0dzedzeḍardzi skes ne—tshi rwakhu— ngu sdi— d+ngha—bha‘tsho ོ/ sto bye yo tsho— ngo~X 4 rke nya ni/rdo lhu po 4〉 lkone ske tsho sna ji4ri tsho bhe rī kizi yam̐ruḥ h+phu rke sta sadoṅkasta tsha 3 r+ṣa ṅka thogyi 7 pya ri ri ci (trīrid+ku hūṃ tsho ri/ 〉sto rtsotre+otre— rmo lke sosku/༈7 —kyerīchi dutsho༄ lnge riju sdu —ri dzaske zhesnye — ra snechi d+kuri1 byā/ra snatsho7 tsā 1 rdzi gle dzā sno r+ṣa74༅ mi me ri 7 — —ṅge tsho mortsu sno— bye skyi) rta spre r+ṇapro ṭ+wāṃrkatsho/ rke riḍaci blo sdukyir+sā ( na’sgru yihūṃnizhe ste skyo tsho kepru— r+ṣaspre —— rto rdzotre dzodza ’1 khe( 4 lkosgo —phro no ju rīju snyerisna kwa sgru 1 /(ṇ+ḍaṃ ne+e( —rwar+sha— — gengabirjo dāngh+runye— bhe 3 )rnyi mo ) sde rtse dzirmesne rme dze d+nghalnge ༄ k+tosne bhe dzotrepyodzi—kā 8— ko4 —— ri/0 shaṃ ’ two—d+nghad+nghane+e ༷ 9tram̐hūṃ7༷byā7rwa/)1—1 kai rke 0d+kuX— rtelke ri dz+nyo(7 0rdzobeḍa — de ༷wa —lkeke ོ— —cho ṅkadedzorte —༷wawa lkedudzha — dzi — rte — horī — tsho

byā༄7/ /klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal byed dang khrid yig lam bzang ye shes snying po bcas bzhugs so/ /rig 'dzin 'gro bol dawa 'a bo rdo rjes mjad/466 trīdīsna( ri 8sproḍāk+toñcād+kudrerlotswa wa tre dā tshispre—phyo shā dzi tram̐ri sdusdocho

dkar chagamadzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ 1klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal byed lhasnan me/ 7'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po yang gsang bla na med pa spyi'i khyad par gyi khrid yig lam bzang ye shes snying po/ 171

༄7/ /gzhung 'di mjad nga po'i rnam tharu mdor bsdus/༄7/ /a 'dzoms 'brug pa rin po che 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje mchog ni/zi ling mtsho sngon nye char sog po du ra tha'u ji'i bu bkra shis 'bum zhes pa mdo smad li thang dga' 'khyil thang du gzhis chags pa'i mi rabs drug gi mtshams a gra zhes pa'i bur chu stag zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nub sku 'khrungs/ kaḥthog dri med ne+eng skyong dpal chos kyi rdo rjes a 'dzoms sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi sprul skur ngos ‘redzin mdzad/ khrom grub thob rgyal ba byang chub kyis 'brug pad+ma dkar po'i skye bar bsngags nas a 'therdoms 'brug pa zhes grags/ zhe chen dbon sprul 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal las skyabs 〈snam gsan te/ mtshan pad+ma mdo sngags lhun grub bzang por gsol/ khong ge mnal 'a ma du dung dkar che chung gnyis 'dug pa chung ba de bus bas dung sgras bod yul lha sa man chad thos pa zhig rmis pas bu 'di rigs bzang yin gsungs/ dgung grangs bcu gnyis par kaḥthog si tu rin po che chos kyi blo gros nges don bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du a khu dang sku mched bcas phebs nas/ klong gsal rdo rje snying po'i khrid pa /ngu chugs pa'i dbang lung khrid bcas gsanarnaskarwas 'chi ba me rtag pa'i gsung /zed kyi skabs nam 'chi cha med kyi myong ba skyes nas/ thugs skyo ste zhal ras mdog 'gyur ba dang bshum pa mjad/ si tu rin po che lan mang du mjal ba'i tha mar sku gsung thugs rten byin chen gyis gtsos pa'i gnang sbyin bcas bstsal nas/ phyin chad dbang lung khrid gsum 'chad spel dgos tshul bka' nan tan gnang / dpal yul rgya sprul mdo sngags bstan 'dzin dang / dgon sprul rang sgrol gnyis las gnam chos sangs rgyas lag bcang / rata gling thugs sgrub skor/ ma ti'i seng 1

༄7/ /gzhung 'di mjad pa pore rnam thar rma dor bsdus/gdong / zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol/ bar do drug khrid sogs dbang lung rgya cher gsan/ brag dkar ri khrod du dge phyogs kyi mkhas grub chen po grags pa don grub phebs pa'i drung nas/ spyod 'jug le'u bzhi/ gsang 'dus lha mang / bde mchog dril bu lugs/ mgon po dkar mthing gi dbang lung bcas gsan pas thugs dgyes tshul gyis khyed byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma'i rigs can du nadug pas/ byang chub sems la blo sbyong gyis zhes gdams/ khyad par 'ja' lus pa nyag bla pad+ma bdud 'dul dang mjal te/ khrom gser gzhung du 'du pa mdo dbang chen po gsungs pa'i dbang dpe 'bul rgyu sogs zhabs tog 'bul dgos bka' bzhin zhus pas/ khyed rang skra lcang lo zhog la khyim pa longs sku'i chas 'chang zhing 'dod yon lnga la spyad nas mchog dman phal nga kun la rdzogs pa chen pe'i chos skal pa dang 'tshams pa 'chad spel mdzang/ na bstan nga/ nyi ma shar ba ltar 'byung bar lung bstan kyang / sku chung ngu nas dge slong bsod snyoms la brten pa zhig gis 'chi kha mi 'gyod pa'i thabs la thugs 'dod che bas/ khyim thabs bzung mi dgos par sanang ba yang yang zhus pas mthar 'am zhig/ na ma byas thabs med kyes skra rwanag rgyu sogs dbang med cig red 'ong de dus rerma gyes sa/sal 'ong gsungs/ zab chos mkha' khyab rang grol gyi nga/bang khrid lung bcas bum pa gang byos tshul du gnang / chos bdag tu lung bstan/ sngar si tu rin po ches 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse las dbang rgyas pa zhig e thob ltos/ da lta khams phyogs 'dir bum pa lag tu len shes pa khong tsam yin zhes bka' ba355 ba bzhin/ gangs can bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi shing rta 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i drung 2

༄7/ /gzhung 'de mjad pa pa'i rnam thar ma dor bsdus/du lan grangs nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar sku bcar zhus pas thugs dgyes tshul gyis dbang lung shin tu mang po dang / khyad par snying thig ma bu sogs 'od gsal gsang ba snying thig gi rgyud lung man ngag thams cad lhag med bum pa gang byos gnang ste/nang thugs kyi sras gcig rtogs pa don gyi rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ dpal sprul chos kyi dbang ngo/sa shin tu thugs brtse chen po gnang nas sngon 'gro kun bzang bla ma/ klong snying rtsa rlung gi smin khrid 'khrul 'khor bcas/ khrid yig ye shes bla ma'i nyams khrid/ bzang spyod kyi khrid zhib rgyas su mdzad nas slob ma skyong bar bka' nan bstsal/ gnyug rgya dbon po 'jigs med las 'khrul zhig dbang drag rgya mtsho'i gcod kyi dbang khrid/ spyo shul bla ma rin po che lung rtogs las ngal gso skor gsum/ mdzod bdun/ snying thig ya bzhi dang / spyod 'jug gi bshad pa tshar gnyis bcas zhib rgyas su gsan/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mi pham rin po che las sa ra ha'i do ha/ bde gshegs snying po'i stong thun/ mdo sdud pa'i 'grel pa/ nges shes sgron me/ bsam pa myur 'grub gsung bshad bcas dang / 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu'i yang srid mtshams sprul kun bzang bde/ chen rdo rje las/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang lung / kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung bcas dang / mi nyag mkhan po nor bu bstan 'dzin las kun btus cha tshang / rje nyid kyi gsar bsgrigs thugs rje chochen po dang tshe sgrub phyogs bsdus kyi dbang khrid/ mdo mkhyen brtse'i sras rdo brag mkhan zur rgyal sras rnam rgyal las byang gter dbang chos/ kaXthog si tu cho gyi rgya mtsho las mkhyen brtse rin po che'i dgongs gter rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying thig gi dbang lung / rje dbon pad+ma rgyal mtshan las rnying rgyud dang / dge rtse'i 3

༄7/ /gzhung 'di mjad nga po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/paṇ+ḍi ta'i bka' 'bum lung / ngor khang gsar mkhan bsod nams rgyal mtshan las mkha' spyod skor gsum be'u bum bcas/ me nyag mkhan po las yen tan mdzod rang 'grel rtsa ba dang / rdo grub 'grel pa rgya mtsho'i chu thigs bcas/ gling tshang mkhan po tshul khrims rgya mtsho las rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang /kaḥthog mkhan skal bzang dbang phyug las bstan 'gyur lung rgyun gang bzhugs thams cad gsan/ gter chen o rgyan rin chen gling pa'i zab gter gyi rtsa ba'i chos bdag tu bsngags te gter chos yongs rdzogs gsan pas thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ rdzogs pa chen po kho na’nyams bzhes kyi thugs dam gcig tu dril bas snang bzhi'i pha mthar son/ snga phyir dgon pa'i 'dus tshogs 'jin skyong dgos tshul zhu mkhan du ma byung yang zhanya gyis ma bzhes/ mthun rkyen mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba tsam/ las gsog 'jog dang bla brang chen po ma mdzad/ dgung grangs so gnyis thog kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung ste rtogs pa na spar ba dang / bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha du mas rjes su bzung / phyi'i lung bstan dus babs bzhin rten sngags 'chang dbu ral lwa thod dkar po/ gzi byur dang ga'u sogs kyi mgul rgyan na bza' bod tshar bzhes pa sogs rgyal po rol pa'i chas yin zhes sku chas bsgyur te bzhugs/ zab gter gyi kha byang dang gsal snang byung yang gro lod phyag rdor bka' thang sogs dgongs gter kha shas las rtsal 'don ma gnang / kaḥthog si citu chos kyi blo gros dang / kun gzigs mkhyen brtse rin po che/ dpal sprul rin po che gtsos dam pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu lung bstan pa ltar rdzogs pa chen po bka' gter gyi dbang dang khyad par 4

༄7/ /gzhung 'di mjad nga po 'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/smin khrid zhib rgyas dus rtag nga/ra bstsal bas/ snga phyir skyes chen dam pa kaḥdapal zhe rdzogs kyi bla sprul che phra mang po dang / mdo mkhyen brtse'i sras rdo rje brag gi mkhan zur sprul sku rgyal sras rnam rgyal/ 'bras ljongs pa thub bstan chos nyid/ngor thar rtse mkhan chen/ sde gzhung sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin sogs dang / g.yung drung bon gyi bstan 'dzin bting chen sgra sprul/ smon rgyas sprul sku rnam gnyis sogs mang po dang / khyad par thams cad mkhyen gzigs kaḥthog si tu nga ṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi rgya mtsho dang / bī ma dngos byon grub dbang rdzogs chen rin po che thub bstan chos kyi rdo rjes rang rang gi gdan sar ched du gdan 'dren zhus nas/snga mas snying thig ya bzhi'i dbang khrid yongs rdzogs dang / phyi mas rdzogs pa chen po'i sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi khrid rim zhib rgyas su gsan/ gdan sa der bzhugs kyi bla sprul mkhan slob thams cad nas dbang khrid rgyas bsdus ci rigs gsan pa dang / dge mang yon tan rgya mtsho/ mkhan kun dpal sogs dang / grub dbang bla ma mtha' yas dang / lung rtogs/ gter chen bsod rgyal sogs nas kyang dbang khrid gdams ngag gsan pas mtshon/ khams dbus gtsang gsum/ a mdo/ rgya gar khu nu/ rgya nag lho 'brug sogs yul dang skad rigs mi gcig pa'i slob ma che phra du ma/ gling dkar chos rgyal yab sras/ lcag la rgyal po 'jigs bral rdo rje sras mo dang / sde btsun mtsho mo sogs/ mi chen nas brtsams 'bangs mi nyam chung yan chad la dbang khrid zab rgyas che phra du mas 'brel tshad don ldan gyi phrin las mthar phyin nas theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa'i nyin byed ches gsal bar mdzod pa'i phrin las mthar phyin/ zhal slob kun la rang la zab 5

༄7/ /gzhung 'di mjad nga po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/gter gyi bka' babs sogs kyang byung mod/ mi che ril po blo gtad gcig chog 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen por byas pas bka' gter nye brgyud ring brgyud kyi chos gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos pa'i gding rnyed/ khyed tshos kyang nyams len rdzogs chen la gyis dang bslu ba med nges yin/ spyir rgyu smon chos gsum gyis 'brel tshad gtsos/ kho bo'i ming tsam thos pa kun kyang dag pa'i zhing du kho bo'i 'dus par skye ba'i smon lam chung nasad bar brjed ma myong / rang gzhan su la'ang dam tshig nyams pa'i mi gcig med pas btagags dga' bzhugs skyid zer ba de yin/ da ni rgad po sdod pa las 'gro ba dga'/ bar srid kyi'agro ba dung phyur gsum 'dren rgyur gu rus lung bstan yod gsungs/ sku gshegs khar/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/ phur pa sogasadakyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba sogs kyi gzigs snang mang po yod tshul zur tsam re gsungs/ nam phyed nas shangs sgrom nas 'od kyi gong bu sran ma tsam mang po khri li li byung ba dang bcas tho rangs dgongs pa dbyings su bsdus so// //

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig /lho༈rdothar lamagasal byed/༄7/ /klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal byed jisnan me zhes bya ba bzhugs rbedu/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru ye/ /ngo bo skye med ka dag chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs nga/'i sku/ /zung 'jug thugs rjes kun khyab sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum dbyer med bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bsgrod pa gcig pu'i lam/ /gsang mchog theg rtse 'od gsal rdzogs pa che/ /ston mdzad brgyud gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs su spyi bos mchod/ /'di na klong chen snying gi thig le yi/ /thun mong sngon 'gro ngag 'don dang 'brel ba'i//khred rim 'jug bde gsal bar byed pa la/ /lha dang bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'dir theg rim dgu'i yang rtse 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po 'phrad chog thos pa rang grol klong chen snying gi thig le'i thun mong sngon 'gu'i rim pa 'chad nyan bgyi ba la/thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro/thun min nang gi sngon 'gro/ nyams len dngos gzhi'i cha lag te lam 'pho ba'i khrid dang gsum/ dang po thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro la blo ldog bzhi zhal byung 'phros don dang bcas pa/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul dang drug go/de la khrid nyan pa'i tshul dang /bshad bya dngos gnyis/khrid nyan tshul la'ang kun slong dang kun spyod gnyis/ dang po sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa zhes/ bsam pa rgya che ba byang chub sems kyi kun slong dang / thabs rgya che ba gsang ba sngags kyi kun slong gnyis/ dang po/ sems can ma ru shes pa/ de'i drin dran pa/drin lan gze 'dod dang gsum/ dang po la'ang spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ spyir sems can thams cad skye ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas da lta'i bar du rang re rnams phan tshun pha ma dgra gnyen sogs 'brel 'dris su ma gyur pa 'ga' yang tshed de/bshesaspring las/ pha ni bu nyid ma ni chung ma nyid/ /'phags nga kat+yā na'i gzigs snang 7

zhu/ /rigalona'agrobolasgroḍihūṃdapa'abordorjes ma dzad/ltar / mchan// skyebodagraragyurapadagabisheme nyad dang / /bzlog pa nyad du mcha bas de slad du//'khor ba dag na nges pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /zhes so/ /de ltar rang re rnams thar pa'i lam la zhugs nas dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su ma blangs na phyis su yang de ltar 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams par 'gyur ba ni/ yang / re res rgya mtsho bzhi bas lhag pa yi/ /'o ma 'thungs te da dung so so yi/ /skye bo'i rjes su 'brang ba'i 'khor ba pas/ /de bas ches mang nyid cig btung 'tshal lo/ /zhes so / / bye brag da lta'i ma 'di nyid las kyis 'phang pas 'bu srin yan chad kyi skye gnas su gyur te yang nas yang du ma byas/ rang bur gyur te shi ba'i rus pa 'thor ba phyogs gcig bstom du yod na dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun po'i tshad las 'das shing /de bzhin du sa chen po 'di rgya shug gi tshi gu'i tshad tsam gyi ril bu dril nas zad zad par grangs bgrangs kyang brtsi ba'i tshad yod na/ ma'i thug mtha' phyogs gcig tu brtsis na zad par mi 'gyur la/ yang de nyid las/ re re'i bdag nyid rus pa'i phung po ni/ /lhun po mnyam pa snyed cig 'das gyur te/ /ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshi gu tsam/ /ri lur bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa drin dran pa ni/ ma rba sko/ra pa tsam du ma zad drin chen pos ni bskyangs/ phan pa tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa las sgo du ma nas bskyab pa'i drin dang ldan pa'i ma sems can 'di rnams lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ma zin pas/ blang dor gyi gnas ni mi shes/bde sdug gi rgyu go log tu sgrub pa'i smyo tshab chen po'i gdon gyis zin pa lta bu'am/ chos kyi snang ba dang ni bral/ dmus long grogs med thang stong du lhags pa lta bu skyabs bral mgon med sdu ga bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis kyis rtag tu mnar ba'i zug gzer rgyun mi 'chad pa'i nad pa lta bu'i ma rgan sems can 'di rnams snying re rjesnyam pa'i snying rje shasami bzod pa lta bur snying nasabasgom/gsum pa drin lan gzo ba ni/ snying rje ba tsam gyis mi chog de sngon ni ma sems can blos 8

༄༅/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayeg /lta rtothar lam gsal byed/btang ste sdug bsngala'akhoraba'aganasasurwa1ra/t+yārang don zha bde kho na ched du gnyer kyang 'grub rgyu sdu ga bsngal las med pa 'di ngo tsha la 'gyod che/ da ni bdag gis ma sems can sdu ga bsngal dang bral te/ gtan bde sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa/ra bya/ de'i ched du bla ma tshul bzhin bsten te dam pa'i chos nyan nas nyams su len la/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' dgos/ de 'bras bu la darma/ bca' ba'i smon sems sam / bsam pa rgya che ba byang chub sems kyi kun slong zhes dge rtsa thabs kyis zin par byed pa sbyor ba sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi lam ji bzhin pa nyams su len skabs dge rtsa gang sgrub dmigs med shes rab kyis rtsis zin dgos pa la/da lta nyan bsam gyi skabs 'dir 'chad 'gyur sngags kyi kun slong gsal 'debs nas kun spyod spang blang rnams dran shes bag yod kyi sgo nas nyams su len pa ni dge ba rkyen gyis mi bshig par byed pa dngos gzhi dmigs med/ mthar thos bsam sgom pa gang la'ang dge rtsa gong 'phel du spel zhing yang dag pa 'i lam du sgyur bar byed pa bsngo ba ste dam pa gsum gyi sgrom du tshud pa'i dge rtsa gang bsgrub theg chen thar pa cha mthun rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa'i rgyu ma nor ba yin pas/ de'i phyir dang po kha nang du log nas rang gi kun slong brtags la 'jig rten tshe 'di'i ched du'am/lung ma bstan du 'dug na yang dag pa'i lam du bcos dgos te/ klu sgrub kyis/sems kyis 'ching bar byed cing grol byed pa/ /bems bum 'di la nus pa 'ga' yang med/ /ces dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ bsam pa dge dang mi dge'i bye brag las/ /dge sdig gzugs brtan che chung rjes mi 'gro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa thabs rgya che ba gsang ba sngags kyi kun slong ni/ tshul gsum sgron me las / don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa ltar/9

༄7/ /riga'ajena'agrobolazlo/rdobyedapa'abo rdo rjes ma dzad/chos 'chad pa'iganasa'adanyadathamalatsusmibam̐masapara'og man chos kyi dbyangs kyi pho brang / chos ston pa'i bla ma rang rgyud pa mi sems par kun bzang rdo rje 'chang /nyan pa po'i 'khor rnams skyon can du mi sems par sems dpa' dang sems ma/bshad par bya ba'i chos gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa/ bshad pa'i dus ni rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo ste phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan du dag snang sbyangs shing gsal gdab/rtsa ba'i gnyis pa kun tu spyod pa la'ang spang blang gnyis/ dang po la snod kyi skyon gsum/dri ma drug /mi 'dzin pa lnga ste gsum/ dang po snod kyi skyon gsum ni/ /rna ba ma gtad kha sbub lta bu'i skyon/ /yid la ma bzung zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon/ /nyon mongs dang 'dres dug can lta bu'i skyon/ /zhes nga/ ltar/ dang po chos nyan pa'i dus rang gi rna ba'i shes pa gzhan du ma yengs par chos kyi sgra de la gtad de legs par nyan dgos/ ma nyan na snod kha sbubs pa'i steng du bcud ci tsam blugs kyang thigs gcig nang du mi 'gro ba lta bu lus chos gral du yod kyang chos ma thos pa dang khyad med pa'i skyon yod/ gnyis pa thos pa de la don gnyer dang ldan pa'i sgo nas tshig don yid la 'dzin dgos/ ma bzung na snod zhabs rdol du bcud mi chags pa lta bu'i chos ci tsam thos rung rang rgyud la skyed 'don med cing gdams pa rgyud thog tu bkal nas nyams su len mi shes pas tha mal pa dang khyad med pa'i skyon yod/gsum pa kun slong grags 'dod dang rnyed tshol sogs chos brgyad kyi bsam pas ma yin par yang dag pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pas nyan dgos/ sems nyon mongs pa dang 'dres bzhin du chos nyan na chos kyis rang gi mems la mi phan par ma zad chos kyang chos min du 'gro ba ni dug can gyi snod du bcud bzang po blugs pa dang 'dra ba'i skyon yod do/ /de'i phyir bdag cag gi ston pas kyang / khyod kyis legs par nyon la yid la zungs shig dang /ngas khyod la legs par bshad do//zhes pa ltar/ yid kyi shes pa gzhan 10

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / ste thar lam gsal byed/du ma g.yengasapalegasaparanyan/ tshigarder+sharnoms yamabral ba' sgo nas yad la gzung / yul chos dang bla ma mched grogs la skyon rtog mi bya zhing lhag bsam bzang ngo dang ldan pas nyan dgos so/ /gnyis pa dri ma drug ni/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang / /don du gter ba med nyid dang //phyi rol rnam g.yengs nang du sdud/ /skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ chos 'jig rten gang thad nas bla ma las nga'i lhag snyam nga/'i nga rgyal/chos dang bla ma la ma dad pa'i log lta/chos thos bsam la don gnyer med pa/ sems phyi rol la g.yengs bzhin pa dang / ha cang nang du sdu da che ba/ chos thun ring grag pa sogs kyis skyo ba ste dri ma drug spang dgo sa/ dang po nga rgyal dang phrag dog gnyis po 'di bag nyal gyi nyon mongs pa yin pas so se'i skye bos ngos zin dka'/ rang la chos dang 'jig rten gang thad nas yon tan phran bu re yod pa la / nga ni 'di dang 'di lta bu'o snyam du rang rgyud kyi skyon ni mi mthong / gzhan gyi yon tan yang skyon tu mthong ba lta bu de yin la/ — phrag dog ni rang dang 'gran zla yod pa'am/ min kyang gzhan gyi 'byor ba dang yon tan yod pa mthong ba'am thos pa'i tshe mi dga' zhing snying gzer gu re 'gro ba de yin pas dus kun tu ngos bzung zhing spang ci thub gal che/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa/sa/ rang bzhin ngan pa skrul gdug lta bu dang / /gzhan 'byor la sdang lha ma yin gyi sems/ /skyabs 'os bslu zhing chos la sdang ba dang / /brku dang 'phrog bcom rngon pa'i lus spongs shog /ces shin tu sdig pa kha na ma tho ba'i las su gsungs pa ltar/ nga rgyal gyi gnyen po phyag dang / phrag dog gi gnyen po dga' ba sgom dgos par gsungs pas na/ bla ma mthong ba'i dus su mthong phyag gzigs pha'i skabs su gzigs phyag gral la 'khod pa'i skabs su gral phyag 'tshal dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yab de yin par 'dug nga/sa / chos gral du tshogs skabs su dus de ring nas bla ma dang mched lcam gyi bran 11

༄/ riga'adzina'agrobolarte~Xbyedapa'abo rdo rjes ma dzad/du dag ga lusangagayadagasumadabulaṣ+pe ra khri gya'o snyamapa dang / phrag dog ga gnyen por rdo rje mched lcam sogs dam pa gong ma rnams kyi yon tan ji lta ba de lta bu'i rjes su bdas slob po snyam pas dga' ba'i mig gis blta zhing rjes su yi rang ba dang bcas me tog pad ma kha 'bus pa lta bu zhes thal mo khong stong dang / ga'u chung gi brtul zhugs zhes lag mthil gnyis sbyar te sor rtse rnams sprad pa'i thal mo gang rung gnas gsum du gtugs la lag mthil gnyis pus mo'i lha nga gnyis dpral ba ste lus kyi ma lnga sa la phabs pa ste/ gus 'dud kyi brtul zhugs lung rig dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal/ gnyis pa dad pa med na chos kyi 'jug sgo 'gags shing thar pa'i sa bon rul pa yin te/ mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi dag la / // dkar pe'i chos ni mi 'byung zhing / /sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dad pa med na rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'jug nga 'i thabs med de/ o rgyar/ chen pos/ dad med brag phug byang bltas lta bu la/ /thugs rje'i nyi ma nam yang 'char dusasmad// /dad med chu dkyil rdo ril lta bu la/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus nam yang zin dus med/ /ces pa ltar dad pa brtan po yod dgos/de la dwangs pa'i dad pa/ 'dod pa'i dad pa/ yid ches pa'i dad pa/ mi ldog pa'i dad pa dang bzhi yod la/ dang po ni bla ma mjal ba'am chosathos pa'i dus sems kyi rnyogs ma dwangs nas dga' ya le ba de yin/ gnyis pa 'khor ba las thar zhing sangs rgyas par 'acesad pa/ gsum pa rgyu 'bras la yid ches nga// bzhi pa bla ma sangs rgyas dngos mthong gi bar dge blo gong 'phel du gyur ba rnams so/ /dad pa ni yon tan thams cad kyi nang na yod des chog yin te/ phal po che'i mdo las byang chub sems dpa' ku na tu bzang pos/ dad pa sems gsal rnyogabashapa med pa ste/ /nga rgyal rnam spangs srid zhu'i rtsa ba yin/ /dad pa spyod mchog nor dang gter yin te/ /lag pa lta bu dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes dang /mdo las/ don dam pa ni dad pas 12

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /ste thar lam gsal byed/rtogs parabya'o/ /zhesaso//deyangakhazhe3damezhagadagos te/ /grub pa' dbang phyug chen po'i zhal snga nas/ /chos snying nas bsgrub pa rnams kyis kha zhe med pa'i dad pa 'di kho na gal che/ de la yang / phyi dkar la nang nag pa ri nag po kha bas g.yogs pa lta bu'i dad pa spangs dgos/ phyi nang gsal sgrib med pa shel gyi mchod rten lta bu'i dad pa bsten dgos/ 'bar sla la 'chi myur ba rtsa'i sgron ma lta bu'i dad pa spangs dgos/ dwangs gsal yun thub nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i dad pa bsten dgos/ 'bab sla la chad myur ba dbyar kyi shwa chu lta bu'i dad pa spangs dgos/rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhung lta bu'i dad pa bsten dgos/ zhes dang / klong chen pas / rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dad pa yis/ /dus rnams kun tu skyo ngal med par bsten/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa/ chos la don gnyer med na thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan 'byung ba'i dus med/ don du gnyer ba'i brtson 'grus can la yon tan thams cad 'byung bar gsung pasasnying dang rdo rus 'phrod pa'i don gnyer la brtson dgos/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang / ngas ni khyod la thar pa'i lam bstan gyi/ /thar pa rang la rag las brtson par gyis/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ chos go lo thos los grub pa ni mi thob/ gzugs rab byung tsam gyis nyan thos su mi 'gro/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can des slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su chos tshig bzhi re'i phyir du sku lus la sha'i kong bu stong brus nas 'bru mar gyi sdong bu btsugasate me sbar ba dang / sku lus me dong du mchong ba dang / sku lus la lcags kyi gzer bu stong btab pa sogs dka' ba brgya phrag gi sgo nas chos btsal ba yin te/ me tshogs spu gri'i so yang brgal nas ni / / phyi mthar thug gi bar du dam chos btsal/ /zhes pa ltar dam pa gong ma'irnam thar la tshad btsugs/dka' tshegaral dub thamasacad khyad du bsadanas thos bsam la 'bad 'tshal/bzhi pa/chosanyan pa'i dus mig sogs dbang po phyi rol gyi yul 13

༄/ /reg lon 'gro 2larmye/ / ༵dpa' bo rdo rjes ma/dzad/la g.yengasanasasosa'askyeba'asebe+esatshulargyorjesasu3|ra nas nyan bsam/ sgom pa gang yin don med du 'gro bas g.yeng ba spangs dgos/lnga pa/ ha cang dbang po nang du sdud che na gnyid rgyugs sogs 'byung ba'i skyon yod pas sems bag yangs su bzhag la nyan/ chos kyi tshig don re re nas spar zin byas na re re zin dus re re brjed 'gro bas sems grim lhod ran par byas nas nyan/ drug pa/ chos thun ring drag pas tsha grang ltog skom sogs dang / lus nad kyis gdung ba lta bu'i dus chos spang gi las mi gsog par dran shes kyis zin par bya zhing /da res dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/mtshan lngan gyi bla ma mjal/ dam pa'i chos 'chi sos kyi bdud rtsi lta bu'i zab mo'i gdams ngag nyan pa'i skal pa dang ldan pa 'di re 'tsheng chos 'di'i ched du dka' tsheg ngal dub ji ltar byung yang bzod par bya snyam du slar spro ba bskyed de nyan/de ltar nyan pa'i phan yon ni/ 'dul ba lung las/ grogs po gang dag dad dam chos nyan nga / / 'di 'dra bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed par dka'/ /zhes so / / gzhan yang chos ston pa'i dus kyi chos rnga dang chos dung gi sgra rna bas thos tshad kyi sems can gyi rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon theb par gsung na/ tshul bzhin nyan pa'i phan yon ni smos ci dgos/rnga bo che'i mdo las/dam chosabastan pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /rnga'am gaṇ+ḍi brdung ba'i sgra/ /thos pas byang chub thob 'gyur na/ skonatshophyir lhags pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lung gis nges shes bskyed de spro bzhin nyan nga/ ni gal che/ de ltar nyan bsamabasgom pa'i dus nam yang / sngar song bag chags kyi rjes su mi 'brang / ma 'ongs nyon mongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i tshogs drug rkyen khar ma shor ba zhig dgos te/rgyal sras rin po che thogs med kyis/ sngon spyad bde sdug chu yi ri mo 'dra/ /zin pa rjes med yin gyis rjes ma gcod/ /cis kyang dran na 'byor rgud 'du 'bral soms//ltos thub chos las 'dugage ma ṇi pa//phyi tshis grab 3|ma grogs skam nya rgya 'dra//bsam pa'i thog tu mi 'bab 'dod 'dun 4

༄༅/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yeg sna rdonithar lam gsal byed/skyungs/ /cas kyangadranananama'achachamedasosh+lause/ /chosaman bya long 'dug ge ma ṇi pa/ /'phral gyi bya bzhag rmi lam so tshe 'dra/ /'bad pa don med yin gyis skyur la thongs/ /chos mthun zas kyang zhen med rgya yis thob/ /bya byed snying po med do ma ṇi ba/ /rjes thob dus gsum rtog pa'i 'dul sbyong 'di/ /dran snang thams cad chos skur ma shar bar//med thabs med do dgos dus dran par gyis/ /'khrul rtog yan par ma btang ma ṇi pa/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa mi 'dzin pa lnga ni/ tshig 'jin la don mi 'dzin pa dang /don 'dzin la tshig mi 'dzin pa dang /brda ma 'phrod par 'jin pa dang / gong 'og bsnol te 'dzin pa dang / log par 'dzin pa dang lnga po spang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa blang bya'i kun spyod la 'du shes bzhi dang phar phyin drug dang spyod lam gzhan bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po/ sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag nyid la nad pa'i ladu shes bskyed par bya'o/ /chos la sman gyi 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /nan tan nyams su len pa la nad nye bar 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /zhes rang re thog ma med pa'i dus nas rgyu nyon mongs pa dang 'bras bu sdu ga bsngal rnam pa du mas rtag tu mnar ba'i nad pa lta bu yin la/ nad de las thar bar 'dod na sman shi sos kyi bdud rtsi lta bu dam pa'i chos yin la/dper na nad tshan po ches theb pa'i nad pa dag gis sman nga bzang po zhig bsten te/ des gang bsgo ba la nyan nas sman nan gyis ma btung na nad la phan mi srid/de bzhin du sman pa bzang po lta bu'i bla ma bsten/ des gang gsung gi chos la nan tan ma byas na ma rig 'khor ba'i gcong nad drag po sel mi nus/ dper na nad pas sman pa mthong ba tsam gyis mi phan/ khyod kyi nad 'di'o/ /sman 'di lta butshuzhig btung na phan zer ba tsam gyis kyang mi phan/ sman bsdusanas byin gyang ma btung na mi phan la/ byude bzhin 5

sto/ /rigalona'agro2la(swādapa'abordo rjes ma/dzad/du bla ma mjalalodang/ chosathosalotsaḍāgyeshā'akhor ba' sdug bsngal las thar dka' bas na/gong smosabazhin brtson 'grus drag posachos la nan tan du bya/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ bla ma bsten kyang gdams ngag ma lon na/ /mdo stor rgya mtsho'i 'gram du skom rid lus/ /gdams ngag yod kyang rgyud la ma 'byor na/ /bcang ba don chung sman dpyad yi ge 'dra/ /zhes pa ltar/ da res yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams rta kha srab kyis bsgyur ba dang 'dra ba rang re dal 'byor gyi lus rten ni thob/sman pa mkhas pa lta bu'i bla ma dam pa dang mjal/ 'chi gsos kyi bdud rtsi lta bu'i dam pa'i chos dang 'phrad pa'i skabs 'dir thos pa'i chos nyams su blangs nas thar pa'i lam du 'gro ba zhig mi byed re snyam pa'i dam bca'/ log pa'i 'du shes tshe 'di'i ched du rnyed bkur 'jigs skyob sogs kyi bsam pas ma yin par/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang don du gnyer ba'i kun slong rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bla mas gang gsung tshad mar 'dzin pa ni gnad kyi dam pa'o/ /gnyis pa phar phyin drug gi sgo nas 'chad nyan bgyi tshul la/ 'chad pa pos phar phyin drug gi sgo nas 'chad par bya ste/ dang po rnyed bkur sogs chos brgyad kyi bsam pa'i dug dang ma 'dres par bstan pa dang sems can la rjes su dgongs nas 'chad pa ni len pa med pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa/ gnyis pa ngom pa'i nga rgyal sogs ma yin par rgyal ba'i bka'/ bla ma'i lung / rang gi nyams myong tshad ma gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad pa ni tshul khrims kyi phar phyin/ gsum pa slob mas spyod lam nor ba'i log sgrub dang rang ngal dub sogs la bzod de 'chad pa ni bzod pa'i phar phyin/ bzhi pa rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa thamasacad kyi nang nas mchog dang phul du gyur pa ni chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa dang 'chad spel gyis rab tu snang bar byed pa sogs yin pas rgyu mtshan shes pa'i sgo nas spro bzhin du 'chad pa ni brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin/ lnga pa thugs gzhan du mi g.yengs shing legs par 'chad pa ni bsam gtan gyi phar 16

༄༅/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig sna rtethara' mgasal byed/phyan/ drug pa'achadapape'ablama'achadabye'ichase 'chad yul slob ma thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur shes pa'i sgo nas slob ma'i rgyud tshod dang bstu na nas 'chad shes pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nyan pa po slob mas kyang nyan tshul ni/chos spyod thams cad kyi man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud las/ me tog stan sogs rab 'bul zhing / /sa phyogs spyod lam sdom pa dang / /srog chags kun la 'che mi bya/ /bla ma la ni yang dag dad/ /ma yengs bla ma'i gdams ngag nyan//dogs sel phyir na skyon tshig 'dri/ /sgron ma yan lag drug dang ldan/ /zhes pa ltar/ dang po chos kyi khri bshams nas gdan 'ding ba dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs sbyin pa/ gnyis pa gnas khang phyag dar byas nas dri'i chag chag gdab pa me tog bkram pa sogs spyod lam thams cad zhi dul chos dang mthun par bya ba ni tshul khrims/gsum pa grogs mched kyis gasdu'i srog chags phra mo yan chad la lus ngag gis gnod 'tshe mi byed pa dang chos phyir dka' tsheg ngal dub sogs la bzod de nyams su len pa bzod pa/ bzhi pa bla ma dang chos la 'phrad dka' ba'i 'du shes bzhag nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i sgo nas spro ba dang bcas te nyan pa ni brtson 'grus/ lnga pa sems gzhan du mi g.yengs shing tshig don ya ma bral bar 'dzin cing nyan pa bsam gtan/ drug pa sla chos dang shes lo tsam du mi bzhag par the tshom sogs dogs sel gang byung slar dri zhing gdams pa'i phu thag bcad de nyan pa ni shes rab ste nyan pa pos de lta bu'i sgo nas nyan par bya'o/ /gsum pa spyod lam gzhan bstan pa la spang blang gnyis las/ dang po 'dul ba lung las / ma gus pa la chos mi bshad//mi na bzhin du mgo g.yogs dang / /gdugs dang 'khar ba mtshon thogs dang / /mgo bo dkris pa dag la min/ /zhes pa ltar chos la ma gus pa dang mgo la zhwa gyon nas 'dug pa sogs go sla bas de dag spang la nyan dgos/ gnyis pa skye rabs las/rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul 7

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrosnyer+ṣalasnyesdowadapa'abordorjes ma dzad/ba' dpal narabatubaskyed/ /dga'adangasdin —pe' mag sa blta/ /tshig ga bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /rab tu sgrim te chos nyon cig /ces pa ltar/rab tu gus shing dad mos spro dga' dang bcas pas nyan pa'i bsod nams ni tshad med de/ phal ngo/ che'i mdor 'jam dpal gyis/ rgyal ba kun dang chos dang dge 'dun dang / /de bzhin bla mar gyur pa thams cad la/ /dad dang mos dang dga' ba bskyed byas te/ /sri zhur mchod byas byang chub sems kyang skye/ /zhes pa ltar/ skyon rtog mi bya bar rang ngos kyi sangs rgyas bka' drin dang ldan pa ni bla ma 'di yin pas bla ma 'di la bsten nas dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin la gdams pa zab mo nyams su len cing tshe 'dirasangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya snyam du chos dang gang zag ya bral du ma song pa'i sgo nas nyams su len par bya ste/de nyid kyis rgyal ba bde gshegs ces la yid ches te//rgyal sras spyod pa rnams la yid ches te/ /byang chub bla na med la yid ches shing / /skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sems skye'o/ /zhes so/ /des kun slong dang kun spyod kyi rim pa bstan zin to/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa 'chad bya dngos la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po thun mong la'ang drug /dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag /sdig pa'i rgyu 'bras/ dge ba'i rgyu 'bras/thams cad las kyi rang bzhin du bstan pa/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul lo/ /dang po dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba bshad pa la'ang bzhi/ ngo bo dal ba la bsam nga//khyad par gyi chos 'byor pa la bsam pa/ rnyed dka'i dpe la bsam pa/ grangs kyi khyad par la bsam pa'o/ /dang po ngo bo dal ba la bsam pa ni/spyir mi khoms pa'i gnas brgyad dang bral te dam pa'i chos bsgrub par khoms pa dang ldan pa yin la/da res dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / kho ring lha dang kla klo log lta can/ /sangs rgyas ma byon zhid dang lkugs pa ste/ /mi khoms brgyad las thar ba'i dal ba 18

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig rdo rtothar 'a ma gsal byed/thob/ /ces nganasongagasumanalasanganaspyo9dazeng gsa'aphang nga/'a 'bras bu tsha grang bkres skom glen lkugs bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal la rtag tu spyod pas chos byed du mi khoms/ tshe ring lha zhes pa ni 'du shes med pa'i lha ste dge sdig gi 'du shes med pa'i bsam gtan la thar par bzung nas bsgom pa'i 'bras bu 'du shes med pa'i lhar skye ba rnams ting nge 'jin de'i ngang du bskal chen mang po'i bar du gnas shing / mthar der 'phen byed kyi las zad pa na log lta'i rgyus ngan song du skyes te chos byed mi khoms pa ste phyi'i mi khoms pa bzhi/ kla klo ni dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan tsam yang thos ma myong ba'i mtha' khob sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs yod par bshad la/ de dag ni 'tshe ba chos su smra ba kla klo'i chos lugs zhes srog bcad de dge bar rtsi ba'i yul ngan sems can gsod pa dang ri dwags bsher ba sogs mi dge ba'i las thabs la lhag par mkhas shing sdig 'ba' zhig la spyod cing shi ma thag ngan song du 'gro ba mang bas mi khoms/log lta can ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las phyi rol tu gyur pa'i lta log rtag chad du lta ba rnams te/ de dag gi rang rgyud lob ltas bslad nas yang dag pa'i chos la mos pa mi skye bas dam pa'i chos byed du mi khoms/ bod 'dir o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis la gtad pas mu stegs pa dngos mi 'jug mod kyang / de dang cha 'dra ba yang dag pa'i gdams ngag lta sgom gyi phu thag ma chod spu'i yid dpyod blos byas kyi lta ba rtag chad la zhugs pa'i log rtog can ni dmo pa'i chos tshul bzhin ma yin pas mi khoms pa yin/ sangs rgyas ma byon pa'i zhing ste mun pa'i bskal par skye na chos nyams su len pa'i skal pa med pas mi khoms/ lkugs par skye na spyir rang rgyud las su ma rung bas chos nyan 'chad sgom sgrub gang yang byed mi nus/ de la'ang gnyis yod/ngag lkugs pas smra mi shes pas na mi'i mtshan nyid mi tshang /yid kyi dbang po skugs pa ste shin tu blun rmongs su gyur pas blang dor gyi gnas mi she sa pa rnamaso kyarnga mi 19

༄/ /rig 'dzin 'gro snyer+ṣal ṣ+ṭṛ tādapa' bo rdo rjes rma dzad/khoms pa stenangagamakhomasapabazha'o/ mo/gny-i sapa khyadapar gya chos 'byor pa bcu la'ang rang 'byer lnga/ gzhan 'byor lnga dang bcu/ dang po ni/ mir gyur dbang po tshang dang yul dbus skye//las mtha' ma log bstan la dad pa ste/ /rang nyid 'byor pa lnga tshang zhes/ de yang mi lus ma thob na chos dang mi 'phrad la/ da res smra shes don go ba mi lus rten gyi 'byor pa/1 dbang po ma tshang na chos kyi gegs su gyur pa la / dbang po skyon dang bral bas na dbang po yon tan gyi 'byor pa/2 yul mtha' khob tu skyes na chos dang bla ma mi mjal la/ da res chos tshigs kyi yul dbus su skyes pas na yul khyad par can gyi 'byor pa/3las kyi mtha' log na rtag tu bsam spyod mi dge ba kho na la spyod par 'gyur na/ da res dge ba dang thar lam la mos pa bsam pa khyad par can gyi 'byor pa/4sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ma dad na chos la yid mi phyogs pa las/da res dad pa'i gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can la rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dad pa thob pa ni yang dag pa'i chos kyi snod ma nor ba rang 'byor lnga'i gtso bo yin/ lnga po 'di dag rang ngos la ltos nas tshing dgos pa'i rang rgyud skal pa'i 'byor pa zhes bya la/ de yang mi lus thob rung dbang po sgo lnga gang rung zhig ma tshang na rab byung gi sdom pa'i rten du mi 'gyur zhing mos gus kyi rten rgyal ba'i sku gzugs dang / thos bsam gyi rten gsung rab mjal ba dang nyan pa la 31gas pa'i skal pa dang mi ldan pas chos yang dag pa'i snod du mi rung / yul mtha' khob tu skyes na chos kyi snang ba dang bral te lam log par zhugs/las mtha' log pa zhes rngon pa dang smad 'tshong ma la sogs pa'i rigs rgyud du skyes na chung ngu'i dus nasasgo gsum chos dang 'gal ba'i las byas tshad sdig par 'gro zhing las kyi mtha' log de'i rigs dngos min kyang phal cher la dus dbang lta bus 'byung nye ba mthong chos su gyur pa 'di yin/ bstan pa/ la ma dad na thar pa'i skal pa chad pas 'dren pa'i thabs med do/ /10

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam/ gsal byed/gnyas pa gzhana'abyoralngan/sangasargyasasdomanarī/chosagasungs bstan pa gnas dang de la zhugs/ bshes gnyen dam pas zin dang gzhan 'byor lnga/ zhes/ da res mdo sngags gnyis kyi ston pa sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa'i bskal bzang sgron bskal chen po dang 'phrad pas ston pa khyad par can gyi 'byor pa/1 de'i chos 'khor rim pa gsum sogs mdo sngags kyi chos nyi ma shar ba lta bu bsgyur bshad mdzad/bstan pa yang gnas pas bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'byor pa/2 de 'dzin lung rtogs bstan pa'i bdag po du ma yang bzhugasapa'i dus khyad par can gyi 'byor pa/3rang rang gi las 'phro bzang pos bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa rang gi skal pa'i 'byor pa/4zhugs kyang mthun rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su ma bzung na blang dor gyi gnas mi shes pas na/des zin pa lhag pa thugs rje dang rang ngosanas chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen zas gos kyi 'byor pa tshang ba ste lnga po 'di ni gzhan gyi rkyen la ltos dgos pas na gzhan 'byor lnga'o/ /de ltar dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang nges pa zhig dka' ste dal ba bas kyang 'byor ba tshang dka'/de yang rang 'byor mir gyur dbang po tshang / yul dbus su skyes kyang /las kyi mtha' log lam du zhugs shing rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ma dad na gsum las med/de gnyis gang rung zhig ma tshang na bzhi las med/ de las kyang las kyi mtha' log pa shin tu 'byung nye/g.yin 'byor lnga lasasangs rgyas byon/chos gsungs/bstan pa gnas rung / rang bstan pa'i sgor ma zhugs shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ma zin na gsum las med/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa de la tha na'ang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la snying khung nas yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po tsam yang med pa dang lam dang lam min gyi dbye ba phyogs tsam yang mi shes pa'i bcos ma'i chos gzugs mi dred kyi lad mo lta bu'i kha ton byed lo dang ser gosagyon pa tsam gyis bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nges pa'i go mi chod/ kun slong bzang posalung 21

༄/ /rig྾na'agrospyol sni/ byedapa'abordorjes mdzad/rtogs kyi bstanapalargyumatshanashesapa'angudadari pa khyad par can dang 'khor ba las bdag gzhan sgrol 'dod kyi nges 'byung khyad par can rgyud la skye ba zhig cis kyang dgos te/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ mtho ris thob kyang sdug bsngal rnam gsum gyis/ /dam la ma bzhag 'khor ba yod min na/ /bde 'gro'i rten la mya ngan 'da' ba'i gegs//mi khoms gnas dang mchungs ldan lus spongs shog/ces so/ /rang la dal 'byor gyi chosa'adi dag tshang ngam mi tshang brtags la mi tshang na slar tshang ba'i thabs la 'bad/ tshang na dga' gabasgom ste skyesngon rang gi dal 'byor 'di lta bu thob byed kyi rgyu bsod nams cher bsags pa la nga rgyal med pas rjes su yi rang dang / sdug bsngal du ma khyad du bsad nas rten bzang 'di bskyed pa'i ma drin mo che de'i drin dran te drin lan gzo 'dod kyi bsam pa byang chubatu sems bskyed pa dang /'di lta bu'i sangasargyas bsgrub pa'i rten tshul bzhin ngo sprad pa po ni blasgo yin pas de'i bka' drin dang yon tan dran pa'i sgo nasabasngo ba dang smon lam bya/de yang res 'ga' ba ma yin par rtag tu blo sbyangs la 'bad 'tsha la/thams cad rang la tshang ba'i gnas thob kyang / /rkyen mnganges pa med pa'i tshespangasanag /'jig rten pha rol nyid du son bar 'gyur/ /zheg de lta bu'idal 'byor bdag rang la tshang ba'i gnas thob pa 'di dngos su yin nam rmi lam yin snyam pa tsam gyi dga' ba bsgom/ dal 'byor la snying po ma lon par chud zos su shor nasa'ajigarten 'di'i gson pa'i tshe spangs te/'jigarten pha rol gyi lam la son pa ste 'gro dgos par gyur na ci bya snyam du blo sbyang /bar chad rkyen dbang du mi btang bar blo chos su 'gro ba dang chosalam dang 'gro ba zhig bla ma o rgyan pad+ma dang kun mkhyen yab sras gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed mkhyen zhes kha zhe med pa'i gsol ba snying nes 'debs pa ni/ blo sna chos la sgyur cig gu ru mkhyen/ kham gol dman par ma gtong kun mkhyen rje/ /gnyis su med do drin chen bla ma mkhyen//gsumaspra 12

༄༅/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig lti rtotharalamagasal byed/rnyed dka' dpe labasamapalaganyis/ dngat+pargyu'asgonasarnyed par dka' ba ni/da res dal rten don yod ma byas na/ /phyi nas thar pa sgrub pa'i rten mi rnyed/ /zhes/spyir lha mi'i lus rten thob byed kyi rgyu dus khrims dang gtan khrims kyi tshul khrims yin cing /de'i steng du mchod sbyin dang / chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa sogs smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyor med na chos ldan gyi lus rten khyad par can thob dka'/dper na dpyid sa bon mang nyung gi dbang gis ston 'bras bu de ltar smin pa bzhin no / / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /skyes bu'i don sgrub thob par gyur ba la/ /gal te 'di la phan nga ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis nas yang dag 'byor ba ga la 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ da lta'i dal 'byor thob pa 'di don yod par ma byas na phyis nas 'di lta bu'i lus rten rnyed par mi 'gyur bas/ sa lud drod gsher 'dzom dus zhing la sa bon ci theb byed dgos pa ltar/ nyin dpa dang mtshan nyal gyi long med pa lta bu'i sgo nas myur du snying po len dgos so/ /gnyis pa dpe'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' tshul ni/ bde 'gra'i rten la bsod nams zad gyur na / / shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gror 'khyams/ /dge sdig mi shes chos kyi sgra mi thos/ /dge ba'i bshes dang mi mjal mtshang re che/ /zhes/ bde 'gro mtho ris gsum gyi nang nas skye dka' ba 'dzam ba'i gling pa khams drug ldan dbang bzhi'i snod du rung ba'i mi lus rin po che 'dirdzinyid stabs legs tsam gyis ni ma yin par 'phen byed kyi rgyu gong smosaltar bsodanams tshad med pa lasabyung ba yin pas bsod nams dge ba'i blo gong 'phel la brtson dgos/ ma brtson na snga ma'i 'phen byed kyi las de zad par gyur tshe/ rdzogs byed ldig pa'i dbang gisaphyi mar 'og nas 'og tu ngan sang ngan 'gro mu mtha' med par 'khyams te daṣ+kasdig blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes dang mi mjal pas 'jig rten 'dita ma tshang de bsache ba ni med/ dper na rlabs chen pos3ma par dkrugasaba'i rgya mtsho'iltengachakhriganyang shing 23

༄/ /rega'ajina'agroboladro/ hūṃtwedapa'abordorjes mdzad/ bu ga dang /rgyam 'gatanganayod pa'aru sbol gya mgran pa 'phrad pa las kyang mi lus thob par dka' ba bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs la/ zhi ba lhas kyang /rgya mtsho'i cher g.yengs gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /mi nyid shin tu thob dka' gsungs//zhes pa ltar/ dpe la brten nas blo sbyang ngo / /bzhi pa grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' tshul la gnyis/ dang po/ mtho ris mi'i lus thob dka' tshul spyir bsten pa ni/ sems can tsam gyi grangs dang rim nga la/ /bsam na mi lus thob pa srid mtha' tsam/ /zhes/ spyir sems can gyi grangs la bsam na mi lusathob pa srid mtha' tsam ste/ 'di ltar dmyal ba na mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam la/ yi dwags na nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ yi dwags na mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam la / dud 'gro na nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ dud 'gro na mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam la/ lha ma yin na nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ lha ma yin na mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam la/ lha mi gnyis nyin mo'i skar ma tsam lasamed par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa bye brag mi'i 'gro ba las kyang chos ldan gyi lus thob dka' tshul ni/ mi yang chos med sdig la spyod mthong na//chos bzhin spyod pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam /zhes/ spyir gong smos bzhin mtho ris lha mi gnyis ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya'i mchog yin pas lus rten rnyed dka' bar gsungasapa dang / khyad par du 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi lus ni de bas rnyed dka' ba ni/ slob dpon tsan+t+ra go sī'i zhal nas/ bde gshegs lam rten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing / /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i/ /lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed lha min dang //mkha' lding sha za mi'am ci dang sto 'phyes min//zhes so//de lta bu'i 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi brgya phrag mang po mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam dus gcig la tshogs na'ang bsod nams dge ba'i blo gsum dang ldan zhing dal brgyad 'byor bcu ji lta ba bzhin tshang ba'i mi ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam mama.u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar dkon zhes/o 24

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / sko thar lam gsal byed/rgyan chen pos/ yangayangarnyedadaka'a.usdumashrīraltar/ /rnyed pa don ldan yad bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /zhes dang / tsan+t+ra go sī'i zhal nas/ gang zhig thob na skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar 'byin cing //byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs byed la//yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan cher lhag pa'i/ /mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed/ /ces so/ /de ltar rgyu grwangs dahe gsum gyi sgo nas dka' bzhin rnyed pa'i rten bzang yid bzhin gyi neri bu lta bu 'di la snyi nga po myur du len nus pa zhig bla ma mkhyen snyam pas/ blo sna chos la lam gol— gnyis su zhes kha tsam min pa'i gsol ba snying nas 'debs so/ /spyir mi lus thob tshad dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che zhes 'bod du rung ba yin pa'i nges pa med de/kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ sdom min rgyud ldan rgyal blon sdig to can/ /g.yul las dga' dang zhal lce 'khyogs por gcod/ /rje bo'i bran gyur nyams chung mnar ba dang /tshong pa dang ni g.yon can lus spong she/ga /ces pa ltar/ gzhan dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ma zin pa'i rgyal blon sogs 'jig rten gyi stobs 'byer mnga' thang che btsan snyan grags ci tsam yod kyang rung lam gyi blang dor mi shes shing sems can la gnod pa kho na skyel ba'i rigs rnams dud 'gro dang khyad med pa de la mi lus phal pa zhes bya/ rje btsun mi las/ khyi ra pa mgon po rdo rje la/ spyir dal 'byor mi lus dkon gsungs kyang / khyod 'dra mthong na dkon rgyu med/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ rngon pa dang shan pa lta bu'i lus rten ni thob pa bas ma thob na dga' la ngan 'gro'i gting rdo yin pas na mi lus tsam po nga/'am snying med ces bya/ gal te mi lus rin chen gling phyin yang / /lus rten bzang la byur po che yi sems/ /thar pa bsgrub pa'i rten du mi rung zhing / /zhes/ mi lus byur po pa'am stong log mkhan zhes rang gi chos sgrub bsam pa'i nges shes yodarung 'phral rkyen gzhan dbang kho nar song nas chos yang dag pa 'grub pa'i skal pa med spuni 25

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrosilazlobyeridapa'abordo rjes ma/dzad/sngon gya las yan par thag bcad la bshade 'gyur ltar 'gyod sdom bya zhang ma 'ongs par smon lam bzang po gdab/ phral byung brgyad ni/ khyad par bdud kyis zin dang dug lnga 'khrugs/ /las ngan thog tu babs dang le 61sa g.yengs/ /gzhan khol bran g.yog 'jigs skyob chos ltar bcos//rmongs sogs phral byung rkyen gyi mi khoms brgyad/ /ces/ dang po/ chos rnam dag bsgrub 'dod kyi blo yod kyang bar du gcod pa'i bdud ni ci rigs su brdzu bas mtha' gcig tu ngos 'dzin dka' yang /gzhan rkyen bdud kyi grogs pos zin pa rgyal bu be+eḍūr+ya'i blo bdud blon rnams kyis pra 'phrul gyis bsgyur ba lta bu dang /bdud lhas spyin lta bu skye sngon bsam sbyor ngan pa'i smon lam log pa dang / dge slong legs skar lta bu chos la brtson 'grus bya ba'i dus dang /yon tan gyi 'bras bu thob khar bar chad du 'byung nye bas dran shes ldan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa/chags sdang gis mtshon dug lnga'i nyon mongs shin tu rags pa'i rigs can rnams ni/ chos sgrub 'dod kyi blo res 'ga' tsam skye yang / rang rgyud kyi dug lnga shugs che ba'i dbang gis chosayang dag mi 'grub padze+e byed myongagang rung gi las yin pas 'gyod sdom bya/ gsum pa/ las ngan gyi mtsho chen rdol ba zhes lus ngag rang dbang du mi 'gyur zhing rnam par g.yengs /phyi bdud dkar po'i phyogasasu mar+pā par gtogs pa sogs/ mchan//pa kho na'i dbang du shor ba'am/ yang na bshags sbyang sogs ci tsam 'bad kyang rang rgyud la yon tan mi skye ba ni dam tshig nyams chags sogs yin pas/ lam la the tshom mi byabar bshags sdom dang brtson 'grus bskyed de nyams su len/ bzhi pa/ spyir le lo ni bdud kyi las yin pasathos bsam sgom gsum gang la bar chad du gsungs te/ ji skad du/lelo can ni bdud kyi las yin no//brtson 'grus can la bdud rnams lhag par sdang / /zhes pa ltar khyad par du chos la brtson 'grus byed pa rnamasal le lo gsum gang rung gis bar chad 'byung 16

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam gsal byed/nges pa shesapasalelordogapasadzo/ lngadzo/ nezhanagyikholapo'am bran du gyur nga/ dag rang dbang dang bral bas chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i skal pa med pa ni nga rgyal gyi las 'bras yin pas dman sa 'dzin cing sngar byas la 'gyod pas bshags sdom bya/ drug pa/ tshe 'di'i nad gdon sogs 'jigs skyob kyi chos sgrub dgos byung na'ang gnod byed de nyid la dmigs pa'i byang chub sems kyi kun slong gis zin par bya ba dang / nad gdon sngon las su shes pas 'gyod sdom dang gtong len bya/bdun pa/ rnyed bkur dang snyan grags bsgrub pa'i phyir chos pa gzugs brnyan pa rnams ni gzhan snang du chos ltar bcos kyang rang ngos tshe 'di kho na don du gnyer nas thar pa'i lam dang bral ba yin pas nges 'byung dang skyo shas rtsal 'don/ brgyad pa/shin tu rmongs pa'i rigs can rnams ni chos sgor zhugs na'ang chos kyi tshig don phra mo yang shes mi nus te thos bsam byed pa'i skal pa dman pa ni sngar chos spang gi las bsags shing / smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar ma byas pa'i skyon yin pas sngar byas la 'gyod sdom dang slar bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs kyi bsnyen sgrub dang bzang po spyod pa sogs smon lam la 'bad/bdag la chos kyi 'gal zlar lhag pa'i tshe/ /blo sna— lam golྈ gnyis su za zhes bdag la chos kyi 'gal zla ste bar chad de dag zhi ba dang phyis mi 'byung bar khyed shes dad pas gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa'o/ / ris chad blo'i mi khoms pa brgyad ni/ skyo shas chung zhing dad pa'i nor dang bral/ /'dod sred zhags pas bcings dang kun spyod rtsub/ /mi dge sdig la mi 'dzem las mtha' log/sdom nga/ nyams shing dam tshig ral pa ste//ris chad blo yi mi khom rnam pa brgyad/ /ces/dang po ni/ spyir khamasagasum 'khor ba sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin yin pa dang / 'dus byas thams cad skad cig tsam yang rtag brtan med tshul sogs thos kyang skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi blo gtan nas mi skyes na chos rtsa ba 27

༄/ /rig 'dzin 'gro bolash+lau/ dīdapa' bo rdo rjes mdzad/nas rul bsayangadagapa'achosa'agrubat+pa'i r+shal pachad/ gnyas pa/ chos dang bla ma la kha zhe med pa'i dad pa snying nas med na bstan pa'i 'jug sgo 'gags te thar pa'i lam du mi tshud/gsum pa/'dod sred che ba'i rigs can grogs bu nor longs spyod gnyen 'dun sogs 'ching ba dam pos rang rgyud bcing ste de'i don du 'bad rtsol sogs kyis g.yengs pas chos byed pa'i long med/ bzhi pa/ rang rgyud la zhi dul sogs mi gzhi til 'bru tsam yang med pas kun spyod la skyed 'don med pa'i rigs can dag bshes gnyen dang 'phrad kyang dam pa'i lam la bsgyur dka'/ lnga pa/khrel dang ngo tsha med pas mi dge ba'i sdig la mi 'dzems shing sgo gsum nye bar ma zhi ba ni dam pa'i yon tan dang bral te chos la yid mi phyogs/ drug pa/ las kyi mtha' log lam du zhugs shing chos kyi snang ba med pa khyi'i sngon du rtsa bzhag pa ltar chos la rgyab 'gal/ bdun pa/ so thar gyi 'dul khrims dang byang sems kyi bslab pa nyams na ngan skung labasha'agro sa med pas mi khoms pa'i gnas las mi thar/brgyad pa/ gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas bla ma dang mched grogs sogs kyi dam tshig 'gal nyams byung na rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro bas dngos grub kyi skal pa chad pa ste brgyad po 'di ni chos la ring zhing thar pa'i sgron me nub pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar lugs 'di la dal ba'i rang bzhin chos nyi shu rtsa bzhi khyad par gyi 'byor pa bcu ste dal 'byor gyi rang bzhin chos sum cu rtsa bzhir gsungs pa ci yin snyam na/snying thig zab mo'i gdams pa 'di ni tshe lusagacig gam lo zla tsam gyis sangs rgyas pa'i lamazab mo yin pas lam gyi cha rkyen 'di dag nges par tshang los dgos/dper na yud tsam gyi kha skom sel byed du lam kha zhig nas tsha ja zhig bskol rgyu la mtshon na / skol rgyu'i ja de'i snod chu shing sogs mang po 'dzom dgos la/ me gcig pu 'bud thabs la'ang me cha me rdo spra ba lag pa'i 'du byed rnams ma tshang na me 'bud mi nus pa dang / gzhan 'dzom yang spra ba gcig po med na'ang ja bskol rgyu gtan 28

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / rtothar lam gsal byed/nas bsholadagosal/ lararangargyudalardokhrirgesi parabartags na dal 'byor bco brgyad tsam yang nges par chang dka' la/ dal ba las 'byor ba tshang min gong nas bshad pa ltar yin la/ khyad par du rgyal ba thabs la mkhas pas dus dang gdul bya'i khams dang bstun te gang 'dul gyi chos ston pas na/ deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ chos byed gzugs brnyan pa gdugs zhabs kyi bla ma/ ri khrod kyi chos pa/rgyal khams kyi bya btang sogs/ bzang por rloms pa mang du yod kyang phal cher mi khoms pa 'di dag gi dbang du song nas chos byed lo byas kyang yang dag pa'i lam du mi 'gro ba ni des lan pa yin gsungs/ de'i phyir dang po dal 'byor gyi chos 'di dag tshang ngam mi tshang legs par brtags/ tshang bar nadug na dga' ba sgom zhing slar dge blo gong 'phel la spro bzhin brtson te rten bzang 'di la brten nas tshe 'dir sangs rgyas pa zhig mi byed re snyam pa'i dam bca'i ri mo snying la bri/ mi tshang na sgo du ma nas tshang pa'i thabs la 'bad/ de ltar ma brtags na gong smos ltar chos brgyad kyis bsam pas kun nas bslang ba'i thos bsam dang gos sogs yon tan phran bu re la rlams nas phrag dog dang nga rgyal gyi dbang gis dge ba'i lo tog sad kyis khyer te yon tan rgyud la skye ba lta zhog /bstan pa'i bla btsong dkon mchog gi rkang 'dren yin pas rang skyon 'di shes par byas la/ skyon yul phud dgos gsungs/ci'i phyir snyam na bsgrub bya sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin mod/ de sgrub byed lam gyi cha rkyen rten 'brel thabs tshul du ma zhig la brten dgos pa ni mdo sngags zhal mthun cing dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar tshad mas kyang grub pa'o/ /bdag la chos kyi 'gal zlar lhag pa'i tshe/ blo sna— lam gol gnyis su— chos kyi 'gal zla mi khoms pa de dag gi dbang du mi 'gro zhing dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa zhig bla ma khyed mkhyen snyam pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs par bya'o/ /spyod 'jug las/ 'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas/ /bdag gis dge goms ma 29

༄/ /rega'adzina'agror+ṣasmu༈/ ñchadapa'abordorjes ma dzad/byas na/ /'dalasabaslusapagazhanamedardo/ /'idalasarmongs pa gzhan med do/ /zhes pa ltar/ da res kyi skye ba 'dir 'dun pa gtan legs dang gtan nyes kyi so mtshams yin pas tshe 'dir btsan sa zin pa zhig cis kyang 'bad dgos snyam du sbyor ba sems bskyed dngos gzhi dmigs med 'jug bsngo ba ste dam pa gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas nyams su blang ngo //dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba'i khrid kyi rim pa'o/ /garkis pa tshe mi rtag par bstan pa'i khrid la bdun/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten/ nang bcud kyi sems can/ dam pa'i skyes bu/ skye rgu'i bdag po/ dpe don sna tshogs/'chi rkyen nges med/'dun pa drag po la bsam nas mi rtag pa sgom pa'o/ /da lta nad dang sdug bsngal gyis ma gzir//bran khol la sogs gzhan dbang ma gyur pas/ /rang dbang thob pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs dus 'dir/ /snyoms lasangang du dal 'byor chud gson na/ /zhes/ da lta yud tsam 'di la lus 'byung 'khrugs nad kyis ma zin/ chos nyan bsam la bar tu gcod pa'i sems sdug bsngal gyis ni ma gzir/ bran g.yog sogs gzhan dbang du ni ma gyur/ gos lhag skyob tsam dang zas thabs chag tsam gyi 'byor ba ni rang la yod/ med kyang gzhan la btsal na'ang nyung zad re nges par rnyed/bla ma dam pas brtse bas rjes su bzung ba'i dus 'dir/ o rgyan rin po ches/ da res phun tshogs rkyen kun 'byor dusa'adir/ brtson 'grus drag pos srid las 'da' bar mdzod/ /ces pa ltar/ chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sna tshogs kyi rten 'brel 'di 'dra ni nam yang bsgrigs kyang 'grigs dka'/ da ni le lo snyom las kyi dbang du skad cig tsam la'ang mi btang / sgeg me'i mgo la me shor ba'am/ sdar ma'i pang du sprul zhugs pa lta bu'i sgo nas snying po myur du len ma nusan dal 'byor yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu 'di rnyed pa ni dka' yang myur du 'jig pa'i chos can yin pas sang byed gnang byed kyi phyi bgol du ma shor bar 'phral 'phral du brtson dgos te/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ de ltar rnyed 30

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / rdothar lam gsal byed/dka'i dal ba thobagyurakyang/ /skadacagadzārteg 'gyuraba'i chos can te/ /rnam par brtags na snyi nga po 'ga' med pas//lha ba rdos 'dra yid rton mi rung bas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu nges par 'chi ba soms//zhes pa ltar/dang po phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la bsam nas mi rtag nga sgom pa ni/'di ltar 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las grub pa'i phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa sra zhing 'thas pa bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa 'di dag kyang mthar me bdun chu gcig gis 'jig cing mi rtag par 'gyur ba can yin te/ de nyid las/ snod bcud mi rtag srid pa chags 'jig gis//me bdun chu gcig rlung gis gtor ba'i tshe/ /khor yug rin chen gling dang ris bskor ba'i//lhun po rin chen gzhi yang mi rtag cing / /thams cad nam mkha' gcig tu 'gyur ba'i skabs//nges par soms la snying nas chos mdzod cig /ces so/ /gnyis pa/ nang bcud kyi sems can mi rtag pa sgom pa ni/ 'di ltar srid pa'i rtse mo nas dmyal ba'i gnas yan chad na sems can yod do cog 'chi ba'i gan/sa las thar ba ni gcig kyang med la/ dper na sa steng gi 'gro ba mi la mtshon na/ de ring nyi ma 'di yan chod mi lo brgya'i gong rol nas skyes pa'i 'dzam bu gling gi mi mchog dman bar ma brtsi ba'i tshad las 'das pa zhig byung ba yang da lta ming gi lhag ma tsam las gcig kyang med/ sngon las sam tshe sgrub pa'i thabs kyis brgya lhag re thub pa tsam ni ma gtogs so/ /de bzhin du de ring nas skyes ba'i byis pa tshun chad lo brgya song dus na yang de ltar du 'gyur nges te/ spring yig las/ sa'am 'on te mtho ris na/ /la la skyes nas ma shi ba/ /'ga' zhig khyod kyis mthong ba'am/ /thos sam 'on te the tshom za/ /zhes so / / gsum pa/ dam pa'i skyes bu la bsam nas mi rtag pa sgom pa ni/ 'di ltar da lta'i bskal pa bzang po 'di la sngon byon sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sogs rab bdun dang / da lta'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa rnams 'khor nyan thos dang byang 31

sgo/ /rigalona'agrobolapy-ihūṃdapa'abordorjes ma dzad/chub sems dpa'atshogasadapagatumedabam̐dange bcas byon nas theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor te gdul bya'i sems can dpag tu med pa rnam grol la bkod par mdzad pa de dag gi bsod nams brgya las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sku yang mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa dang / de bzhin du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bka'i bsdu ba mdzad pa'i dgra bcom chen po lnga brgya/ gzhan 'das rjes thob pa'i paṇa chen rnam bzhi/mchog gi rig 'dzin chen po brgyad/'dzam bu gling gi rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor brgyad cu/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas smin grol gyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i skabs su rje 'bangs grub chen nyer lnga/ yer ba'i grub chen brgyad cu sogs dang / phyis su'ang / rnying ma'i so zur gnub gsum/ gsar ma'i mar mi dwags gsum sogs mkhas shing grub pha bzhes pa'i skyes bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon cing /de dag phal cher thog bcasatre thog med du byed pa sogs rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston nus pa/'byung ba bzhi la rang dbang bsgyur pa sogs sa gsum na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba rnam thar sna re thos pas grol ba de dag kyang mthar mi rtag pa'i tshul bstan te da lta de lta bu'o zhes pa tsam las mi bzhugs te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ ci ste sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i/ /rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu shing snying po med 'dra ba'i/ /lus can rnams la smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa ltar rang re sdug bden gyitshophung po zag pa dang bcas pa 'di ci'i phyir rtag bzhi nga / skye rgu'i bdag po la bsam nas mi rtag pa sgom pa ni/'di ltar skye rgu'i bdag po tshangs pa la sogs stobs dang gzi brjid dang ldan pa rnams dang gzhan yang lha dang mi yi drang sgong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul gyi nam mkhar 'gro nus pa rnams dang /stobs dang 'byor pas mngon par 32

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / rtse thar lam/ gsal byed/mtho ba' 'khoralosasgyuraba'argyalapotsherdoparnams dang / rgya gar shar nub gya rgyal po mnga' thang stobs 'byor rgyas pa du ma dang / bod 'dir yang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa chos rgyal chen po rim gyis byon pa rnams kyang da lta de lta bu byon no zhes pa'i lo rgyus tsam las med pa ni/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ tshangs dbang bde 'byung 'khor los sgyur rnams kyang / /'chi bdag bdud las bzur ba'i thabs ma mchis/ /zhes so//rang re nyams chung dbul phongs 'bu srin lta bu rnams mi rtag pa lta ci smos/ lnga pa/ dpe don sna tshogs la bsam nas mi rtag pa sgom pa ni / spyir skye 'gro kun gyi tshe lo dang bskal ba'i 'phel 'grib/ bye brag nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog /nyin dang mtshan dang chu tshod tsam yang skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur ba can las rtag pa dang brtan pa ni gcig kyang med la/ de bzhin du 'gro ba'i lam mi rtag /sdod pa'i gnas mi rtag /bza' ba'i zas mi rtag /bgo ba'i gos mi rtag /'grogs pa'i gnyen mi rtag /bsam pa'i sems mi rtag /skyid sdug gi snang ba mi rtag ste/ o rgyan chen pos/ na ning da lo'i nam zla'i stod smad dang //zhag dang nyin mtshan skad cig dus mi rtag /ces dang / sgyu ma smig rgyu rmi lam gzugs brnyan dang / /dri za'i grong khyer brag cha lta bur spyod/ /chu zla chu bur mig yor sprul nga/ sogs/ /shes bya sgyu ma'i dpe bcu de bzhin du/ /'khor 'das chos rnams de ltar shes par gyis/ /zhes so/ /drug pa/ 'chi rkyen nges med la bsam nas mi rtag pa sgom pa ni/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad skye ba tsam nas 'chi ba'i rang bzhin can yin pa shes rung /'chi lugs dang 'chi rkyen dang 'chi ba'i dus tshod/ nam 'chi dang der 'chi dang / 'di ltar 'chi ba ni sus kyang shes dka' ste/spyod 'jug las/de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes//bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /zhes rbedu/ /'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang zhing 'tsho ba'i rkyen nyung la/ slob dpon ār+ya de bas/ 'chi 33

༄/ /rig 'dzin 'gro bola~X/ ༵dpa' bo rdo rjes ma rdzad/ba'i rkyen nashanatumang/ /'tshoba'irkyenargani lhan tu nyung / /de yang 'chi ba' rkyen du 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ nad dang / gdon dang / me dang / chu dang / dug dang /mtshon dang / g.yang sa dang / mi rgod dug sbrul gcan gzan sogs glo bur ye 'grogs kyis 'chi ba'i rkyen mang / gzhan 'tsho ba'i rkyen du rloms pa'i zas dang gos la sogs pa'ang 'chi rkyen du 'gyur ba yod/ de bzhin du 'jig rten tshe 'di'i ched du mi bya ba ni gcig kyang med de/ sto gos don gnyer/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong /tshong dang so nam/ 'dod pa sogs kyi ched du pha ro bus mi mthong / bu ro phas mi mthong bar 'chi ba'ang yod/ dus tshod kyang nyin mtshan chu tshod 'di lta bu la 'chi zhes tshad bzung mi shes/ 'jig rten 'di'i 'dun phug gi ring thung la nges pa med pas blo sna rbad kyis bstung dgos so/ /bdun pa/ 'dun pa drag ngo/ la bsam nas mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ dus rtag tu 'gro 'dug sogs bya ba gang byas kyang 'di ni spyod lam gyi tha ma yin no zhes ngag gis brjod cing sems la dud de bsgom par bya ste/mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ tshe 'di gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi//chu yi chu bur las kyang mi rtag na/ /dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyi log pa las/ /sad khoms gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ /zhes pa ltar gnas gzhan du 'gro na'ang der 'chi'am tshur e sleb cha med snyam pa dang / lam bar gyi ngal stegs lta bu la sdod na 'dir 'chi'am snyam pa'i blo sbyangs/ mtshan mo nyal ba'i dus kyang sang nyi ma shar ba dang tshe phyi ma'i snang ba shar rgyu gnyis gang snga snyam pa dang / nam langs pa'i dus su'ang de ring nyin gang 'di la 'chi'am/ do nub slar nyal ba'i nges pa med do snyam pa sogs spyod lam kun tu dran shes dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas blo sbyang / mdo las/ sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ /sngon du gang 'ong gtol med pas/ /sang gi chis la ma 'bad par/ /phyi ma'i don la 'bad par rigs/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/thams cad bor te cha dgos par/ /bdag gis de ltar ma shes pas/ /zhes pa 34

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam gsal byed/ltar / spyar lus semasakyatshogasang/martagapasmri g.yarapobadag tu ma 'dzin/ 'gro ba'i lam mi rtag pas gom pa chos phyogs su 'dor/'dug na gnas mal mi rtag pas zhing khams yid la byos/ bza' btung dang longs spyod mi rtag pas ting nge 'dzin gyi zas za/nyal na gnyid mi rtag pas zhabrul ba 'od gsal du sbyongs/ /'byor ba'i nor rdzas mi rtag pas 'phags pa'i nor bdun bsnyen/ gnyen grogs dang srid sde mi rtag pas dben par nges 'byung la bskul/che btsan dang snyan grags mi rtag pas rtag tu dman sa bzung / smra ba'i tshig mi rtag pas bzlas brjod dang kha ton la rems/ dad pa dang nges 'byung mi rtag nga/sa dam bca' brtan por brtson/ 'du shes dang rnam rtog mi rtag pas mi gzhi bzang por bslab/ nyams dang rtogs pa mi rtag pas chos nyid zad sar skyol dang / de'i dus su skye 'chi'i bar lag 'gyel/'chi brod kyi gding tshad rnyed/ 'chi med kyi btsan sa zin/ bya rgod pos gnam 'phang chod pa dang 'dra bas 'chi ba 'ong snyam pa'i yi mug de sangs ba'i dus la ma thug gi bar du thabs du ma'i sgo nas bsgom dgos gsungs/rje mi las/nga 'chi bas 'jigs nas ri la phyin/ /nam 'chi cha med bsgom bsgom pas/ /da 'chi med gnyug ma'i don rtogs nas/ /'chi ba ngang gis brjed nas thal/ zhes so/ /de ltar gnad du dril nas nyams su len pa la/ gong gi phyi snod nang bcud dam pa'i skyes bu skye rgu'i bdag po dpe don sna tshogs te sa bcad lngar gsungs pa'i don/nges par 'chi ba thag chod par bya ba dang / nam 'chi cha med kyi zhar la 'chi rkyen nges med bstan pa dang / 'dun pa drag po la bsam pas tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad la snying po med par sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur shes pas thag gcad/ nges par 'chi ba tsam shes pas mi chog nam 'chi cha med dpa'achi rkyen nges med kyi 'du shes rgyud la skyes nges zhig med na rtag 'dzin 'di snang gi re dogs chod pa'i dus med/chos kyi mtha' 'byol dka' ste/ o rgyan chen pos/ yun thung tshe yi phyed cha gtirtsomug gnyid/ phyed kyang 35

༄/ /rigalona'agro5lan+ḍi/ tram̐dapa'abordorjes ma/dzad/sum gnyasarnamagayengasa'adu' 'alaṅge/ 4 tre/5phyedachagacag la'ang bar chad rkyen dbang mang / /de phyir 'du byed mi rtag sprin ltar g.yo/ /zhes so/ /nges par 'chi ba rgyud la skyes na dang po chos la bskul ba'i rgyu bya/nam 'chi cha med dang 'chi rkyen nges med rgyud la skyes na bar du chos la brtson pa'i grogs byed/ tshe 'di'i bya ba gang la'ang don med par thag chod na chos mthar phyin pa'i rkyen bya zhes rje bla ma dam nga/'i zhal nas gsungs so/ /tshe 'di'i byas pa thams cad don med par dmigs bsal du bstan pa ni/ 'khor dang longs spyod nye du 'brel pa lta/ /lta ci gces par bzung pa'i lusa'adi yang //malagyi nanganas saphyogasastong par bskyal//wa dang bya rgod khyi yis 'drad pa'i dus/ /zhes/ dpal sbyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las / pha ma sbun zla bu dang chung ma dang / /bran g.yog nor dang rtsa lag rnams kyi tshogs/ /shi ba'i phyi bzhin de dag 'gro ba med/ ces pa ltar rang gis bsog pa'i nor rdzas 'grogs pa'i gza' mi nye 'brel thams cad cham gyis shul du lhag nas 'gro ba ni mi zhes pa 'di la bsam pa'i sems/ blta ba'i mig /nyan pa'i rna ba yod na kun gyi mthong chos su yod pa 'a di la bsam nas rang gis rang la gros 'debs 'os/ ji skad du/ dka' ba mngalposabasgrub pa yi/ zas dang skom gyis bskyangs pa'i lus/ /rang dang mi 'grogs bya khyis za/ /yang na 'bar ba'i me yis tshig /yang na chu yi nang du 'brul/ /yang na sa yi dong du spa/ zhes pa ltar/ rang re rnams 'chi ba'i nad kyis theb nas yun ring byas te 'chi ba'i dbang du byas na/ lus kyi stobs shor bas tsog pur sdod mi nus/ byad kyi bkrag nyams/ tshor ba sdug bsngal te na tsha la sdod tshugs pa'i thabs ni med/sman dpyad dang rim gro gang gis kyang mi phan dus 'chi ba ni shes kyang bya thabs ni med/ nye 'brel gza' tsho sogs 'grogs pa'i tha mas ni bskor/ zas kyi tha ma ni za/gtam gyi tha ma kha chems ni zlo zhing /dbugs chad pa na gces pa'i bu chung gcig pu'i ro yin kyang 'jigs pa dang skyug 36

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khred yeg / rtse thar larma gsal byed/bro ba'i gnasasugyurate/ zhagakhashasanasdu ri le bskyal/ bya khya gcan gzan/ gyas za ba'am/ yang nas mer bsreg /yang na chur bskyur/yang nas zhabs su spa ba sogs/don sa'am rdo ba ltar gyur nas bdag tu bzung ba lta ci/ mdo las/ bdag ni gdon mi za bar mi 'gyur te/ /shi nas gzhan gyi gtam du 'gyur te 'ong / /zhes pa ltar ro bsregs shul lam/ ro khang ngam/ khyi dang gcan gzan gyis zos pa'i rus pa dang skra 'thor ba'am sha la sogs bya khyis khyer ba gzhan gyis mthong ba na 'di ni che ge mo shi ba red 'di lta bu a tsa ma zer nas gleng rgyu las med pa ni rang re lus zhes pa'i gces 'dzen can 'di'i 'dun phug go/bar de'i yul na 'jigs pa shin tu che/ /blo sna lam rgolaḥ gnyis su— zhes/ de ltar 'brul snang rtag 'dzin carma/ gyi sems rnam par shes pa 'di nyid kyi 'dun phug la bsam na/mar dkyil nas spu bton pa ltar phyi ma'i lam la skye ser gyi rlung dang 'grogs te gcer bu lag stong mchan du bcug nas 'gro ba ni/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ dus kyis nyen te rgyal po 'gro gyur na//longs spyod rdzas dang nye du rjes mi 'brang / /skyes bu de ni gar gnas gar 'gro yang / /las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang / /zhes pa ltar/ zhes pa ltar/tshe 'di'i snang ba thams cad rmi lam bdo 'phro la sad pa ltar cham gyi shul du lhag /las gang byas kyi rjes su rnam shes ni 'brang / bzod thabs med pa'i sdug bsngal ni rang gcig pu'i nyams su myong / su la'ang bgo bya ni med/ 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ya nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum/ nges pa dang ma nges pa'i rtags drug sogs 'jigs skrag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bar de'i 'phrang ring la gcar nas 'gro dgos/ rang re da lta'i tshe mjug sprin bar gyi nyi ma lta bu 'di la blo sna rbad kyis bstungs te phyi ma'i 'gro chus tshags su tshud pa zhig gal che'o/ /'chi ba mi rtag pa'i khrid kyi rim pa'o/ /gsum pa las rgyu 'bras kyi khrid bstan pa'i rim pa ni/ dge sdig las kyi rnam smin phyi bzhin 'brang / zhes/ spang bya mi dge 37

༄/ /rega'ajina'agrolpol py-ik+todapa'abordorjes mdzad/ba' las 'bras/ bsgrubabyadageba'alabazlo'abres/ thamasacad las kya rang bzhin du bstan pa dang gsum/ 'di ltar 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug thams cad kun slong dge sdig gi las byas tshab che chung dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu de ltar 'byung ba yin ste / phal po che'i mdo las byang chub sems dpa/'a kun tu bzang pos/ ji ltar sa bon khyad par gyis/ /'bras bu sna tshogs snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin las kyi khyad par gyis/ /sems can rnams dang zhing 'byung ngo / /zhes pa ltar/ sa bon kha ba la 'bras bu kha ba/ sa bon mngar ba la 'brasabu mngar ba las rgyu dang 'bras bu go log tu mi 'byung / mdo las/ me ni grang bar 'gyur yang srid/ /rlung ni zhags pas zin yang srid/ /nyi zla thang la lhung yang srid/ /las kyi rnam smin bslu mi srid/ /ces pa ltar/ dang po/ spang bya mi dge ba'i rgyu 'bras bshad par bya ste/ rgyu dug gsum gyis kun nas bslang ba'i ladrangami dge ba zhes 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba yin la/rin chen phreng ba las/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/des bskyed las ni mi dge ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ sdig pa'i las ngos bzung ba/ lci yang gi khyad par bstan pa'o/ /dang po/ mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga/ lci ba bzhi/ log pa brgyad do/ /dang po ni lus kyi gsum/ ngag gi bzhi/ yid kyi gsum mo/ /lus kyi las srog gcod pa/ ma byin len pa/ mi tshangs spyod pa'am/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa /rab byung ba yin na mchan khyim pa dge bsnyen yin na/ martan//dang gsum/ngag gi las rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag bkyal dang bzhi/ yid kyi las brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta dang gsum ste bcu'o/ /delas dang po srog gcod pa la'ang yul pha rol po mi'am dud 'gro sogs gzhi sems can gang yin gzhan dang ma nor pa der shes pa/ de 'di ltar gsod dgos bsam pa/ gsod byed kyi sbyor ba lag tu len pa/ mthar pha rol po'i srog gi dbang po 'gag pa ste yan lag 38

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / rtse thar larme gsal byed/bzha ka tshang ba nirabatulcal/dela'angabyasari zhing bsags pa dang / ma byas shang bsags nga/ gnyis yod/ dang po/ pha rol gyi dgra zla lta bu zhe sdang gi sgo nas srog gcod pa dang /ri dwags dang g.yung dwags lta bu'i sha za 'dod dang lpags pa gyon 'dod sogs 'dod chags kyi sgo nas srog gcod pa dang / rgyu 'bras kyi gnas ji bzhin mi shes pas gti mug gi sgo nas srog gcod pa ste dug gsum gang rung gi kun nas bslang bas rang gis dngos su gsod pa dang / gnyis pa gzhan la gsod du bcug pa/gsod pa la rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /༈gzhan 'og ma rnams la'ang de'i rigs 'gres/ mawo/1'bras bu ni spyir mi dge ba bcu po re re bzhin/rnam smin gyi 'bras bu / rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ dbang gi 'bras bu/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu dang bzhi re yod la/ dang po rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni kun slong gi khyad par gsum/ zhe sdang gis dmyal ba/ 'dod chags kyis yi dwags/ gti mug gis dud 'gror skye zhing rang rang gi sdug bsngal la spyod dgos par gsung / yang na kun slong chen po zhes bya ba chags sdang rmongs gsum shin tu tshab che ba dang rgyun ring bo'i sno nas las bsags na dmyal ba dang /'bring gis yi dwags/chung dus dud 'gro skye bar gsungs/gnyis pa rgyu mthun ni rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ngan song gi gnas nas thar te lus rten gzhan thob pa'i dus myong ba yin/ de la'ang byed myong gnyis/ dang po byed pa rgyu mthun ni byed las dang mthun pa ste/ srog gcod kyi rgyu mthun mi la mtshon na byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas srog gcod la dga' zhing sdig pa'i las thabs la mkhas pa dang / dud 'gro rnams la yang khra dang spyang ska sogs gsod pa la dga' ba rnams so / gnyis pa myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ dper na byis pa chung ngu skyesam thag 'chi ba dang / de dag skye ba mang por lan grangs du mar skyes tsam nas 'chi ba'o/ /yang na gzhen nu'i dus kho na la 'chi ba shas che/ yang bu rgyud shi ba'i rjes su pha ma sdug bsngal ba ni 39

zhu/ /rega'adzina'agrosilarto/ rihūṃdapa'abordorjes ma dzad/skye sngon srog gcod kyi lan chags rang la 'khor ba yan/ de bzhan du chung ngu nas nad sna tshogs kyis gdung zhing skyes nas 'chi la thug gi bar du sman dpyad sogs gang gis kyang mi phan pa de dag sngar sems can brdung brdeg byas pa'i rgyu mthun yin par gsungs so/ /gsum pa dbang gi 'bras bu ni yul la smin pa ste/ sa phyogs nyams mi dga' zhing / ngam grogs dang g.yang sa can sogs srog la gnod pa can gyi yul du skye'o/ /lus kyi las gnyis pa ma byin len pa la/ dbang gis len pa/'jab bus len pa/ g.yo rgyus len pa gsum/ dang po ni rgyal po lta bu'i thob thang gi gzhung khral ma yin par btsan btsugs byas nas 'phrog pa'am/ dmag sogs dpung shed kyi sgo nas dngos su 'phrog bcom byed pa lta bu ni dbang gis len nga 'am/stobs kyis len pa zhes bya/gnyis pa rkun ma lta bu'i bdag pos mi mthong sar lkog nas dngos rdzas blangs te bdag gir byas pa/ gsum pa tshong sogs kyi skabs pha rol po bslu sems kyis rdzun dang / bre log dang / srang log 'dzug pa sogs kyi sgo nas gzhan gyi rgyu rdzas blangs pa'o/ /byed pa rgyu mthun chung nas rku ba la dga' zhing rku thabs la mkhas pa dang / byi ba sogs dud 'gro'i nang na'ang rku ba la dga' ba lta bu'o/ /myong ba rgyu mthun ni gang du skyes kyang longs spyod dbul ba dang / gal te longs spyod cung zad re yod na'ang dgra zla dang thun/ mong du gyur ba rnams so/ /dbang 'bras ni lo tog la sad ser sdang ba dang ljon shing la 'bras bu mi chags/ mu ge yod pa'i yul du skye'o/ /gsum pa tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa blangs zin nas mi tshangs spyod pa gtan khrims yin pa dang /khyim pa yin na 'dod pas log par g.yem pa ste/ de'i nyes pa che shos gzhan gyi sdom pa gtong ba'i rkyen byas pa dang / rang gi khu ba byung nas gaska gyi bdagatu bzung ba dang / gla rngan sprad tshar ba dang /rang dbang yin kyang nyin mo dang / bsnyen gnas bsrung ba'i dus dang /na ba dang / sbrum ma dang / mya ngan gyisanon nga dang / zla mtshan 40

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig ༄ tharalam/gsal byed/yod pa dang / bang ma sangs pa dang / dkan mchag ga rten yod sar bsgrod nga/ dang /pha ma dang rigs kyi bsrung ba dang / ma smin pa'i gzhon nu ma dang / kha dang gshang lam la sogs par bsgrod pa ste/ log g.yem gyi rnam pa tha dad pa nyams su myong ba'o/ /byed nga/ rgyu mthun ni/ khyim bya de pho dang / ngang ba/ phug ron/ rta gseb/bong ring sogs/ 'dod chags che ba'i rigs su skye la/ myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ khyim thabs mi mdzes shing /lcod pa can dang /gza' tsho nang mi mthun pa 'byung / dbang 'bras ni/ bshang gci dang 'dam rdzab la sogs pa yid du mi 'ong ba'i gnas su skye'o/ /ngag gi las la bzhi las/ dang po/ rdzun la phal pa/ chen po/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun dang gsum/dang po gzhan bslu ba'i bsam nga/ can gyi rang bzhin rdzun du smra ba thams cad/ gnyis pa dge sdig gnyisaka'i 'bras bu bde sdug mi bden zhes rgyu 'bras med par smra ba/ gsum pa rang ma grub pa la grub rdzu/ mi shes pa la shes rdzu la sogs yon tan med pa la yod tshul smra ba'o/ /'di dag re re nas/ gzhi/ bsam pa/ sbyor ba/ mthar thug ste yan lag bzhi po kun la /lus ngag gi mi dge bdun po/ mchan// 'gresaso/ /byed pa rgyu mthun ni byed las dang mthun pa kun la khyad med/ myong ba rgyusprathun ni ma nyes kyang gzhan gyis skur 'debs mang ba/nam yang gzhan gyis bslu bar byed pa/ /'og ma rnams la 'gres so / / mchan//dbang 'bras ni/ 'byor ba mi brtan cing rtag tu shes pa rtab sdar ma cing skrag pa'i yul rkyen dang 'phrad pa rnams so//gnyis pa phra ma la/ mngon phra dang lkog phra gnyis yod/dang po mi dbang che ba rnams kyis dngos su phan tshun la phra ma mjug pa/ gnyis pa mi yid mthun su yang rung ste lkog nas phra ma ste dbyen gyi sgo nas so sor mi mthun pa byas pa'o//byed pa rgyu mthun ni gong ltar/ myong ba rgyu mthun 'khor g.yog mi mthun pa dang rang la gzhan gyis don med par rgol ba sogs 'byung / dbang 'bras/ yul ngam grogs dang gcong rong can la soga.oṃlam bsgrod 4/

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrosilaṇ+ḍaṃdzo/zhudapa'abordorjes rme dzad/dka' sar gnasache(/ /gsumapa/ tshigartsub ni/ gzhanagazugs ma mdzes pa lta bu la de'i skyon dngos su brjod de ci gnod kyi tshig rtsub mor smra ste zhe sha gcod pa'o//byed pa rgyu mthun ni gong ltar/ myong ba rgyu mthun rtag tu mi snyan pa thos shing rang gi smras pa yang 'thab mo'i tshig tu 'gyur/ lar tshig rtsub ni ngag gi las rnams las nyes pa lci shos yin/ dbang 'bras ni/ yul rdo gseg dang tsher ma can la sogs sa phyogs yid mi bde sar skye'o//bzhi pa/ ngag bkyal ni/ bram za'i gsang tshigs sogs chos ma yin pa chos su sems pa dang /smad 'tshong ma'i gtam/ chags sems kyi glu/ dmag dang chom rkun sogs chags sdang skye ba'i gtam 'brel med du smra ba ste mdor na dge sbyor g.yengs pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i ngag 'khyal sna tshogs su smra ba rnams yin la/ legs par brtags na chags sdang gi kun nas bslang ba shasache bas rang gzhan gyi rgyud la chagasasdang ci tsam slong ba de tsam du nyes pa che'o//gzhan yang kha ton dang bzlas brjod la sogs pa'i skabs su ngag 'khyal dang 'dres nas ci tsam 'don zlos byas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byin pa sogs skyon shin tu che'o/ /byed pa rgyu mthun ni gong ltar/ myong ba rgyu mthun ni rang gi tshig mi btsun/drang por smras kyang gzhan gyis bden par mi 'dzin/ mang po'i nang nas gtam smra ba la spobs pa chung ba sogs 'byung / dbang 'bras lo tog la so nam byas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung / dus tshigs log cing mi brtan sar skye/ yid kyi las gsum gyi dang po/brnab sems ni/ gzhan la rgyu rdzas yid du 'ong ba zhig yod na de nga la yod na ci ma rung snyam du yang nas yang du yid kyis bdag gir byas nas/ de rang gi thob thabs ci lta bu yod snyam pa sogs so/ /byed pa rgyu mthun ni gong ltar/ myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ yid la bsam pa mi 'grub cing mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab/ dbang 'bras ni/ lo tog nyesashing gnas dus ngan pa'i sdug bsngal mang du 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa gnod sems ni/ gzhan la zhe sdang dang 42
