༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / rtse thar lam/ gsal byed/phrag dog ga dbangagasapharolapoblosabortong nes 'ad la gnod pa 'di dang 'ad lta bu byed thabs byung na ci ma rung snya/ma pa dang / dpal 'byor dang yon tan yod pa la mi dga' zhing 'di 'di tsam du ma 'byor zhing ma bzang na snyam pa dang /de la mi 'dod pa byung na dga' ba sogs ni gnod sems so/ /byed pa rgyu mthun gong ltar/myong ba rgyu mthun ni 'jigs shing skrag pa dang 'tshe ba mang / dbang 'bras/ rtag tu 'jigs pa dang 'tshe ba 'ong ba'i yul du skye/ gsum pa log lta ni/ rgyu 'bras med par lta ba dang / rtag chad du lta ba ste gnyis/ dang po ni go sla/ gnyis pa ni mu stegs pa ste de la spyir lta log sum brgya drug cu/ lta ngan drug cu rtsa gnyis sogs su dbye yang /bsdu/ na rtag chad gnyis la 'du/de la dang po rtag par lta ba la'ang /bdag rtag par lta ba dang / 'jig rten gyi byed po dbang phyug dang khyab mjug la sogs pa rtag par 'dod/ gnyis pa chad par lta ba ni/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid nas byung bar 'dod pas tshe snga phyi las rgyu 'bras/ thar pa dang grol ba la sogs pa med par 'dod pa dang / 'jig rten du bde sdug dang legs nyes sna tshogs su snang ba yang ngo bo nyid kyis de ltar byung ba yin gyi/ sngon gyi las dang / tshe snga ma dang skye ba phyi ma la sogs pa ni med do zhes 'dod/ de dag gi gzhung la bden par bzung nas de'i rjes su zhugs pa'am min kyang / rgyal ba'i bka'/ bla ma'i lung / mkhas pa'i gzhung gang la yang bshad tshod las mi bden no snyam du the tshom dang sgro skur byas pa thams cad log lta yin par gsung / byed pa rgyu mthun ni gong ltar/ myong ba rgyu mthun ni lta ba ngan pa la gnas/ dbang 'bras ni 'byor ba nyung zhing skyabs dang dpung gnyen med sar skye/de yang ngo bo'i sgo nas lci yang ni/yid kyi las gsum ga lci/ khyad par du log lta lci la/ lusakyi las gsum gyi dang po lci/ srog gcod gong na sdig gzhan med/ /mi dge bcu la log lta lci/ /zhes so/ /ngag gi las bzhi la tshig rtsub lci bar gsungs/ mi dge ba'i las lam bcu po 'di dgagi byas 43

༄/ /rigalona'agroswalabyeXdapa'abordorjes ma dzad/tshab che chung dang/ byebragaramapara'oganame8 bshada'agyur ltar yul dang bsam pa dus kyi khyad par ni kun la shes dgos so/ /rtsa ba'i bzhi pa/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu ni las gang byas pa de mngon par 'phel te skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du sdug bsngal mu mtha' med par kha brgyud nas/ slar yang las ngan gong nas gong du 'phel te 'khor bar 'khyams pa'o/ /gnyis pa mtshams med pa lnga ni/ pha dang ma dang dgra bcom bsad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ngan sems kyis khrag 'byen pa/ dge 'dun 'khor lo'i dbyen dang lnga'o/ /da lta pod 'dir phyi ma gsum yul ma tshang bas de dag dngos su mi 'byung yang / tshe rabs nas byas pa grangs kyis mi chod/ gsum pa de dang nye ba lnga ni/ pha gsod pa dang nye ba byang chub sems dpa' gsod pa/ ma gsod pa dang nye ba tshangs spyod ma'i sdom pa dbang med du phrogs pa/dgra bcom gsod pa dang nye ba slob pa gsod pa/dbyen byed pa dang nye ba dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo phrogasapa/rgyal ba'i sku la khrag 'byin pa dang nye ba mchod rten bshig pa ste lnga'o/ /de dag la sdig pa'i yan lag bzhi ga tshang na mtshams med du 'gyur la ma tshang na mi 'gyur zhes/ārla de was/dge slong rang gi sku rgan la//myur 'dongs zhesani bskul gyur nas//phul bas de ni shi gyur kyang / /mtshamasamed 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa lci ba bzhi la/ dbye na bcu drug ste/ dang po bkur ba'i lci ba bzhi ni/ mkhas pa'i gral gong / dge slong ngam sgom chen gyi phyag /sgrub pa pe'i zas/sngagasapa'i nor dang bzhi/ nyams pa'i lci ba bzhi ni/ mi chos kyi mna'azos pa/ nyan thos kyi 'dul khrims )mas pa/ byang sems kyi bslab pa nyams pa/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang bzhi/ smod pa'i lci ba bzhi ni/ gti mug gi dbang gis 'phags pa'i sku la smod pa/nga rgyal gyi dbang gis bden pa'i tshig la smod pa/ phrag dog gi dbang gis grogs kyi yon tan la smod pa/ phyogs ris kyi dbang gis lha 44

༄༅/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig sna rtethar lam gsal byed/la blang dorabyedapa'o/ /logapa'ilcibabazhoni/byumanyam nyid don la khyad 'don lca//yang dag don la 'gal 'jug lci/ /mtshams med lnga la khrag 'byin lci/ /mi dge bcu la log lta'i lci/ /de dag kyang yul bsam pa dus kyi khyad par gyis 'bras bu ngan song dang / byed myong gnyis sogs 'byung ba ni gong dang 'dra la/ lnga pa log pa brgyad ni/ dkar nag phyogs la smad dang bstod/ /dge ba can gyi thugs dkrugs dang / /dad pa can gyi tshogs bcag dang //bla ma lha dang rma ched lcam spangs//dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dral dang brgyad/ /'di dag log pa brgyad du gsungs//zhes so//de dag kyang nyes pa shin tu che'o/ /de ltar sdig mi dge ba'i las 'di dag tshor ba dang ma tshor ba'i sgo nas lus rten 'di la rang gi byas pa la byas shing bsags pa/ ma byas shing bsags pa ni gzhan la byed du bcug pa dang byed pa la rjes su yi rang gnyis la sdig pa'i yan lag tshang ma tshang gi khyad par tsam las don la khyad med/ tshe 'dir byas pa med rung tshe rabs nas byas pa grangs kyis mi chod/ de dag sngar byas la 'gyod pa drag po dang / phyin chad mi bgyid snyam pa'i dam bca'/ de ltar rgyu mi dge ba'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal dang / khyad par zhe sdang gis kun nas bslang ba'i las kyi rnam smin dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ khyad par dmyal ba'i 'jig rten nyid son na/ /zhes/ de la gnyis/ dang po tsha dmyal la'ang brgyad yod de/ mdzod las/'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na/ /mnar med pa'o de tsam mo/ /de yi steng na dmyal ba bdun//zhes pa ltar/'dzam bu gling 'di'i 'og tu nga/pag tshad stong phrag nyi shu gzhal ba'i 'og na thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje mnar med kyiciganas yod pa'i steng nas rim par thun mong gi dmyal khams bdun po brtsegs mar yod te/ bshes spring las/sems can nyes par spyad pa spyod rnams la//yang sosathig nag rab tu tsha ba dang //bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod mnar med la sogos pa'i/ /dmyal ba rnams surtag nyu 45

༄/ /reg lon 'gro bolasna/ swā ṭī dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad/sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /zhesapa'adangapoyakra / sku/sa ni/ lcags sreg sa gzhir mtshon gyis mgo lus 'drar/ /zhes dang bstan bcos dran pa nyer bzhag las/ phan chun 'khon zhing zhe gcod pa/ /mi gang mi ni gsod pa dang / /gzhan yang bskyed /gso phag lta bu/ mchan//nas gsod byed pa/ /de dag nges par yang sos 'gro/ /zhes pas/de yang sa cha thams cad lcags sreg gi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du las rlung bis ded pa'i sems can kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu grangs med pa lhan cig tu 'dus shing / der 'phen byed zhe sdang gi las kyi rnam smin dang / byed pa rgyu mthun phan tshun gcig gis gcig la dgra sha bo mthong ba lta bu'i khong khro skye/ myong ba rgyu mthun sa gzhir las kyi mtshon cha rang grub mang po yod pa de lag tu blangs nas gcig gis gcig la brgyab pas bsad zin pa dang nam mkha' nas sos par gyur cig gi sgra grags ma thags slar sos te yang sngar bzhin yang shi yang sos kyi sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzod pa nyin re la lan lnga brgya rer myong dgosapas yang sos zhes bya ste/ bshes spring las/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa/ /des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang / /dper yang mi bgyid char yang mi phod do/ /zhes so/ /tshe tshad ni mi lo lnga bcu la lha rgyal chen rigs bzhi pas zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i zhag sum cu la zla ba / zla ba bcu gnyis la lor brtsis pa'i lha lo lnga brgya la yang sos pas zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya'i bar sdug bsngal lo/ /sog les gshogs dang /zhes/ de 'og gnyis pa thig nag ni/ yang de nyid las/bya min byed du 'jug pa dang / /mi rnams mdza' bo 'byed byed pa'i/ /phra ma rdzun du smra byed pa/ /thig nag du ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa lcags sreg gi sa gzhizhi steng du las mkhan mgo brnyan mi 'dra ba 'jigs su rung ba du mas der skye ba'i sems can lus mgal dum ltar bsgyel te thig nag po bzhi dang brgyad dang bcu drug 46

༄tsho/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal byed/dang sum cu rtsa gnyas sogs btab pa' nga du ltegs sreg ga sog le 'bar ba dang stu res gshags shing lus po so sor bral zin pa na slar sngar bzhin 'byar ba yang gasgordzogs shing 'dra bas sdug bsngal te/ bshes spring las/ kha cig sog les 'dra ste de bzhin gzhan/ /stu re mi bzad so rnon rnams kyis gshags/ /zhes so/ /tshe tshad ni mi lo brgya lha sum cu rtsa gsum pas zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i gong ma ltar nyis 'gyur gyi sdu ga bsngal lo/ /tho lum 'bar bas 'tshir/ /zhes/ de 'og gsum pa bsdus 'joms la'ang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yang de nyid las/ 'bru yi nang na 'khod pa yi//srog chags mthong na 'joms pa gang //de ni lcags kyi gtun shing gis//yang dang yang du brdung bar bya//zhes pas lcags kyi gshun chen po yul ljongs tsam pa re'i nang du sems can grangs med pa blugs nas/ las mkhan rnams kyis lcags sreg gi tho ba ri rab tsam pa re glad la bskor te brdung bas ngu co di re 'jigs skrag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal drag ngo/ dang bcas lus til brdung ba bzhin rdul phran du gtor te shi/ tho ba btegs pa na slar sos pa yang sngar ltar brdung bas sdug bsngal lo//gnyis pa ni/de nyid las/ba glang ra lug ma he dang / /ri dwags phag dang bya rigs dang / /gzhan yang bskyed nas gsod byas na/ /lus can bsdus 'joms 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes pas rang rang gis srog gang bcad kyi sems can de'i mgo dang 'dra ba'i brag ri me 'bar bsaphan tshun brdung kha bkyes pa'i bar du rang las rlung gis dbang med du ded de sha rus rdul phran ltar gtor/ slar gyes tshe yang sngar ltar sos shing yang brdung bas sdug bsngal sku1/ /de bzhin du rang gi lus la gnas pa'i shig dang sro ma bsad pa la nyes pa med ces bdud kyi ngag tshig lab mod kyang / yang de nyid las/ stong brgyar yang dang yang du ni / / brag dkar po yis 'joms par 'gyur/ /zhes pa yang zhe sdang gi kun nas 47

༄/ /rega'ajina'agrozhebolasnrotram̐dapa'abordorjes rme dzad/bslang ba'isdig pa'ayanalagabazhakats+tshangaskre'asgonasarang gi sen mo gnyis kyi bar nas shig bcir te bsad pa'i rnam smin/ brag ri dkar po rang gi sen mo'i mdog 'dra ba gnyis phan tshun 'thab pa'i bar du lus rdul phran phye ma ltar 'thags shing slar sos pas sdug bsngal te/ bshes spring las/ kha cig til bzhin 'tshir te de bzhin gzhan/ /phye ma zhib mo bzhin du phye mar rlog /ces so/ /tshe tshad mi lo nyis brgya lha 'thab bral gyi zhag gcig tu brtsi ba'i lha lo nyis stong bsdus 'joms nga/sa zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo stong phrag gnyis kyi bar du sdug bsngal myong ngo //de 'og bzhi pa ngu 'bod ni/ sgo med lcags khyim 'thums /ngu 'bod dang ngu 'bod chen ngo gnyis ka 'dis ston/ mtshan//par 'o dod 'bod/ /ces/ yang / gzhan bslu g.yo dang rgyu byed ba'i/ /skye bo dag ni yid dbyung bas/ /'jigs su rung ba'i sgra 'byin cing / /yun ring ngu 'bod sreg par byed/ ṣes pas lcags sreg gi khang pa sgo med pa drwa mig can me 'bar ba'i nang du las mkhan rnams kyis las ngan pa'i sems can rnams brdung brdeg rgyob sod kyi sgra dang bcas dbang med du btsud cing drwa mig dag nas las kyi sprul pa'i bya dang khyi dang sprul sogs srogapyichags 'jigs su rung ba mang pos gnod pa dang bcas/ 'di nas thar pa'i dus mi 'ong snyam nas sdug bsngal te 'o dod drag po 'bod pa ste/ tshe tshad ni mi lo bzhi brgya lha dga' ldan pas zhag gcig tu brtsis ba'i lha lo bzhi stong ngu 'bod kyi zhag gcig tu brtsis ba'i rang lo bzhi stong thub bo/ /de 'og lnga pa ngu 'bod chen po ni/ yang / gang gis lha dang bram ze dang / /bla ma'i rdzas 'phrog sdug bsngal byas/ /gang dag btam pa 'phrog byed pa/ /de ni ngu 'bod chen por skye/ /zhes nga gshin rje'i las mkhan 'jigs su rung ba mtshon cha thogs pa mang pos dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa ded de lcags kyi khang pa me 'u ru ru 'bar ba nyis rim gyi nang du btsud nas tho bas brdeg cing / sgo phyi nang gnyis ka lcags zhun gyis srub med par byas te nang ma nas thar 48

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam/ gsal byed/kyang phya ma nasam tharasnyamapa'a'ododadarmera'abodapakha dang mtshan mar khro chu blugs pa sogs kyis sdug bsngal te/ bshes spring las/ de bzhin gzhan dag khro chu bzhus pa yi/ /khu ba 'bar bas 'khrigs pa lhud par bgyid/ /ces so/ /tshe tshad ni mi lo brgyad brgya lha 'phrul dgas zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i lha lo brgyad stong ngu 'bod chen pos zhag gcig byas pa'i rang lo stong brgyad thub bo/ /de 'og drug pa tsha ba ni/ 'bar ba'i gsal shing gis 'bigs zhes/ yang / dge sbyong bram ze dge ba dang //de bzhin gang zhig pha ma la//gnod pa drag pos gnod byed pa/ /de ni tsha bas rab tu sreg/cesapas lcags kyi khyim me 'bar ba'i nang du las mkhan rnams kyi lcags kyi gsal shing rtse mo gsum pa me 'bar bas rkang mthil gnyis dang 'og sgo nas brgyab cing phrag pa gnyis dang spyi bo nas thal le 'byin pa dang /lcags sreg gi snam bus lus kyi phyi nas dkris pas sdug bsngal ba dang / gzhan yang zas 'bar ma dang /gdan 'bar ma sogs kyisashin tusdug bsngal te/bshesaspring las/ kha cig lcags kyi gsal shing rab 'bar ba/ /tsher ma can /shal ma le yang bstan/ mchan//la kun tu rgyud par bgyid/ /ces so//tshe tshad ni mi lo stong phrag gcig dang drug brgya lha gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyis zhag gcig ste lha lo khri drug stong / tsha bas zhag gcig byas pa'i rang lo khri phrag gcig dang stong phrag drug thub bo / / de 'og bdun pa rab tu tsha ba ni/ khro chur 'tshod/ /ces/ yang / med par lta ba gang zhig gis//chos ni chos min log ston cing / /skye bo dam pa dag la sdang / /de ni rab tu tsha bas sreg /ces pa dmyal zangs zhes lcags kyi snod chen po dpag tshad mang po yod pa khro chu khol mas gang ba'i nang du dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa 'bras chan btsos pa ltar 'tshod pas sdug bsngal zhing / steng du thon pa rnams las mkhan rnams kyis lcags kyus bzung ste mgo la tho lum gyis bsnun pas dran pa nyams shing yud tsam rer brgyal song tshe tshor ba 'gags pa la bde 49

༄/ /riga'adzina'agro2laspro/ tādapa'abordorjes ma dzad/bar rlom pa tsamagyasashanatusdugabasngalodha/riribashesasprangalas/ kha cag lcags las byas pa'i zangs chen du/ spyi'u tshugs 'bras kyi cung 'phed bzhin du 'ched//ces so / / tshe tshad ni bar gyi bskal pa phyed thub bo/ /kun nas tsha ba'i mes bsregs brgyad tshan gcig/ces/ de 'og brgyad pa thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje mnar med pa'i dmyal ba ni/gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam la zhugs nas smin grol gyi gdams pa thob phyin chad rdo rje slob dpon dang rdo rje mched lcam gyi gtsos rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma bsrung par dngos su nyams pa'am/ min kyang 'gal nyams dang zhor nyams kyi nyams chags ma bskang ba dang mtshams med pa'i las byas pa rnams kyi skye gnas yin la/ yang / yon tan dgagi che ba la/ /gnod pa drag po byas pa'am//pha ma bla ma bsad byas na//nges par bskalaspar mnar med 'gro//zhes pasalcags sreg gi khang pa ngos re la dpag tshad nyisastong yod paligru bzhi pa nye 'khor lhag ma bcu drug gis bskor ba'i nang du gshin rje'i las mkhan rnams kyis lcags sreg gi sol phung ri rab tsam spungs pa'i dgyil du dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa bcug nas stag gzig giljud pa mang pophyogasaphyogs nas 'ur sgra 'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba tsam du me 'bud pas 'o dod 'bod pa'i sgra tsam las me dang lcags khang so sor mi mngon pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba shin tu rags shing thar pa'i dus ni med/ skabs rer me sgo cung zad re phyes nas bros par brtsam tshe las mkhan rnams kyis mda' bo che dang / dbyug pa dang / tho ba la sogs pasabasnun cing / khro chu khol ma pho mo'i kha dang mtshan mar blugs pa sogs dmyal ba snga ma bdun po'i sdug bsngal dus gcig la myong dgosate/ bshes spring las/ de ltar sdug bsngal kun gyi nang na ni//mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rab mi bzad//ces so catshe tshad ni bar gyi bskal pa gcig thub bo/ /de las lhag par mnar rgyu med pas 50

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam gsal byed/na mnar medapazhesabya'o/ /gnyasapagradzadirmyele brgyadani/ tsha dmyal nas dpa ga tshad nyi shu bcal ba'i byang phyogs na yod par gsungs la/ de yang / gangs ri stug po'i 'dab dang chu 'khyags kyi/ /gcong rong ya nga'i gnas su bu yug sbrebs/ /zhes/ spyi mthun du gzhi dang 'khor yug thams cad gangs ri dang chab rom gyi khrod/ shin tu grang ngar can gyi bu yug 'ba' zhig sbrebs pa'i gnas ya nga bar skyabs bral mgon med shin tu sdug bsngal ba gcer bur skyes shing / grang reg rlung gis btab nga 'i lang tsho ni/ /chu bur can dang zhes/ grang ba'i reg byas lus la chu bur thol thol rdol ba'i chu bur can dang / lhag par rdol ba can/ /zhes/ ha cang grang che bas chu bur rdol nas rmar song ba la chu bur rdol ba dang / smre sngags rgyun mi chad par 'don pa yang / /zhes/ a chu chu zer nas smre sngags rgyun mi chad pa dang / tshor ba'i sdug bsngal brnag par dka' ba yis/ /zungs kyis rab btang 'chi kha'i nad pa bzhin/khugs ring 'don cing zhes/ skad kyi gdangs chags pas shugs ring kyis kyi hud 'don pa dang /so tham zhes/ grang ba'i zug rngu mi bzod par so tham pa dang / pags pa 'gas/ zhes/ lngags mdog sngon por song ste bzhi tshal du gas pa lasdat+pal ltar gas pa dang / sha'u thon nas zhes/ nang gi sha mdog dmar por mngon pa grang reg gi brgyad tshal du gas pas pad+ma ltar dang /lhag par 'gas te brgyad//ces/ de las kyang dmar nag tu gyur te bcu drug dang / sum cu so gnyis dang grangs med gas pa la pad+ma chen po ltar gas pa/ de'i me nang du srin bu ltags kyi mchu can mang po zhugs nas za ba sogs sdug bsngal bzod du med pa'o/ /de ltar sdug bsngal mi 'dra ba brgyad la ming brgyad du chags pas grang dmyal brgyad do / / tshe tshad ni/ grong khyer go sa la'i bre la gzhal ba'i bcu tshad shongs pa'i gzhong pa zhig til gyis bkang ba las lo brgya re nas til re re byung bas til thams cad zad pa na chu bur can gyi tshe tshad yin la/ 'og ma rnamasal tshe tshad 51

sto/ /rig 'dzen 'gro 2lash+lau ༵dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad/nya shu re 'gyurazhangasdugabasngala'oganas:rgo skyi ram par che'o /ngan song gsum sogs las ngan gang byas kyi las de ma zad par sdug bsngal myong dgos nges pa ni/bshes spring las/de ltar sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad lo/ /bye ba phrag brgyar nyams su myong yang ni/ /ji srid mi dge de zad ma gyur pa/ /de srid srog dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /der skye ba'i rgyu ni/ chos 'chad pa'i 'du khang bshig pa dang / pha ma dang bla ma dang chos kyi na bza' lha sku'i snyan dar sogs 'phrog ba dang bcad pa/ semasacan chu 'khyag lta bu'i grang reg gis sgo nas bsad pa dang / 'phags pa la skur ba btab pa/ theg pa chen po'i chos snying nas smad pa sogs der skye ba mdo las gsungs so/ /de nas nye 'khor lhag ma bcu drug ni/ /gong gi mnar med kyi las srab pa rnams thar du nye ba'i tshe'am/ yang na rang rang lasasoso'i dbang gis skye ba sogs ma nges kyang / rdo rje mnar med kyi dmyal ba'i lcags khang de'i phyogs bzhi na sgo bzhi yod pa'i gang nas bud kyang me ma mur gyi 'obs sogs phyogs bzhi na bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug mtshams bzhi na lcags kyi shal ma ri'i sdong po re yod par gsungs pas/ de bzhin spu gri'i thang la rkang pa gshogs/ /zhes/ dang po spu gri gtam pa'i thang ni/rgyangs ring po nas thang sngon po nyams dga' ba mthong ste dga' bzhin rgyugs pas sa gzhi thams cad lcags sreg gi tsher ma dang spu gri sngon po kha gyen du bstan pa'i thang du gyur nas rkang pa g.yas bzhag tshe sha dang rus pa'i bar 'big cing gtub la / yang g.yon pa bzhag tshe g.yas pa sos shing g.yon pa gtub ste sdug bsngal lo / / der skye ba'i rgyu ni/las so so ltar na chos ma yin pa gzhan la bstan pa sogs kyi skye gnas su gsungs pa ni/ yang / gang zhig chos kyi stegs 'jig cing / /yang dag ma yin lam smra ba'i/ /mi de dag ni spu gri 'i sos/ /gtam pa'i lam la 'gro bar 'gyur//zhes so//ral gri'i tshal du lus la bcad gtubs byed/khes/gnyis 02

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig ri thar lam gsal byed/pa ral gra 'e1ma'anagasatshalan/ sngam larmecithar nas nags tshal nyams dga' ba zhig mthong nas phyin pa na ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal zhes lcags kyi sdong po la ral gri rno ngar can mang po lo ma ltar skyes pa de rlung gis bskyod pas lus dum bu dum bur gcod cing dmyal ba'i bya khyi sna tshogs kyis za bas sdug bsngal lo/ /skye ba'i rgyu las so so'i dbang du na rang bzhin gyi sems can bag pheb par gnas pa'am/ bsam gtan bsgom pa'i thugs dkrugs pa/ don med pa'i mi la gnod pa/ sna tshogs bskyal ba sogs kyi skye gnas su gsungs pa ni/ yang / bag phebs can la gnod byed mi/ /nags tshal ral gri'i 'dab can du/ /gdug par ngu zhing bya rgod khyi/ /'ug pa bya rog za bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /ro myags 'dam tshud zhes/gsum pa ro myag gi 'dam ni/ gong ltar rang bzhin gyi 'dam rdzab lta bu nyams dga' ba mthong nas dga' bzhin zhugs pas mi khyi rta sogs sems can gyi ro rul ba shin tu mi gtsang ba dri nga ba 'bus gang ba'i 'damo rdzab tu gyur pas lus der nub nas // srin bu mchu rnon zhes srin bu lcags gyi mchu can mang pos sha rus 'big ste rkang 'jib pa sogs sdug bsngal lo/ /gong ltar las skusnaso'i dbang du na/ log 'tsho dang / dge 'dun gyi gdan drod can tsham tshom med par 'gom pa dang / yon tan med bzhin dkor nag rngam po che za ba rnams kyi skye gnas su gsungs pa ni/yang / gang du 'tsho ba log pa ni/ ṣ+ṭhang zad kyis kyang 'tsho byed pa/ /de dag skyag 'jim nub gyur nas/ /srin bu rnams kyis bza' bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /thal tshan rabs med /thal tshan gyi me ma mur dang chu bo rab med gnyis ka ston/ mchan//klong / /mnar ba'i nye 'khor ba dang zhes/ bzhi pa thal tshan rab med ni/ gong ltar grib ma nag ngam me ba'i 'obs nyams dga' ba mthong ste dga' bzhin du 'bog pa'i tshe/ lcags kyi 'dags me 'bar ba'i 'obs su tshud de sha lpags rus pa'i bar du tshig cing sdug bsngal lo/ /53

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrosnyulapyosbyadapa'abordorjes mdzad/so sa' dbangadunasobyang bslabasdom tswakru neme ma bsrung ba rnams kya skye gnas su gsungs pa ni/ yang / gang zhig brtul zhugs bzang mnos nas/ /legs par srung bar mi byed na/ /de ni nges par sha dang rus/ /'jig pa'i me ma mur du sreg /ces so / / lcags kyi shal ma ri ni/ btsun pa pho me'i tshangs spyod nyams pa rnams dang /bud med kyis rang rgyud bsad pa dang /btsun ma sogs la 'dod log spyod pa rnams skye ba'i gnas yin te/ yang / byi bo byed pa shal ma ri'i/ /lcags kyi tsher ma rtse me 'bar/ /sor ni bcu drug yod pa la//ngu zhing stobs kyis 'dzegs par 'gyur/ /zhes nga ltar/shal ma ri ni lcags kyi sdong po la lcags kyi tsher ma sor bcu drug pa mang po'i rtse mo thur du gzengs yod pa'i rtsa bar 'dod log spyad pa'am tshul nyams rnams las kyis sleb pa dang / rtse mo na sngar rang dang dga' gdung yod pa'i grogs de'am/ rang rgyud bsad pa yin na gsod rgyu'ibyubyisapa de'i snying rje rje'i skad kyis 'bod par mthong nas las rlung gi stobs kyis gyen du ded nas phyin tshe/ tsher ma rnams mthur du gzengs te brang nas rgal gzhung bar 'bigs shing gshag te rtser phyin pa na/ sngar gyi de ma yin pa'i dmyal ba'i bya khā ta 'jigs ces pa dang / bya rgod la sogs ma rung ba'i bya mang po dag gis mig tshil 'bru ba dang sha lpags bcad cing rus pa'i bar za ba sogs sdug bsngal / yang rtsa ba na sngar ltar 'bod pa mthong nas mthur du phyin pas tsher ma rnams rtse mo gyen du gzengs nas 'bigs shing sngar ltar sdug bsngal/ rtsa bar sleb pa dang lcags sreg gi skyes pa'am bud med 'jigs su rung bas pang du 'khyud cing mgo bo khar bcug ste bsdad pas 'gram khug gnyis nas klad pa skya chil gyi 'ong ba dang / lcags kyi khyi bre po zhes 'jigs su rung bas za zhing mid pa sogasakyis sdug bsngal/ de ltar sbu gri'i thang ral gri'i nags tshal gnyis mtshon char gcig tu brtsi ba'i phyi rol na thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med yod de/ rgyangs nas chu chen po zhig mthong nas tsha bas gdung che bas 54

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / tothar lam gsal byed/dga' bzhan 'thunga'adodakyasadrungaduslebardoji/rnyegs kyakhrochu khol ma lcags zangs kyi bye mas skyo nur por lus kyi rke man chad nub ste sha rnams tshos shing rus pa skya sing nger 'gro ba la yang yang brgal dgos pa'i sdug bsngal yod do/ /yang / chu rkyal nya sogs bsad pas na/ /chu bo rab med 'bar ba yi/ /zangs kyi khu ba chur 'gro zhing / /mi de mes kyang bsreg par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /nye 'khor lhag ma bcu drug po de dag tu dmyal srung mgo brnyan mi 'dra ba 'jigs su rung ba mang pos mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs shing dbang med du ded pa sogs sdug bsngal lo//dmyal khams de dag gi sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs dpag tu med pa dngos su myong ba lta ci/ri mo bris pa mig gis mthong ba dang / yid la dran pa tsam gyis snying 'gas pa tsam gyi sdug bsngal yod do/ /de nas tsha grang gnyis kar gtogs pa'i nyi tshe ba'i gnas dang las snang nges pa med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs brjod du med pa yod de/ mdo tsam ston na/ 'gyur ba can/ /sgo dang ka ba thab dang thag pa sogs/ /rtag tu bkol zhing spyod pa'i nyi tshe ba/ /zhes/ khang pa'i sgo dang / ka ba dang gdung ma / thab rdo dang / thag pa dang / gtun dang / phyags ma dang / phru ba la sogs pa rang yin par 'du shes te sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba nyams su myong ba dang / de bzhin du shing sdong po'i yal ga bcad gtub byas tshe rang gi yan lag bcad pa'i sdug bsngal nye bar len pa dang / gzhan yang chu tshan gyi nang du 'tshod pa dang /chu 'khyags dang chab rom gyi nang du rid pa dang / brag bar du bcar ba/ shing dang rdo yi nang du 'thum pa sogs sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod do/ /dmyal khams de dag tu rang mngon sum du skye nas sdu ga bsngal de dag nyams su myong bar bsgoms te da res der dngos su skye ba min kyang de'i sdug bsngal sems thog tu blangs pa tsam la yang 'jigs skeskrag dang sdug bsngal 'di tsam 'dug na/ da lta der skye ba'i sems can grangs med pa zhig yod/ de thams cad rang gi skye sngon 55

༄/ /rig 'dzin 'gro bolarmyo/༵dpa' bo rdo rjes rme dzad/dang da lta' phamanye'abrelasogasayanapashā dzo rnamasasnyang re rje/ der skye ba' rgyu' gtso bo zhe sdang gi las yin/ rang re'i tshe rabs 'di dang gzhan du'ang nyon mongs nga/ zhe sngang gi las bsags pa yang grangs kyis mi chod pas dmyal ba'i gnas de dag tu skye nges pas/ da phyin chad ngan song gi gnas de dag tu las kyi dbang gis mi skye ba'i thabasal 'bad dgos snyam du blo sbyangs la/ sngar byas kyi las la 'gyod bshags dang / phyin chad sgog la bab kyang zhe sdang drag posalas mi bgyid snyam pa'i dam bca' bya/ der skyes ba'i sems can la snying rje shas mi bzod pa bsgom la sdug bsngal gtong len sogs sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i thabs sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyamasasu blang bar bya'o/ /rnam grangs bco brgyad gang las 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /zhe sdang drag po'i kun slong skyes ba'i tshe/ /blo snaḥ lam golaḥ gnyis su zhes gsol ba 'debs lugs ni sngar ltar ro/ /ngan song gi gnas gnyis pa yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal la bying na gnas pa dang /mkha' la rgyu ba gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ de bzhin phongs la nyams mi dga' ba'i yul / / zhes/ yul yangs pa can zhes bde bas rab tu phongs pas rdo gseg ma can nyin re bye tshan gyi char lan bdun rer 'bab cing / dus tshig go log pas dbyar dus zla bas bsreg cing / dgun dus nyi ma'i grang reg gis gdung ba'i yul ngan der/ bza' bsa'i longs spyod ming yang mi grags par/ /zas skom lo zlar mi rnyed yi dwags lus/ /rid cing sdang ba'i stobs nyams rnam pa gsum/ /zhes/yang / gang zhig ci yang mi ster dang / /sbyin pa zlog par byed pa ste/ /yi dwags bkres pas gdung ba yi/ /gsus che kha ni khab tsam 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/spyir las dbang gi sdug bsngal sogs mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang / spyi mthun tsam la rim par/ phyi'i sgrib pa can ni/ zas skom myong ba lta ci/ lo grangs brgya phrag mang por chu'i ming tsam yang thos ma myong bas shin tu bkres skom gyis gdungs shing 56

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / rtse thar larma gsal byed/lus shan turadapasamagaladumaltabudzazi' btung btsal kyang ma rnyed/ gal te rgyang ring por chu klung sngo shar shar 'bab pa dang / shing ljon pa me tog dang lo 'bras can mang po mthong nas zas skom gyi sred pas dga' ste 'gro ba na/ yan lag gi lhu tshig 'khrol zhing sto ba mi thegs pa'i sdug bsngal bzhin thang chad chad du phyin nas drung du sleb tshe chu thams cad skam nas gram pa skya khrog ger 'gro ba dang / shing yang skam nas khra ma skya khrol gyis song nas slar bkres skom me 'bar ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ yang bza' btung longs spyod gya nom pa mang po mthong nas drung du phyin tsa na spyod dbang med par skyes bu go mtshon dang ldan pa mang pos bsrung zhing mtshon chas brdeg pas sdug bsngal ba'o//nang gi sgrib pa can ni/ kha khab mig tsam las med pas zas skom khar mi tshud/ tshud kyang mid pa rta rnga tsam las med pas der ma tshud gong du kha'i dug gis skems pa dang / cung zad re mid par song yang lto ba yul ljongs tsam yod pa mi kheng / lho bde tsam re stor song na mtshan mo me 'bar bas glo snying nang khrol thams cad tshig cing sdug bsngal ba'o/ /sgos khur gyi sgrib pa can ni / yi dwags re re'i lus la mang pos tshang bcas nas za bar byed pa sogs sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs gzhan yang ma nges pa mang du yod pa ni khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal sdo/nga sogs las shes so/ /gnyis pa mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags ni/ btsan rgyal po/ shi 'dre/ 'byung bo/ ma mo/the'u rang sogs sems can gyi srog dbugs 'phrog pa'i rigs yin la/ de dag kyang dus rtag tu 'jigs skrag dang 'khrul snang 'ba' zhig la spyod/ rtag tu bsam pa ngan pa la gnas nas gzhan la gnod pa'i las kho na la brtson te slar shi ma thag ngan song las thar ba'i dus med/ khyad par zhag bdun phrag re'i mtshams su sngar rang nyid nad mtshon sogs gang gis shi ba'i dus kyi sdug bsngal de nyid nyams su myong nas/ sdug bsngal de dag gzhan la spo bar 'dod pas gang du phyin pa'i mi dang 57

cu/ /rig lon 'gro lpol droX dpa' bo rdo rjes ma/dzad/dud 'gro la gnodacangarangalanamaphan/ ljar/sgyinyedu'adrungadu nam phyin kyang de dag la smyo 'bog la sogs pa mi 'dod pa'i nad gdon du ma 'byung / de'i rkyen gyis sngags pa nus can gyis sa 'og tu mnan pa dang / sbyin sreg gi me la bsreg pa/yungs thun sogs thun gyis brab cing brdeg pas sdug bsngal dang / dus tshigs log pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong ngo / /gang las 'byung ba'i rgyu ni ser sna yin/ /zhes/ yang / sred dang ser sna'i skyon gyis ni/ /shi nas yi dwags 'di rnams 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ yi dwags su skye ba'i rgyu ni/ bsgrod bya dang zas nor la 'dod sred bskam chags kyis ser sna dang 'jur gegs de'i ched du phyi mar sha khrag gi tshab skugs sogs yin par gsungs pas/ sngar byas la 'bre1da pa / phyin chad sdom sems/ zas nor la mchod spyin ci 'grub dang / yi dwags kyi skye gnas der skye ba'i sems can la dmigs nas chu sbyin/ lus sbyin/ dkar dmar gsur bsngo sogs sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo / /ngan song gi gnas gsum pa dud 'gro la'ang bying na gnas pa dang / kha 'thor ba gnyis te/dang po ni/ gcig la gcig za gsod pa'i 'jigs pa che/ /zhes/ mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na nya dang / dung dang / chu srin dang sbal pa dang / spir dang / 'bu srin la sogs pa gzugs ma nges pa du ma chang 'gag gi sbang ma bzhin lcig lcig tu yod la/ sprul dang chu srin chen po rnams kyis ri rab la dkris mang du byas te rang gi mjug ma rang gis za ba dang / chung ba ni rdul phran tsam du yod cing / che bas chung ba jur mid byas te za ba dang / chung bas che ba rnams kyi lus thal mar 'bigs shing za ba/ che ba re re'i lus la chung ngu mang pos tshang bcas nas za bar byed pa dang / gcig la mang po rub ste za ba dang / gling bar mun nag gi dud 'gro rnams kyi rang gi yan lag brkyangs bskum tsam yang mi mthong bar g.yang la 'dril ba sogs shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /58

'dzi ra ri'i 95 sa ga rī༄7//sngana'agra'akhradayag///rdzuthar lamagasal byad/gnyas pa kha 'thor ba na/bkol zhang spyod pas nyams thag blang dor rmongs/ /pha mtha' med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i//zhes/ gnas gzhan dang lha mi'i gnas na yod pa rnams kyang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal kho na la spyod de/khyad par du mis bdag tu bzung ba'i sgo phyugs rnams/'o ma bzho ba/khal 'gel ba/bya gcod pa/sna 'big pa/rmos rmo ba/khrag 'byin pa/zhon nas 'gro ba sogs rang dbang skad cig tsam yang med pa mthong chos su yod pa 'di'o//da lta mi phal cher sgo phyugs dud 'gro la ma brten par zas gos sogs kyi mthun rkyen ci yang med pa 'di la mi sems par mi nag chen la khrims gtad pa lta bu'i blun cing gti mug pa'i las ngan dud 'gro drin dang ldan pa 'di rnams la snying rje til tsam yang med par gson tshe la ci thub ci ngan gyis brdung brdeg tshig ngan sogs bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal kho na la gtad/ mthar sha za gang chog dang lngags pa gyon gang chog rnams gshin rje'i skyesabu'i las thabs lta bu'i sgog gcod pa kho na las rang dbang gis 'chir bcug pa ni re zung las med/ min kyang gzhan la btsong ste de'i rin rtsal bdag gir byas nas sems bde bde ltar 'dug pa las de'i drin dran pa dang snying rje tsam yang med pa 'di yin/ bdag pos ma bzung ba'i ri dwags rnams ni gcan gzan dang rngon pas gsod kyis dogs nas rtsa khams gcig yang bag pheb nas za dbang ni med/ gzhan khras byi'u dang byi'us 'bu gsod pas mtshon rtag tu 'jigs skrag gi snang ba kho nas mnar zhing nyes pa spu tsam ma shor yang /rang gi lus kyi sha tshil lpags pa rwa co sogs rang gsod byed kyi rgyu ru gyur nas/las ngan rngon pa rnams kyis dgra sha bo lta bur sems gnag cing gab bskung phud de gsod thabs sna tshogs pas gsod pa sogasasdug bsngal tshad las 'das pa 'di'o//sa bon gti mug mun par 'khyams pa bdag/ces/ der skye ba'i sa bon ṭ+wāṃ chos

༄༅/ /rig lon 'gro 2lawa/ ༄tādapa' bo rdo rjes mdzad/la ma mos pa dang/ chosakyasnangabamed nga/ri8chosadangagang zag la skur 'debs byas pa dang / dge sdig blang dor gang yang mi shes pa cung tsam shes rung gti mug dbang che bas sdig la spyod pa rnams so//de ltar ngan song gi gnas gsum po gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs dos drag la rgyun ring / slar yang der skyes na phyis thar bar dka' bas rang re ngan song du skye ba'i rgyu tshe rabs 'di dang gzhan du byas pa grangs kyis mi chod pa yod pas/ gong smos ltar bshags sdom snying nas bya/ dngos sam brgyud nas byams snying rje bsgom zhing rang gi dus gsum gyi dge rtsa thams cad ngan song de dag tu skyes pa rnams kyi ched du bsngo ba dang /gnas ngan de dag las myur du thar pa'i smon lam bzang po gdab/ snying dang rdo rus 'phrod pa'i gdam pa nyams su len/tshe 'dir sangasargyas kyi go 'phang bsgrubs te / ngan song na gnas pa'i sems can de dag gcig kyang ma lus pa bdag gcig pus sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya snyam du sems bskyed de dam yang yang bca'/de ltar nus pa zhig bla ma dang dkon mchog gis byin gyis rlobasashig snyam du lha dang bla ma la gsol ba 'debs shing ra mdar sbran pani/ blo sna —lam go'akhu gnyis su— zhes snying khung rus pa'i gting nasagasol ba 'debs par bya'o/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bshad pa'i rim pa'o// // gnyis pa dge ba'i rgyu 'bras bshad pa ni/ bsgrub bya dge ba'i las lam bcu ni spyir mi dge ba bcu po de dag gi tes dmigs shes nas sdom pa yang dag par len pa ni thun mong gi dge ba bcu yin la/ de yang sems dge bas kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo gsum gyi bya ba gang byas kyi 'bras bu bde ba skyed par 'gyur ba ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /des bskyed las ni dge ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar/'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i sgo gsum gyi bya ba yin pas las dang /bde 'gro'i rgyu yin pas lam zhes bya'o/ /dbye na/ de nyid las/ mi gsod pa dang rku spongs dang / /60

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /blo thar lam gsal byed/log rdzun phramartsubanyadadang/ /ma'abrel(6 rbe ciyangadagasdom/ /chags dang gnod sems med pa pas/ /nyid kyi lta ba yongs skrong ba/ /'di dag las lam dkar bcu ste / / zhes pa ltar/ srog gcod pa spangs te srog skyob pa dang / khyad par du gsod nges pa'i srog bslus na phan yon lhag par che/ de yang rang gi yid la dam bca' ba ni sems can 'di dang 'di lta bu'am/ gtan nas srog mi gcod do snyam pa sogs bla ma'am rten drung du khas blangs pa ni 'gyur stobs che/ srog gcod gtan nas spong mi nus pa'i las ngan rnams kyi hor zla dang po cho 'phrul zla ba sogs la zla sdom tsam dang / lo dang zla ba kha shas re tsam dang / zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad dang bcu dang bco lnga dang gnam stong sogs la sdom pa brtan po bzung nus na / grong gi bshan pa'i gtam rgyud ltar 'bras bu bde sdug spel mar myong bar gsungs pas spang blang gal che'o/ /de bzhin du ma byin len pa spangs nas sbyin pa gtong /mi tshangs spyod pa spangs nas tshulakhrims(khyim pasa'adod log dang dus khrims/rab byung bas gtanakhrims/ mchan//bsrung ba ste lusakyi dge ba gsum/ rdzun spangs nas bden par smra/ phra ma spangs nas mkhon pa bzlum/ tshig rtsub spangs nas zhi dal smra/ ngag bkyal spangs nas bzlas brjod dang don dang ldan pa'i gtam smra ba ste ngag gi dge ba bzhi/ brnab sems spangasanas chog shes pa/ gnod sems spangs nas byams dang snying rje sgom pa/ log lta spangs nas yang dag pa'i lta ba rgyud la brten pa ste yid kyi dge ba gsum dang bcu'o/ /de ltar bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba'i 'brasabu/chung ngus mi dang /'bringagis lha ma yin dang / che bas 'dod khams gyi lhar skye la/ de'i steng mi g.yo ba'i las zhes bsam gtan bsgom pas khams gong ma'i lhar skye'o/ /byed pa rgyu mthun ni gang du skyes kyang dge ba la spro zhing sdig sems chung / myong ba rgyu mthun ni phyog gcod dang semasacan la brdung brdeg sbangs pas tshe ring ba dang 6/

cu/ /riga'adzina'agrospyolaṭātram̐dapa'abordorjes mdzad/nad nyung / mabyanalenapaspangasapasarmingasaṃspyodadangaldan zhang dgra rkun med/'dod log spangs pas khyim thabs mdzes shing dgra zla nyung/ rdzun spangs pas kun gyis bstod cing byams/ phra ma spangs pas 'khor g.yog gus/ tshig rtsub spangs pas snyan nga thos/ ngag 'khyal spangs pas tshig btsun/ brnab sems spangs pas bsam don 'grub/ gnod sems spangs pas 'tshe ba dang bral/ log lta spangs pas lta ba bzang ngo/ rgyud la skye'o/ /dbang gi 'bras bu ni/ yang rim par/ lo tog mthu che ba/1 dusasu smin pa/2 gzhan du mi 'gyur ba/3 'bras bu bsrung ba/4 ro zhim pa/5 gtan du lo legs pa/6 'bru che ba/7 lus la phan pa/8 rang gi longs spyod par 'gyur ba dang /9 'bru mang zhing 'phel skyed che ba'o/ /10 dang po/ mi ni gling bzhi gling phran brgyad na gnasapa rnams yin la/de la'ang rgyu rnam par dkar ba dang / dkar nag 'dres ma sogasa'aphen byed kyi las dang mtshungasaldan tshe bsod rigs rus/ 'byor rgud sogs gong smos ltar las sna tshogs kyis mi phal ba dang /las khyad par can gyis mi'i 'bras gzhes/ rgyu dge ba 'bring gis mngon mthe'i yon tan bdun ldan dang / che bas 'khor los sgyuraba'i rgyal por skye la/ dang po ni / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshe ring de bzhin nad med dang / /skazugs dang skal pa de bzhin rigs/ /nor dang shes rab dag dang ldan/ /yon tan mdo sde dag las gsungs/ /zhes pas de dag gi las dmigs bsal ni/ yang de nyid las/gsod sar chud pa legs btang dang / /de bzhin srog gi phan gdags zhing / /srog chags 'tshe ba las ldog pa/ /tshe ring pa ni thob par 'gyur/1/nad pa bsnyen bkur byas sman pa/ /sman ni rab tu sbyin pa dang //srog chags bong ba dbyug sogs kyis//mi 'tshe bas na nad med nyid/2/khro ba med la brten pa dag /brgya byin pas ni gzugs bzang nyid/3/phrag dog med pa'i 'brasabu ni/ /skal ba bzang po yongs su bshad/4/dam pa mchod cing bsnyen bkur byas/ /nga rgyal spangs bas rigs 62

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / ste thar lam gsal byed/mthor 'gyur/5/sbyanabyedarkubalasaldogawaṃs/byu/longs spyod phun sum tshogs thob 'gyur/6/dge dang sdig pa gang yin zhes/ /yang dag 'dri la brtson pa dang / /chos kyi bstan chos sbyin pa yis/ /blo gros rgya chen thob par 'gyur/7/zhes dang / yang /sbyin pas longs spyod dang / tshul khrims kyis 'bor/ bzod pas gzugs/brtson 'grus kyis chos phun sum tshogs pa ste/ phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ldan zhes grags so//ga'i/sa pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba ni/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'khor sgyur ni tshe lo dpag med nas brgyad khri'i bar du byung la/ stobs kyis 'khor los sgyur ba ni tshe lo brgya pa man chad la yang 'byung bar gsungs la/ de'i rgyu dge bcu ches cher spyad cing / khyad par du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten bzhengs pa dang / byams pa bsgom pa dang / gnod sems spangs pa sogs kyi 'bras bu'o/ /spyir mi'i skye gnas su skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi chu bo bzhi dang / 'byor rgud 'du 'bral/'dod pa thog tu mi khel ba dang / mi 'dod pa thog tu 'babasang// dgra sngang ba dang 'phrad dogs/ gnyen byams pa dang bral dogs sogs sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa ni mthong chos so/ /gnyis pa lha min ni/ gnas ri rab kyi chu mtshams man chad kyi khong seng na rim par lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'jin dang / rab rgod dang / mgul phreng /gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng na thag bzangs ris kyiganas yod la/ longs spyod ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha la 'gran nus pa yod/ der skye ba'i rgyu phrag dog gis kun nas bslangs pa gong smos ltar zag bcas kyi dge ba'i 'bras bu yin pas/ byed myong gi rgyu mthun gcig gis gcig la phrag dog ste rtag tu 'thab cing rtsode pa dang g.yul 'gyed pas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha dang 'thab pa'i tshe g.yul nyes pa sogs sdug bsngal lo/ /gsum pa lha'i 'gro ba la 'dod khamasakyi lha drug ni rim par/ rgyal chen ris bzhi ni ri rab kyi bang rim bzhi dang / ri bdun dang / nam mkha' la nyi 63

sto/ /rega'adzina'agro2larūk+ṇidapa'abordorjes ma dzad/zla gza' skararnamasadang/ khorayugagoshusngonai can dang / gzhan yang 'dzam bu' gling dag na gnas so/ /ri rab kyi steng na sum cu rtsa gsum pa ste/ dbus su lha dbang brgya byin gyi pho brang rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi mtha' bskor du nye dbang sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi khang pas bskor nas yod pa la grong khyer lta na sdug ces stobs 'byor dang longs spyod mngon par mtho ba rab tu rgyas pa yod do/ /ri rab kyi zur cog bzhi la gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi gnas yod/ de'i steng na grong dang dgon pa'i tshul gyis nam mkha' la yas rim du/ lha min dang 'thab pa med pas 'thab bral dang / byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gcig gis thogs pa sha stag pa rnams bzhugs shing theg chen gyi chos kyis dga' bas dga' ldan dang /rang gi sprul pa la longs spyod pas 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan gyi sprul pa la thun mong du longasaspyad pas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de/ 'dod lha rigs drug po phal cher lha 'chi 'opho lhung ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can yin pasadaper na/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa la mtshon na mi lo bdun brgya'i bar du nya bye tshan la phog pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong nas slar ngan 'gror ltung bar gsungs/ de'i steng nas rim par khams gong ma'i lha gzugs khamaba'iganaba'iris bcu bdun zheba'ibasam gtan dang ngo/ la tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa 'dun na 'don dang / tshangs chen dang gsum/bsam gtan gnyis pa la 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal gyi lha dang gsum/ bsam gtan gsum pa la dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang gsum/ bsam gtan bzhi pyol sprin med 'od dang / bsod nams skyesatredang / 'bras bu che ba dang gsum ste bcu gnyis po ni so so'i skye bo'i sa yin la/'bras bu che ba'i gnas dang grong las dgon pa'i tshul du lha tshe ring bo'am 'du shes med pa'i gnas yod/ der ni sngar 'du shes med pa'i sems thob pa/'i 'bras bu'i gnas der skyes pas thar bar rlom nas bskal chen khri drug stong la sermas sems 64

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig ri thar lam gsal byed/byung 'gags te gnasakyangaslara'adushes sarinesatharapaphyan ca log red snyams pa'i log lta skyes te ngan song du lhung bar gsungs so/ /'phags pa'i gnas gtsang ma ris kyi lha lnga ni/ mi che ba/ mi gdung ba/ gya noms snang ba/ shin tu mthong ba/ 'og min gyi lha'o/ /gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi ni/nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched/ yod min med min kyi skye mched de srid pa'i rtse me'o/ /de ltar bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge rtsa zhes 'bras bu 'khor ba'i gnas yin pas rang rang gi dbang po dang skal bar 'tshams pa'i sgo nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyis gtan la phabs te 'khor ba'i sdu ga bsngal las thar ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos te/ sa snying 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ dge ba dang ni sdig pa'i chos/ /ma thos bar du shes mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin dge dang sdig pa'i chos/ /thos nas rnam par shes par bya//zhes pa ltar/thos bsam kha nang du bskor nasarang rgyud la sbyar te 'khor 'das kyi dge rtsa so sor shes par bya dgos/ thar pa dam pa'i rgyu tshad med bzhi/ phar phyin drug /bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs sted bzhi/ zhi lhag gnyis la sogs pa thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub kho na bsgrub 'dod kyi nges 'byung / snying rje/ dad pa/ gsum gyis kun nas bslang ba'i dge ba'i 'bras bu thar pa zhes 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar te nyan rang byang sems gsum gang rung gi go 'phang thob par 'byur la/ slob dpon chen po be+e ro tsa nas/ tshig gi rtsa ba ma bcad don gyi rtsa ba chod//tshig gi rtsa ba bcad na nam mkha'i mtha' dang 'dra/ /don gyi rtsa ba bcad na tshig mtha' de ru rdzogs/ /zhes pa ltar/ don gnad du dril nas nyams su len bya ni/ rgyu bsod nams dge ba'i blo gsum gong nas gong du 'phel bar bya ba'i rkyen blo ldog rnam pa bzhis rang rgyud las su rung bar byas te/ lam thams cad kyi rming rdo skyabs su 'gro ba nas bzung / lam gyi dngosagazhi yongs su rdzogs pa re re nas phan yon 65

༄/ /rigalona'agrospyol༈/twedapa'abordorjes mdzad/bshad pa ltar bsagasasbyangasarnamasa'a'adi'agyur bzhan shes rab chen pa' rtsas zin pa'i sgo nas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas bla ma'i man ngag ji lta ba bzhin nyams su blangs na 'bras bu tshe 'dir sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba ni man ngag gi gzhung rnams dang / sngon byon grub dbang rnams kyi rnam thar tshad mas kyang grub mod/ de yang chos dang bla ma ya bral du ma song pa'i sgo nasanyams su len dgos/dpal sa ra has/don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang / /rtogasaldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las / / thabs gzhan bsten pa rmongs par shesapar bya/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du/phal po che'i mdo las/dper na yul pa so nam mkhan gyi mis//rang gi zhing bskyur gzhan la legs bslab kyi/ /ston thog smin dus rang la med pa bzhin/ /shes nas ma bsgoms chosakyang de dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ sngon 'gro'i chos 'di las mang mi dgos nyung na mi 'thu ba'i lam kha tshang yin pas bshad yam dang thos lo tsam du mi bzhag par rang rgyud chos dang 'dres nges kyi bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag phu thag chod par bya'o//dge brlargyu 'brasakyi rim pha'o////gsum pa bskyar brdaspukyi tshul du thams cad las kyi rang bzhin du bstan pa ni/ de ltar srid pa'i rtse mo nas dmyal ba yan chad kyi bde sdug gi snang ba thams cad las 'ba' zhig las byung ba yin te/ mdo sde las brgya pa las/ las rnams kyang ni sna tshogs las/ /de yis 'gro 'di sna tshogs byas/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du las dge sdig gang la sred zhen chags pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams pa yin te/ rgya chen rol pa las/ sred srid ma rig dbang gis 'gro ba rnams/ /lha dang mi dang ngan song gnas gsum po/ /'gro ba lnga yi gnas su mi mkhas 'khor/ /dper na rdza mkhan 'phang lo 'khor ba bzhin/ /zhesapa ltar/ ngan song gsumadang mtho ris mi/lha lha min gnyis gcig tu bsdom pa'i 'gro ba lnga po 'di ru rja mkhan gyi 'phang lo 66

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam gsal byed/lta bu'am/ bum nangadubungababatsudapaltarabloraba'adusamed par yang yang bde sdug res mos 'khor zhing 'gro bas na 'khor ba'am 'gro ba zhes bya la/ bstan bcos dran pa nyer bzhag las/gtsang ma'i gnas rnams ma gtogs pa//sna tshogs las kyi cha nas su/ /khros pa gang du'ang mi lhung ba/ /sems can gang yang yod ma yin/ /yang dang yang du dmyal ba nas/ /zangs zhun bskol ma gang 'thungs pa/ /rgya mtsho'i nang gi chu la yang / /de yi tshad kyang yod ma yin/ /khyi dang phag tu gyur pa na/ /mi gtsang ba ni gang zos pa/ /ri yi rgyal po lhun po yi/ /tshad las shin tu lhag par 'gyur/ /mdza' bshes rab tu bral ba yi/ /'khor mi de ltar gang ngus pa/ /mig gi mchi ma'i thigs pa yi/ /snod du rgya mtsho'ang rung ma yin/ /phan tshun dag tu rtsod pa'i phyir//mgo bo bcad pa gang yin pa//spungs na de ltar mtho ba ni//tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang thal/ /zhes pa ltar/ gong smos bzhin zag bcas kyi las kyis 'phang ba'i kharmas gsum gyi sems can thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin/me 'obs dang / gcan gzan dang dug sbrul gyi tshang sgo'am/ gshed ma ral gri thogs pa drung na 'dug pa lta bu ma byung bar blo sbyang / nges 'byung gting tshugs pa zhig rgyud la ma skyes na chos gang bsgrub gnad du mi 'gro/ thos bsam ci tsam byas rung / bla ma mig dred/ gdams ngag rna dred/ gyong po snum dred/ dam nyams chos dred kyi rgyu las grol ba'i dus med pas dge sdig gi rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba nas shes par bya la spangs blang gi gnas mig nang du rdul la btsa' ba lta bu zhig ma byung na chos pa'i ming thogs kyang de tsam mo/ /de ltar mtho ris lha mi gnyis kyi gnas su skyes kyang gal te dge ba'i lhag ma 'ga' med pa rnams bsod nams kyi 'phen pa zad nas ngan 'gror skye ba ni/ las brgya pa las/lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs 67

༄/ /riga'adzina'agro2lakauk+ṇidapa'abordorjes ma dzad/shing dus la babapan/ /'brasabusmanapasnyad sdu 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ dper na bya nam mkhar 'phur ba dbyings mtho sar phyin tshe bya de'i grib ma mi mngon kyang /grib ma med pa ma yin te mthar sa la bab tshe grib ma dngos su yod pa ltar dge sdig gi 'bras bu 'di'o zhes 'phral 'phral du mi mngon kyang / mthar cis kyang myong dgos/ rang re rnams lta ci bdag cag gi ston pas kyang rgyu 'bras bden pa bslu med bdag gir mdzad tshul shākya'i grong du mnyan yod gyi rgyal po 'phags skyes po'i dmag 'ong dus kyi gtam rgyud sogs dang / rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog mo'u 'gal bu mu stegs pas brdung ba'i gtam rgyud dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi mgul rtsa 'jag mas bsngam ste sku bgrong pa'i lo rgyus sogs las kyi 'bras bu ni nam yang chud mi za bas dge sdig gi las chung ngu la'ang brnyas pa mi bya bar spang blang bya dgos/ mdo mdzangs blun las/ sdig pa chung ju dag la yang / /mi gnod snyamo du brnyas mi bya/ /me stag chung ngu dag gis kyang / /rtsa phung ri tsam sreg par byed//dge ba chung ngu dag la yang / /mi phan snyam du brnyas mi bya/ /chu yi thigs pa bsogasapa yis/ /snodaspyochen rim gyis 'gengs par 'gyur/ /zhesapa ltar/ sngon dgelkong zhig 'dul ba'i nyes byabasaphra mo tsam la 'gol ba'i rnam smin gyis klu e le'i 'dab tu skyes pa'i lo rgyus bzhin no/ /de bzhin du dge ba yong sngon mi zhig gis sran ma spar gang sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i 'bras bu mi dbang rgyal po nga las nus sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha sa/nas man chad la dbang bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus bzhin dge sdig gi las gang byas thams cad kun slong gi khyad par gtso che/ dper na shing sdong po zhig gi rtsa ba sman yin na de'i 'bras bu yang sman yin pa de bzhin du rtsa ba dug yin na 'bras bu yang dug yin pa ltar/ kun slong chags sdang sogasakyis bskyed pa'i dge ba ltar snang ba zhig byas kyang don mi dge bar 'gyur la/ kun slong rnam par dag pas mi dge ba ltar byas rung don dge bar 'gyur ba'ang yod de/ yon tan mdzod 68

༄tsho/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /1 thar lam/ gsal byed/las / rtsa ba smanadumachasanamyugu'angasmasna / /rtsa bdug yan myu gu smos ca dgos/ /bsam pa dge dang mi dge'i bye brag las/ /dge sdig gzugs brnyan che chung rjes mi 'gro/ /zhes pa ltar/ rang 'dod kyi zhen 'khris rtsa ba nas med dus byang chub sems dang/'a rnams la lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun po dngos su gnang ba'i skabs yod de/ dper na ded dpon snying rje chen pos mi nag mdung thung can bsad pa dang /bram ze khye'u skar ma'i lo rgyus ltar srog gcod pa dang mi tshangs spyod pa yang de lta bu la gnang ba yin gyi/ chags sdang rang rgyud pa ni nam yang gnang ba med do/ /ma byin len pa yang phyugs po ser sna can gyi longs spyod thabs kyis blangs te dkon mchog la mchod pa dang / ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs kyi ched du gnang la/de'i 'gres rdzun smra ba yang sems can gyi srog skyob phyir dang / bla ma dkon mchog gi dkor sogs bsrung ba'i ched du gnang la/ phra ma ni dge ba byed pa zhig dang sdig pa la dga' ba'i mi gnyis grogs mthun po yod na/ sdig sems can gyi skyon des gcig shos log lam du bsgyur gyis dogs nas de gnyis dbyen byed pa lta bu'i ched du gnang ba dang / tshig rtsub ni 'jam pos mi 'dul ba'i rigs btsan thabs su chos la gzud pa dang / gzhan yang gdams ngag gis rjes su 'dzin pa'i skabs skyon yon dbye bsal gyi thabs su mtshang la rgolab sogs kyi ched du gnang ba dang /ngag bkyal ni gtam la dga' ba'i mi kha cig thabs kyis brid de chos sgor gzhug pa'i ched du'am/ yun ring gi nad pa/ shul ring gi mgron po/ sems sdug bsngal gyis non pa sogs la gnang ste gzhan du ni ma yin/ de bzhin du rnam par dkar ba/rnam par gnag pa/ dkar nag 'dres ma/ byas shing bsags pa/ ma byas shing bsags nga / byas bsags gnyis ka sku(gas zhikha tu shes par byas la spang blang bya/yid kyi nyes pa gsum po ni kun slong dge bar bskurashu med cing rnam rtog ngan pa gcig skye phyin chad mi dge bar 'gyur bas nam ming gnang ba'i skabs med do/ /69

d+ku/ /rigalona'agro5la dro3/dpa'abordo rjes mdzad/de ltar las dgebadangamadageba'abyedardzopo ni semasakhon yan pas rtag tu rang sems brtags te dge ba gang bsgrub kun slong ngan par 'dug na bzang por bsgyur/mi btub na dge ba de bshol na dga'/ so so'i skye bo'i sa na kun rtog ngan pa rgyud la mi skye ba mi 'ong bas rgyun du dran shes bag yod dang ldan pa gal che/ gong smos ltar rang gis tshe 'dir sdig chen po bsags pa med na'ang tshe rabs nas myong 'gyur gyi las bsags pa grangs kyis mi chod/ da lta dge ba 'ba' zhig byed pa dang /stong nyid bsgom pa rnamasal phyi mar myong 'gyur gyi las bag nyal du yod pa rnams gnyen pos mngon du phyung nas tshe 'dir sdug bsngal ba'ang yod de/ rdo rje gcod pa las/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mnar zhing rab tu mnar bar 'gyur te/de ma 'ongs pa na myong 'gyur gyi las tshe 'dir smin pa'o//zhes dang / de bzhin du sdig pa 'ba' zhig byed pa la'ang dge ba'i las kyis bde ba myong 'gyur phra mo yod pa 'phral du sminaskunas zad pa yang yod la/ rgyal tshab be+eḍār ya'i bsod nams zad khar dang po zhagatshobadun rin po che'i char babs pa dang / rim bzhin gos dang 'bru'i chang babs/ mthar sa'i char babs te thams cad sa 'og tu non nasashi ste dmyal b.raskyis pa'i lo rgyus ltar ro/ /dge ba can la ltar snang sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang / sdig pa can ltar snang skyid por 'dug pa thams cad kyang sngon las kyi 'phro yin/ da lta rang gi dge sdig gang byas phyi ma'am/phyi ma'i phyi ma la smin par nges pas/ gong smos ltar dus rtag tu rgyu 'bras kyi gnas la yid ches bskyed pa gal che/ lta ba mthon po'i chos skad kyis rgyu 'bras khyed du gsod par mi bya ste/ o rgyan chen pos/ rgyal po chen po/ nga'i gsang sngags 'di lta ba gtso che/lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa ma shor bar mdzod/de shoran dge stong sdig stong nag po kha 'byams bdud kyi lta ba ru 'gro zhes gsungs pa dang / pha da ma pa rin po ches/ stong nyid rtogs dus sdirga pa byas pas gnod dam mi gnod zhus pas/70

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig sna thar lam gsal byed/stong nyad rtogasanasdagapabyadonamed/ dzhanganyadartogs pa dang snyang rje skye ba dus mnyam zhes gsungs pa ltar lta spyod ya ma bral ba'i nyams len ni chos la zhugs pa'i don po yod des chog yin pas gdams pa'i snying por 'dzin dgos/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu dge ba phra mo tshun chad dam pa gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas nyams su len/ sdig pa'i las phra mo tsam yang mi bya snyam du dam bca'/ nang par ldang ba'i tshe yang rmi lam du sdig sems byung na bshags sdom bya/ dge bar byung na dga' ba bsgom ste bsngo ba bya/ de ring gi nyi ma 'di la yang dge ba ci nus bsgrub/ sdig pa ci nus spang snyam pa'i mos 'dun bya/ nub mo nyal ba'i tshe dran med du mi nyal bar ngas de ring gi nyi ma 'di la snying po ci lon/ las dge sdig ci lta bu byas snyam du dpyad/ dge ba 'grub par 'dug na dga' ba bsgom la gong ltar bsngo ba bya/ mi dge ba'i las byas par 'dug na 'gyod pa bskyed de snying thag pa nas bshags sdom bya/ de bzhin du dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dran shes dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas phyi nang snod bcud kyi snang ba tham sa cad la a 'thas kyi bden zhen mi bya zhing bden med sgyu ma'i rnam rol tu blo sbyang / ji skad du/ lcags kyi gong bu chung yang de nyid gting du 'gro/ /de nyid stod du byas na che yang kha ru 'phyo/ /zhes pa ltar gang zag gi rgyud tshod dang bstun dgos mod kyang / don gyi snying po rtag par rang rgyud dge ba dang drang po'i lam la bzhag nas blo las su rung bar bya ba ni 'di yan chad gyi blo ldog bzhi po'i don hril gyis dril ba lta bu yin pas/ de ltar byas na dge ba gang byas thams cad shugs kyis dam pa gsumadang 'brel zhing / ji skad du/ dge ba can sman gyi sdong po 'dra/ /gang bstenabasten pa kun rgyal nas gda'/ /zhes pa ltar/ rang gi blo las su rung ba'i mthu la brten nasa'abrel tshad kyi blo kha yang dag pa'i lam la bsgyur nus shing / rang gzhan gyi dge ba rlabs po che gonganasagong 'phel du 'gyur/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du ngan song ngan—'gro log par 71

cu/ /rigalona'agro2lak+to/sbyadapa'abordorjes ma dzad/lhung ba'aganasasumaskye nga/ mthoras3denge ma'alusarten khyad par can thob/de lta bu'i chos ldan gyi gang zag de gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs tsam du yang dge zhing bkra shis pa dang /rtag tu lhas bsrung bar 'gyur ba yin no//thams cad las kyi rang basmi du bstan pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhar byung rang skyon sun 'byin gyi ra du gdams pa ni/ /chos lam zhugs kyang nyesaspyod mi stom zhing / /zhes/ dang po nges 'byung gis kun nas bslang ba'i chosakyi lam la zhugs pa zhes 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar thabs nyams su len pa lazer ba yin/ de la 'jug sgo dang po nang pa sangs rgyasapa'i khyad chos skyabasasu 'gro ba yin pas/ skyabasagasum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen ni khyim pasakyang ma thob thabs med pas bla slob gnyis kasagal chung mi bya bar skyabs sdom 'bog pa cho ga ltar byas la/ bslab bya 'chad 'gyur skyabs 'gro'i skabs bzhin nyams su len dgos/ de'i steng du bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ni/ o rgyan pad+mas/ dge ba mtha' dag ma lusagaso ba dang / /sdig pa ma lus rnam par sbyong ba ste/ /dge gso phyir dang sdig pa rnam sbyong phyir/ /de bzhin gshegasapas gso sbyong bda' stsalasato/ /zhes pa ltar/ bsrung bya tshul khrims kyi yan lag bzhi/ bag yod kyi gcig brtul zhugs kyi gsum dang brgyad/ dang po nyes spyod sdom pa tshul khrims kyi yan lag ni sdom pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas na rtsa ba bzhi zhes lusakyi las gsum/ ngag gi rdzun te bzhi po phra mo nas spang / gnyisapabag yod kyi yan lag 'bru chang sogasamyos byed kyi bza' btung thams cad/ gsum pa brtul zhugs kyi yan lag ni byis pa'i spyod pa brtul te spyod pa bzang por zhugs pa'i don yin pas/ 'phyor sgegs kyi bsam pas dri bzang po lus la bsku ba/rin po che sogs phreng bas lus brgyan pa/ gzhan rna cha gdu bu sogs rgyan gyi rigs byed gsum/ rtsed mo dang bzhad gad kyi ched 'chong rgyugs sogs dang gtam sna tshogs smra ba ste gar gyirnam pa/ glu dang 72

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yeg / ste thar lam gsal byed/rol mo 'bud dkrolasogasagaragyarags bh+yone gsum/ nyin phyed phan chad kha skom sel byed kyi ja dang chu tsam las bza' ba dang bca' ba'i rigs thams cad/khru gang las mtho ba'i stan nam gzhan yang dar gos stag gzigs sogs rin thang che ba'i stan spang ba ste/ gar sogs rtsed mo'i rigs byed gsum gcig dang / phreng sogs rgyan gyi rigs byed gsum gcig tu brtsi/ dus min zas dang stan gnyis gcig tu brtsi ba brtul zhugs kyi yan lag gsum ste brgyad po 'di/ de ring gi nyi ma ma shar gong nas sang gi nyi ma ma shar bar bsrung ba ni dus khrims/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar khas len pa ni gtan khrims go mi'i dge bsnyen du grags so/ /gong smos ltar rtsa ba bzhi chang dang lnga po spong ba yongs /nang gses dbye ba'i srol yod/ ma༅//rdzogs dge bsnyen/ srog gcod cam spong ba sna gcig /ma byin len dang gnyis ka spong ba sna 'ga'/ rdzun dang gsum spong ba phal cher spyod pa'i dge bsnyen/mi tshangs spyod pa spong pa tshangs spyod dge bsnyen no/ /gang bsrung rgyu de khas len dus bdag tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen du bzung du gsol zhes pa lta bu'i khas len dgos/ dge chul slong gnyis kyi bslab pa ni gzhan 'dul ba'i gzhung las shes so/ /gang khas blangs pa de ma bsrung na bcas sdig tshul 'chal du 'gyur bas dge 'dun gyi sde la mi dbang ba sogs nyes pa shin tu che ste/ snying gi thur ma las/tshul khrims 'chal bas sa ni gom pa gang / /zas ni kham gcig btung ba chu phor gang / /tsam zhig dge 'dun rdzas la longs spyod na/ /log 'tsho yin te dmyal bar skye bar gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ da dus sngon 'gro go lo thos lo tsam mamothun mong dge sbyor tsam la snyem nas dkor nag tsham tshom med pa la spyod pa mang po 'dug mod kyang / log 'tsho la cung tsam 'jem bag re ma mdzad na/ tshul khrims dag rung spong klog gi yon tan gang yang med tshe dad gshinashu rdzas la sgyud pa rnams kyis phyi mar bu 61na 'jal dgos par gsung padang / khyimaspra yin kyang ོ la73

sto/ /rigalona'agro2la༈sbyadapa'abordorjes ma dzad/zhugs pa yonazhesabaslabasdomagangayangashād rne de tsamamo//sdom nga/ thob nas bsrung ba'i phan yon ni/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /dang ba'i semasakyis zas dang skom rnams dang / /gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i phreng ba yis/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro byas/ /gang zhig dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang / /bde gshegasabastan pa 'gag par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa/ /bsod nams 'di ni de bas khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa ltar/ sngon bstan pa dar ba'i tshe sdom pa yongs rdzogs ji srid du bsrung ba las da res nyin gcig la sdom pa sna gcig bsrung ba'i phan yon che/ khyad par du byang chub sems kyis zin pa'i sdom pa'i phan yon ni tshad med/ rdo rje theg pa'i lha sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel nas nyams su blangs na tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thob par gsungs pas lam yang dag pa la zhugs 'dod rnams kyis dang po nas nam mkhar spar zin lta bu'i mi 'grub pa'i chen po zhig la mi rlom par bslab pa 'di dag bsrung 'tshams shes par byas nas spang blang bya ba ni gnad do/ /theg chen sgor zhugs gzhan phan semasadang bral/ /zhes snying rje chen pos kun nas bslang ste g.yin don byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de theg chen gyi sgor zhugs nas bzung ste/ rang don zhi bde don gnyer gyi blos nyan rang du sems bskyed na nyes pa tshad med pa ni/ sdud pa las/ gal te bskal ba bye bar dge ba'i las lam bcu/ /spyad kyang rang rgyal dgra bcom nyid la 'dod bskyed na/ /de tshe tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyams pa yin/ /sems bskyed de ni phas pham pas kyang shin tu lci/ /zhes so/ /las dang po pas byang sdom rgyas bsdus gang rung gi sgo nas nyin re bzhin gso sbyong bya zhing / bslab pa tshul bzhin bsrung ba'i phan yon ni/ /mdo las/ gang la snying rje mchis pa de la byang chub kyi sems mchis so/ /gang byang chub kyi sems mchis 74

༄tsho/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /blo thar lam gsal byed/pa de la sangs rgyasamachasaso/ /zhesasogs klon yonamatha' yas/ de ltar phan yon dang nyes dmigs dran shes bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas spang blang dang dngos sam brgyud de gzhan phan kho na nyams su len tshul 'chad 'gyur sems bskyed skabs ltar lag tu len dgos so/ /dbang bzhi thob kyang bskyed rdzogs mi sgom pa'i/ /lam gol 'di las bla mas bsgral du gsol/ /zhes yid ches kyi dad pas kun nas bslang ste rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi 'jug sgo'am rtsa ba smin byed kyi dbang yin te/ ji skad du/ dbang ma thob na dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir bas mar mi 'byung / /zhes pa ltar dbang thob dgos la/ thob pa tsam gyis mi chog /dbang gi srog rgyud la 'dzin pa dam tshig la rag las pas na de la'ang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig spyi dang / dbang bzhi so so'i dam tshig rnams gzhan du shes par byas la ma nyams par bsrungs na/ lam gzhan las khyad par du mas 'phags pa nyi zla'i bgrod pa lta bu kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang tshe gcig gis thob nges la/ nyams na rdo rje mnar med kyi dmyal bar 'gro ba las 'gro sa gzhan med pa gsar rnying gi rgyud sde zhal mthun pa yin/ pad sdong brtsegs pa las/ ma nyams bsrung na don 'bras 'grub/ /nyams na yun ring sdug bsngal myong / /zhes so/ /de ltar sdom pa gsum po ngo bo gnas 'gyur yon tanayar ldan gyi tshul du gang zag gcig gi rgyud la 'gal med nyams su len dgos na/ lam gyi spang blang ji bzhin mi shes pa'am shes kyang nyams su ma blangs pa'i lam gol 'di las bsgral te yang dag pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs 'tshal/ lta ba ma rtogs tho co'i spyod pa can/ /sgom pa yengs kyang go yul 'ud gog 'thag /spyod pa nor kyang rang skyon mi sems pa'i/ /chos dred 'di las bla mas bsgral du gsol/ /zhes/ da dus rdzogs chen bstan pa'i chom rkun mkhas rlom kha cig gis yid daphyod blosabyas kyi lta bar rdzogs chen du btags pa dang / thos chung blune+esgomi rang 'dod canakhocig 75

༄/ /rig lon 'gro 5la ṭ+wāṃ/ ༷ ༵/dpa' bo rdo rjes ma/dzad/gas stong 'dzinaganyenapa'azhenapalakhrergo sa ram̐d du btags nas rgyu 'bras 'chol nyog tu spyod pa sogs mang po byung bar snang pas/ zab mo gdams ngag gi bcud dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa las khyad par gyi khrid ngo sprod dmar bcings su thob dgos pa dang / lta sgom gyi phu thags gcod dgos pa'i ched du gdams pa yin pas don go bar gyis la gsol ba 'debs 'tshal/ nangs par 'chi yang gnas gos nor la sred/ /na tshod yol yang nges 'byung skyo shas bral/ /thos pa chung yang yon tan can du rlom/ /ma rig 'di las bla mas bsgral du gsol/ /zhes/ tshig dngos su bstan pas go sla mod kyang / tshig rjes su don dran par byas te rang skyon ngos bzung ste yul phud/ nges 'byung skyo shas kyi dge blo gong 'phel la brtson/ rang rgyud kyi khengs pa skyungs dgos pa sogs la dgongs nas gdams pa yin pas don shesapa'i sgo nasagasol ba 'debasa'atshal/ rkyen khar 'chor yang 'du 'dziganasaskor sems/ /dben pa brten kyang rang rgyud shing ltar rengs/ /dul bar smra yang chags sdang ma zhig pa'i/ /chos brgyad 'di las bla mas bsgral du gsol/ /gnyid 'thug 'di las myur du sad du gsol/ /khri mun 'di las myur du dbyung du gsol/ /zhes/ chos yang dag sgrub par 'dod pa'i lam gyi bar chad 'jig rten tshe 'di'i ched du 'du byed rkyen khar 'chor ba'i las lha'i bu'i bdud ces grags snyan rnyed bkur te mthun phyogs bzhi dang / de las sdog phyogasabazhi mimathun pa ste/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi re dogs spang dka' zhing brtags na chos par rloms pa phal cher gyis 'di kho na don du gnyer te/ tshong khe skyed grong dgon gyi ched du chags sdang sogs 'du 'dzi sna tshogs kyi yo lang dang / gnas skor lta bu'i rgyal khams su 'gro bar sems pa dang / ltar snang ri khrod dang dben rir brten na'ang chos brgyad nang nas ma thul ba'i rkyen gyis rang rgyud la yon tan gyi lo 'bras mi smin pa ni/sdud pa las/ gang zhig dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa'i ri yi sul/ /sbrul gyis gang bar 76

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar larma gsal byed/lo mang bye bar gnas byed kyang //dben pa 'ad shes pa byang chub sems dpa' de/ /lhag par nga rgyal rnyed nas 'dre par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ slar rgyud je gyong rje rtsub shing sdong skam po lta bu 'khor ba las 'phags pa lta ci/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog gi snon mar song ba'i ma rig pa du mas bsgrib pa'i gnyid 'thug po lta bu 'di las sad de thar pa'i lam yang dag pa snang bar mdzad pa dang / khri mun ni mngon brjod kyi skad de ma rung pa'i btson khang dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i btson dong 'di las myur du thar ba zhig bla ma mkhyen snyam pa'i gsol ba kha tsam ma yin par snying khung rus pa'i gting nas 'debs par bya'o/ /des rgyu 'bras zhar byung dang bcas pa'i rim pa'o// //drug pa bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul ni/ bla ma ma brten par sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i lo rgyus mdo rgyud gang las ma gsungs/ mthong chos su yang rang bzo dang pho tshod kyi sa lam gyi yon tan rgyud/ la skye ba ni gcig kyang med/ 'di ltar rang dang bcas pa'i sems can kun log pa'i lam la rnam rig gzo ba nyid de/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la long ba bshes med thang stong du mgo 'khor ba dang mtshungs pa 'di'o/ /des na ded dpon la ma brten par rin po che'i gling nas nor bu blang ba'i dpe med/ de'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dge ba'i grogs po ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam yang dag pa la khrid pa'i ded dpon dam pa yin pa'i phyir gus pas bsten dgos/ de la dang po bla ma brtag pa/ bar du bla ma brten pa/ tha ma dgongs spyod bslab pa dang gsum/ dang po la'ang bsten bya dang spang bya gnyis/ dang po bsten bya ni/ spyir so so'isnye bo'i rgyud grogs la sogs pa 'phral rkyen gyis bsgyur sla ba yin pas dus dang rnam pa kun tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dge ba'i grogs po labasten tegong ma'i rjes su zloprenasayon tan sna re yin kyang gong 'phel gyi thabasal brtsonadagos/de yapadalta dusasnyigs77

d+ku/ /rigalona'agrobol (/lhadapa'abordorjes ma dzad/mar song ba'agashasadangarangarenyonamodzosaskrajehrag tusong ba' rkyen gyas log lta'i mig skyon che ba dang / sngon sbyangs smon lam dman pa'i skal med mang po dus gcig tshogs pa dang / bdud kyi bar chad ci rigs su brdzus nas/ lta snang log lam du bsgyur ba'i mthus/ rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen ni rnyed par dka' yang /gang bsten bya'i bla ma de dag la spyir yon tan 'di dag tshang dgos gsungs/ phyi so thar/ nang byang sems/ gsang ba gsang sngags te sdom pa gsum dang ldan pas rgyud gtsang ba/mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi gnas la ma rmongs pas thos pa che ba/sems can thams cad la shin tu brtse ba'i snying rjes rgyud brlan pa/ phyi sde snod gsum dang / nang gsang sngagasadang rgyud 'in chog lamakhasapa/don nyamasasu blang pa la bsten nasarang rgyud la spangs rtogs kyi yon to khyad par can mngon du gyur pa/ sbyin dang snyan smra don spyod don mthun te bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis skal ldan gyi slob ma sdud pa ste de lta bu zhig bsten dgos gsungs/ khyad par du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i man ngag gi zab gnad ston pa'i bla ma ni/ rgyud sde rin po che nas ji skad bshad pa'i smin byed dbang gi chu bo'i zam ma chad pasargyud smin pa/ dbang dus su khasablangasaba'i dam drig dang sdom pa'i gnas la 'gal ba med pa nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog chung bas rgyud zhi zhing dul ba/ gsang sngagasardo rje theg pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i rgyud don khong du chud pa/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba sogs bsnyen bsgrub kyi rtags rdzogs pa/ gnas lugs kyi don mngon du gyur nas rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba/ thugs rgyud snying rjes gang bas gzhan don 'ba' zhig gnyer ba/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i zhen pa spangs pas bya ba nyung ba/ phyi ma dang du blang bas nan tan chos la semasapa/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du mthong bas thugs rgyud skyo shas che zhing gzhan yang de la bskul ba/ gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas gdul bya'i slob ma 78

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /1 rtethar lam gsal byed/rjes su 'dzinapa'ithabasalamakhasapa/ blazla'ibaka'abazhin bsgrub pas brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa de lta bu zhig bsten dgos gsungs so/ /khyad par man ngag ston pa'i bla ma ni/ rgyud las/ mkhas shing bya ba bral ba dang / /chos nyid don ldan tshad phebs pa/ /'dod pa'i don la rmongs pa med/ /gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyud don byang chub kyi sems la spyangs shing gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum rtogs pa ni mkhas pa zhes phul dang mchog yin la/ chos brgyad sogs spros pa'i bya ba nang nas bral zhingatshu/ lung rigs dang mthun pa'i nyams myong gi tshad ma'i sgo nas slob ma'i rgyud tshod dang mthun pa'i don ston/ nus pa'am/ rang gi tshe rabs kyi bla ma zhes dngos brgyud nas gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dad gus 'phel ba'am/ yang na chos gang gsung rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro zhing serme sa la phan nges pa'i bla ma dam pa dang phrad na/rtags dang cha lugs ji ltar 'dug kyang brten bya yin la/ gang ltar/ brgyud pa'i byin rlabs thob pa'i lta sgom spyod pa'i khrid nyams myong gi sgo nas 'chad shes pa zhig ni cis kyang gal che'o/ /gnyis pa spang bya ni/ rgyud na thos bsam bsgom gsum med kyang go sa tsam gyis nga rgyal ba/ de dag cung zad yod kyang bla mas gnang ba med bzhin chos brgyad don gnyer gyis smin grol ras chod gzu lum gyis gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa/ kha lta skam pos zab mo'i gnad 'chol nyog tu spyod cing ston pa/ yon tan gang yang med rung mi nag pho mo sogs kyi bkur stis rgyags pas rang mthong can/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang bral ba ni spang bar bya'o/ /lung las/ slob dpon tshad mar ma rgyur sprel 'dra'i lung / /man ngag log pa'i lam du lhung ta re/ /zhes dang /o rgyan chen pos/ bla ma ma brtags dug 'thung 'dra/ /slob ma ma brtagakhasagasbung mchong 'dra/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gong du bshad pa'i yon tan de dag tshang ba'i bla ma 79

༄/ /rigawona'agro2la)shā/tādapa'abordorjes mdzad/ni / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugathe rje ye shes kyi rang gzugs gdul bya'i sems can gyi don du gang zag mi'i gzugs su byon pa yin par shes dgos/thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi ngos nas sangs rgyas dang mnyam zhing / bzang 'brel tshe gcig sangs rgyas dang / ngan 'brel 'khor ba mtha' can du 'gyur nges/gnyis pa brten tshul dang / gsum pa dgongs spyod bslab pa gnyis bsdus te bstan pa ni/ rje mi la rasapas lho brag mar pa brten pa'i lo rgyus sogs/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa sku tshe 'di nyid la don gnyis lhun grub mngon du mdzad pa'i gsar rnying gi grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar ltar ci bzhin pa dus dbang gis 'ong bar dka' yang / dam pa de dag gi rnam thar la tshad btsugs nas dngos su ci nus dang / ma 'ongs pa na de lta bu'i dad pa dang snying rus ldan pas bla ma mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas brten te gdams ngag mthar phyin pa'i smon lam bzang po gdab/ rgyas par ni khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sogs la gzigs mdzod/ bzhes gnyen brten pa'i khrid kyi rim pa'o// //spyi don gnyis pa thun min nang gi sngon 'gro la/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/sgrib spyong / maṇ+ḍal/ ku swā la'i tshogasagasogs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang drug las/ dang po ni/ chosathamasacad kyi sgo dbye lamogyi rming rdo lta bu nang pa sangs rgyas kyi khyad chos skyabs 'gro yin te/ skyabs 'gro bdun cu pa las/ sdom pa kun la yod mod kyang / /skyabs su ma /las dang po rnams la kun mkhyen rang gi zhal gsungs ltar skyabs sdom sbyin/ mchan//song pa la med/ /ces so/ /skyabs 'gro'i sgo dbye ba dad pa yin pas dad pa phyir mi ldog pa zhig rang rgyud la skye nus na yod des chog gi skyabs 'gro yin par gsungs shing / spyir dad pa ni rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyi nang nas med thabs chag shing rta'i kha lo sbrur byed kyi 'khor lo dang chos mtshungs la/ ji skad du/ dad pa 'khor lo rin po che/ /nyin mtshan dge ba'i las 80

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /ste rdothar lamagasal byed/la sbyor/ /zhesadang/ yangadadapani'aphaṅgas pe'i nor bdun gyi gtso bo 'di phyi'i phan bde ma lus yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyu yin pas nor bu rin po che dang /yon tan mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas yin pas gter dang / thar pa dang thams chad mkhyen pa'i lam du 'gro bar byed pa'i rkang ba lta bu dang / dge ba'i chos thams cad rang rgyud la sdud byed med mi rung ba'i lag pa lta bu ste/ yon tan mdzod las/dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang ba'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes nga ltar spyir chos yang dag pa'i sngon 'gro dad pa yin cing / khyad par du skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo yod des chog yin pas kha zhe med pa'i dad pa brtan po gal che/mdo las/ dad pas mos pa rnams la mngon par dga' ba/ zhes dang / 31 rgyan pad+mas/ yid khyed shes kyi dad pas byin rlabs 'jug /ces pa ltar/ rang ngos na dad mos rab 'bring tha ma ci tsam yod pa de tsam gyi byin rlabs rang rgyud la 'jug cing / dad mos rtsa ba nas med na thugs rje dang byin rlabs gtan nas 'jug pa'i thabs med/ mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos ni mi 'byung ste/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /zhes dang / tse( rgyan chen pos/ dad med brag phug byang bltas lta bu la/ /thugs rje'i nyi ma nam yang 'char dus med/ /ces so/ /khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen nyams su len pa dag gi dngos grub kyi skal ba chad pa'i rgyu log lta dang the tshom kho na yin par gsung pas/ chosadang gang zag ya ma bral ba'i yid ches kyi dad 'dun bzang po ni sman dkar po gcig thub lta bu byin rlabs dngos grub myur du thob byed kyi rgyu ma nor ba yin pa ni 'phags bod kyi grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar las kyang shes mod/'jam dpalazhing bkod las/chos rnams thams cad rkyen yin te/ /'dun pa'i rtse la rab tuganas/ /zhes dang /o rgyan chen pos/ dad pa can gyi gang zag tho mo la/ /pad 'byung gangatshodu'ang ma 81

༄/ /rigawona'agro2la〉khyidapa'abordorjes mdzad/bzhud sgo nyalayod/ /ngayitshela'adasagrojeyod mayin/ /dad ldan mi re'i mdun na pad 'byung re/ /zhes dang / gnas lugs don dam gyi lta ba mngon sum rtogs pa yang dad pa kho na la rag las te/ mdo las/ shā ri'i bu don dam pa ni dad pas rtogs par bya ba kho na'o/ /zhes so/ /skyabs su 'gro ba dngos la gsum/kun slong gi khyad pa/ra/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul/ bslab bya dang phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po/ kun slong la'ang gsum/ dang po/ rang ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la skrag nas mtho ris lha mi'i bde ba tsam don du gnyer nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni 'bras bu gnas skabs kyi bde ba tsam las med pas na skyes bu chung ngu'i blo zhes bya/ gnyis pa/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin par shes nas rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde don du gnyer nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni 'bras bu rang nyid 'khor ba las thar tsam las med pas skyes bu 'bring po zhes bya/ gsum pa de gnyis ka'i bsam pas ma yin par thog ma med pa'i dus nas drin bsam gyi mi khyab pas bskyangs pa'i mkha' mnyam kyi ma semaba'ican thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis kyis rtag tu mnar ba 'di rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral te 'bras bu rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya ba'i ched du bdag bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro'o snyam pa'i snying rjes gzhan don la dmigs nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni skyes bu chen po'i lam bsod nams tshad med pa'i 'jug ngogs yin la/ de lta bu'i theg pa chen po'i blos skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ sems can khams ni tshad med pa / / phan 'dod de ni de 'dra'o//zhes pa ltar skyes bu chen po'i rjes su bslab par bya'o snyam pas kun slong 'chos pa gal che'o/ / gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ thun mong theg pa'i lugs la dkon mchog 82

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam gsal byed/gsum/ stonapalamagrogasasumosate〈8rmesum̐'agro bdang / thun min gsang sngags spyi'i lugs la/ sgo gsum bla ma la 'bul/ yi dam la brten/ mkha' 'gro la grogs kyi tshul du byas te skyabs su 'gro ba dang / thabs mchog rdo rje snying po'i lugs la/ rtsa sprul skur brten/ rlung longs skur sbyangs/ thig le chos skur dag pa'i myur lam la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / mthar thug gnas lugs rdo rje'i skyabs 'gro ni/ skyabs yul dam pa'i thugs rgyud kyi ye shes sku gsum dbyer med kyi bdag nyid rang rgyud la bsgrub byar byed cing la bzla ba'i tshul de lta bu'i gnas la 'dris par byas nas skyabs su 'gro ba yin cing / de la'ang kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis las/ dang po ltar na/rang nyid 'dug pa'i sa phyogs thams cad rab tu yangs shing rgya che ba rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i sa gzhi mnan na nem pa/btegs na 'phar ba/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa/ zhing gi bkod pa tshad med pa'i dbus su rang gi mdun du dpag bsam ljon shing sdong po yal ga lnga pa/ lo 'dab dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa phyogs kun tu rgyas pas bar mtshams thams cad rin po che dang dar sna tshogs kyi drwa ba dang drwa phyed dril g.yel rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can rlung gis bskyod pas rab tu snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa du ma'i 'phyang 'phrul sna tshogs kyis mdzes par brgyan pa'i dbus kyi yalartsoga'i steng du seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo dpal mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa /dpal mgon bla ma mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bzhed pa ltar na longs spyod rdzogs sku yab yum yin la/ gang ltar mos kyang chog mchan//o rgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs ka'i 83

༄/ /rig྾na'agrobol)'e/ dpa'abordo rjes mdzad/thad du bsdigs pa'itshulagyisa'adzinacingaga.oṃn mnyamabazhag gi steng na ka pā la 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba'i dbus su tshe bum ljon shing gi kha rgyan can 'dzin pa/ sku la nang nas rim par rdo rje'i gsang gos dkar po/ 'dung ma dmar po/ phod chen mthing ga chos gos dmar po gser gyi ha ri can/ za 'og gi ber chen dbang gi mdog can rnams brtsegs mar mnab pa/ dbu la /'dabs ldan rigs lnga ma/ mchan//pad zhu gsol ba/ yum mtsho rgyal dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhal rang la phyogs nas bzhugs pa'i steng nas yar la rim par/ pad+ma 'od /khoba'i brgyud pa ltar na bka' drin thob snga phyi'i dbang gis/ mapha//gsal mdo sngags gling pa snga 'gyur paṇa grub kyi chas/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin rdo rje dang bcas pad sdong rtser bum pa/ g.yon mnyam bzhag dril bu bcas pad sdong pod ral/ o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po sku chas gong ltar/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad phyag rgyas pad sdong pod ral/ 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu rdo rje slob dpon gyi chas can/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na gser gyi 'khor lo/rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa darkang chas glegs ral can zhabs phyed skyil phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon gdan brten pad sdong pod ral/klong chen rab 'byams bzang po paṇa grub chas zhabs skyil krung / phyag gnyis pus gnon ngal bso'i phyag rgya las gyes pa'i pad sdong pod ral/ de'i steng du/ dbus su chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan 'khor los sgyur rgyal chas/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag las gyes pa'i pad sdong pod ral/ de'i g.yas su lo chen be+e ro tsā na paṇa grub chas/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag po ti/ rgyal po'i g.yon du mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal longs sbyod rdzogs pa'i chas/ zhabs btsun mo rol stabs/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba dkur brten pa/ rgyal pa'i spyi bor o rgyan rin po che pad+ma 'od 'bar ltar/ dri med bshes 84
