༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /ste thar lam gsal byed/gnyen phyag gnyis mnyamabazhagathodapabadudar 〉sa gangab/ dz+nyā na su tra phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag pusti/ shrī seng ha phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas bsdigs mdzub nam mkhar gtad de/ g.yon ka pā la dkur brten pa/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen chos 'chad phyag rgyas pusti/ bzhi ka'ang paṇa grub chas /bri bya rnying ba ltar he ru ka'i tshul can bsgom kyang chog mchan//can/ dga' rab rdo rje sku mdog dkar po sangs rgyas sprul sku ji lta ba phyag gnyis chos 'chad/ rdo rje sems dpa' spyi ltar/ kun tu bzang po rgyan med yab rkyang rnams so se'i gong ma'i gdan la 'og ma'i dbu ma reg tsam ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa dang bcas tho brtsegs su bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i mtha' bskor du yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/mdun gyi yal ga'i steng du bcom ldan 'dasargyal ba shākya thub pa la bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyasastong sogs phyogs bcukhus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad kyang mchog gi sprul sku tshangs par spyod pa'i cha byad can/ dbu la gtsug tor dang zhabs la 'khor lo sogs mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung /phyag rigs lnga so se'i phyag rgya can/ sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gagayas kyi yal ga'i steng du 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs te rgyal sras rig gsum mgon po'i 'khor du nye sras brgyad sogs byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyisabaskor ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes shing / zhabs mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ g.yon gyi sdil ga'i stepadu shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu ste nyan thos mchog gnyis la nyan rang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/85

༄/ /rigalona'agro2lazlordo/sbyadapa'abordorjes mdzad/thams cad kyangaskumadogadakarapo/ skulachormigosarnamagasum gsol ba/ phyag na 'khar gsil dang lhung bzed bsnams pa/ zhabs bzhengs stabs can/ rgyab kyi yal gar chos dkon mchog 'od kyi drwa mig gi klong na glegs bam brtsegs pa'i rnam pa can ā li dang kā li'i rang sgra sgrogs pa/ de dag gi bar mtshams thams cad na ye shes dang las las grub pa'i chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bar med du gang ba/ thams cad kyang mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dpag tu med pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la rjes su brtse zhing / 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por rang mdog gi 'od dang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas mngon sum ltar bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi g.yas su skye ba da res kyi pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du gang gnod kyi dgra bgegs/ mtha' bskor du khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad sa gzhi'i ngos la khrom chen po tshogs pa ltar bdag gzhan 'dun pa gcig pa'i sgo nas lus gus pas dngos sam yid kyis phyag 'tshal/ ngag gus pas skyabs 'gro'i tshig brjod cing / yid gus pas dus 'di nas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du bla ma la 'dren pa/ yi dam dang sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong dge 'dun la lam gyi zla grogs zhu ba'i tshul gyis bdag cag rnams khyed la re/ khyed la brten/ khyed la 'bul/ khyed las gzhan na skyabs gnas re sa med panasaskyid sdug legs nyes ci mdzad khyed kho na mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus gdung ba drag pos/dkon mchog gsum dngos bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum: rtsa rlung thig le'i rang bzhin byang chub sems: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor la: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi:zhes dran shes bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nyams su len/ de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe rang gi pha ma g.yas g.yon dang dgra bgegs gnyis mdun du bsgom 86

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam gsal byed/dgos pa'i rgyumatshanaciyinasnyaman/ rangan+nithegapachenapo'i sgor zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams kyis mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems snyoms par sgom dgos la/ khyad par du bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs shing dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsags pa thams cad chud mi za ba'i dgos pa yod de/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/ 'tshe bas nyen pas chos dang 'phrad pa de/ /thar lam rnyed pas gnod byed bka' drin che/ /sdug bsngal yid byung chos dang 'phrad pa de/ /gtan bde rnyed pas sdug bsngal bka' drin che/ /mi min gnod pas chos dang 'phrad pa de/ /'jigs med rnyed pas 'dre gdon bka' drin che/ /ma sogs sdang bas chos dang 'phrad pa de/ /phan bde rnyed pas sdang byed bka' drin che/ /rkyen ngan drag pos chos dang 'phrad pa de/ /'gyur med lam rnyed rkyen ngan bka' drin che/ /gzhan gyis bskul bas chos dang 'phrad pa de/ /snying po'i don rnyed bskul mkhan bka' drin che/ /mnyam du drin gzo dge ba de la bsngo/ /zhes pa ltar/ tshe 'dir bka' drin che ba dang tshe rabs snga ma'i pha ma'ang yin tshul 'dra bas na sgom dgos gsungs so/ /mthar thun bsdu ba'i tshe slar mos gus dung ba byas pa'i rkyen gyis skyabs yul lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad la phog pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas/nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi zhing thams cad 'od kyi rnam par gyur nas skyabs yul rnams la thim/ skyabs yul rnams kyang 'od du zhu nas dbus kyi bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus la thim/bla ma de yang chos sku spros bral gdod ma'i ngang la bstim pa ni kun rdzob kyi rnam pa/de'i ngang du sems bca' bcos mi bya bar rang babs su ltod de rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du dang bral bar ci gnas su bzhag pa ni/ gnyis pa don dmoyongs shes kyi skyabs 'gro'o/ /de las ldang ba'i tshe/ dge ba 'di yilomyur du bdag /dkon 487

༄/ /riga'adzena'agrosnyulakhro/tram̐dapa'abordorjes ma dzad/mchog gsum po'agrubagyuranas/ /'grobargecig kyangam lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /sogs brjod/de yang khral sprad lta bu ma yin par thun tu bcad nas skyabs 'gro 'bum ther kha bskang bcas 'gro nges bya/ phal ba yin na phyag 'bum ther dang dus gcig byas kyang rung ngo / /rgyun tu dran shes dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas 'og tu bshad pa ltar lam khyer la bslab par bya'o/ /gsum pa bslab bya dang phan yon gnyis las/ dang po la'ang gsum/ spang bya/ bsgrub bya/ cha mthun no / / dang po spang bya la'ang gsum/ mdo las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba / / de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te/ /nam du yang ni lha gzhan la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin no/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs 'gro ba/ /'tshe zhing gnod pa'i sems dang bral/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs 'gro ba/ /mu stegs can dang 'grogs mi bya/ /cesas pa ltar/sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lha dregs pa rang rgyud pa sogs la skyabs mi tshol/ phyag mi 'tshal/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba dngos su ci nus su spang / rmi lam du gnod 'tshe byas pa rmi na'ang bshags sdom bya/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas grogs mu stegs can zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang ston pa rang gi bla ma la mi dad pa'i lta spyod log pa'i mu stegs pa'i rigs mthun dang mi 'grogs/ gnyis pa bsgrub bya la'ang gsum/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas sku rten chag dum yan chad sangs rgyas dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed de gus pa dang bkur sti bya/ chos la skyabs su song nas gsung rab yi ge 'bru gcig yan chad la chos dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas dad gus bya/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas lhan pa ser po yan chad rdog pas mi rdzi/ brnyas bcosami bya/ dad pa dang dag snang bya/ gsum pa cha mthun gsum la'ang / da lta rang la blang dor gyi gnasaston 8ni

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /rto rtethar lam gsal byed/pa'i bla ma la/ sangasargyasadakonamachogardongosaci kyi 'du shes bzhag nas tha na sku'i grib ma tsam la yang mi 'gong zhabs tog dang bsnyen bkur la 'bad/ bla ma dam pa de'i bka' ji ltar stsal ba chos dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas ci gsung dang du blang zhing gsung zur tsam yang mi bcag bla ma'i 'khor dang slob ma rang gi grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la dge 'dun dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas lus ngag yid gsum gus nga/sa brten zhing mi mnyes pa skad cig ma tsam yang mi bya'o/ /khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i skyabs yul gyi gtso bo bla ma yin pas/ bla ma'i sku dge 'dun/ gsungs dam chos/thugs sangs rgyas/ de bzhin du sku bla ma/gsung yi dam/ thugs mkha' 'gro/ sku sprul sku/gsung longs sku/ thugs chos sku/ yon tan nor lha gter bdag phrin las chos skyong srung ma dang bcas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yin pa la yin tshul shes pa'i sgo nas thag bcad/ nges shes bskyed/ snying long rus pa'i gting nas khyed shes kyi dad 'dun dang ldan pas rtag tu gsol 'debs la 'bad/ gal te rang gi sgo gsum gyi spyod pas thugs sun dbyung na skyabs yul thams cad dus cig la spang 'gro ba yin pas snying rus dang zhe bcad drag pos bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs la dus dang rnam pa thams cad du 'bad par bya'o/ /ci mdzad khyed shes zhes kha tsam gyis mi 'ong / skyid sdug gnyis po gang byung yang bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje ru shes pas lam khyer la bslab dgos pas 'di ltar 'jig rten 'di'i bde ba dang dge ba'i dngos po tha na tsha ba'i dus ser bu'i ngad pa phra mo tsam ldang ba tshun tshad sangs rgyas kyi thugasarje dang byin rlabs yin nga ra gsungs shing / de bzhin du sems la dge ba'i rnam rtog skadahocig ma zhig skyes na'ang sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs kho na'i mthu yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig rab snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin 89

༄/ /rigalona'agrokhrularmoXdapa'abordorjes mdzad/sangs rgyas mthuyisabargyalaman/ /'jigartene bsodanams blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung / /zhes pa ltar phan pa dang bde ba'i dngos po skyid pa ci byung bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje yin par shes pas lam khyer bya ba dang / ji skad du/ nags chen me 'bar rlung chen grogs su 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ na tsha dang sdug bsngal gdon bgegs kyi bar chad la sogs pa ci lta bu byung yang / bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes rang gi tshe rabs snga ma'i myong 'gyur gyi las ngan byang ba'i thabs su shes pas lam du khyer cing slar snying nas dad pas gsol ba 'debs pa ma gtogs log lta dang de dag sel ba'i thabs gzhan la blo mi gtad/ gal te sman dpyad dang gto chog sogs byed dgos byung na yang / de dag kyang bla ma dkon mchog gi phrin las yin pa la yin tshul shes pa'i nges shes bskyed/ gang snang ba thams cad skyabs yul gyi rnam rol tu shes pas dad pa dang dag snang sbyangs/ phyogs gzhan du don gnyer la sogs par 'gro ba'i dus su gar 'gro'i phyogs kyi bla ma dkon mchog la phyag 'tshal te 'gro/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang gzhung ltar ram/yang na theg pa spyi'i skyabs 'gro/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes skyabs 'gro bzhi skor du grags pa 'di yi dam du bya/ gzhan la yang skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsngags pa brjod cing skyabs 'gro la bkod de rang gzhan thams cad kyi 'di phyi'i blo gtad bla ma dkon mchog la bca' zhing skyabs 'gror 'bad/ nyal ba'i tshe tshogs zhing lha tshogs snying dbus su gsal btab ste/ de la sems gtad de gnyid du 'jug pa'am/ de ltar ma nus na skyabs yul dam pas bdag la thugs rje brtse bas nye bar dgongs te mngon sum mgo bo bstan phyogs kyi sngas mgor na bzhugs yod snyam pas yid khyed shes kyi dad pa brtan po'i ngang nas skyabs yul gyi yon tan rjes su dran pa dang ma bral bas gnyid log bza' btung 90

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / rtethar lam gsal byed/byed pa'i tshe yangadakonamachogagasumaman+t+ran mer gsal te bza' btung gi ros mchod pa'am/ ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ de bzhin du gos gsar pa lta bu gyon tshe yang dang po bla ma dkon mchog gsum mchod snyam du nam mkha' la 'deng tsam bya/ slar bzod pa dam pa'i berdzo/sa su byin gyis brlabs te dngos grub tu bdag la gnang ba yin no snya ma du bgo gzhan yang phyi rol yul gyi rnam pa dngos po yid du 'ong ba ci dang ci mthong yang bla ma dkon mchog mchod snyam du mos gus bya/ rang la tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan grags rnyed pa la sogs 'dod pa ci byung yang bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje yin/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum po rang mchod snya ma pa ma gtogs rang mthong gi nga rgyal mi bya/ bskyed rdzogs sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba gang 'grub thams cad kyang bla ma dkon mchog la mchod cing sems can gyi don du bsngo ba bya/ nya stong dus drug sogs la bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa ci nus dang / dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dran shes dang ldan pas blo gtad bla ma dkon mchog gsum la bcol zhing skyabs 'gro mi brjed par bya/ de ltar byas pas rmi lam du 'jigs skrag la sogs skye ba'i tshe skyabs 'gro byed pa byung na bar dor yang de ltar 'byung ba yin pas de lta bu ma byung bar du 'bad/mdor na thar pa'i lam du zhugs shing nang pa sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug zhig yin phyin chad skyabs 'gro dang skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya srog la bab kyang mi 'dor ba nyams su len dgos rber+sha/ /gnyis pa phan yon ni/ de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba ni chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin te/ gang gi skyabs su song ba tsam gyi thar ba'i sa bon thebs pa dang / mi dge ba'i tshogs las ring du byed cing / dge ba gong du 'phel ba dang / sngom pa gsum gyi rten gzhi/ yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su 'gyur ba dang / gnas skabs su yang skyabs yul rnams kyi rjes su 'dzin cing dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams 91

༄/ /rigalona'agro5lakyā/zlo dpa'abordorjes mdzad/kyis rtag tu bsrung zhing bsam pa yid bzhin rdu 'grub pa dang / dus rtag tu dkon mchog gsum gyi snang ba dang mi 'bral zhing tshe rabs dran pa dang / 'di phyi'i phan bde ma lus 'grub pa sogs phan yon tshad las 'das pa dang / tha na'ang sangs rgyas zhes pa'i mtshan gyi sgra tsam yang rna bar thos pa dang / sku gsung thugs rten gang rigs la 'brel ba cung zad byas pas kyang sems can gyi rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon thebs nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde 'bras thob pa sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs shing / mdor bsdu na/ dri ma med pa'i mdo las/ skyabs su song ba'i bsod nams gang / /gal te de la gzugs mchis na / / nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang yang / /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / phar phyin bsdus pa las/ skyabs song bsod nams gzugs mchis na/ /khams gsum 'di yang snod du chung / /rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ /phul gyis gzhal bar ga la nus/ /zhes dang / nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas skyabs su sems can su 'gro ba/ /bdud rnams bye bas bsad par mi nus te/ /tshul khrims nyams shing blo ni zhabrugs zin kyang / /de ni nges par skye ba'i pha rol 'gro/ /zhes sogs phan yon tshad med do/ /de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i gnas 'di la thos bsam sgom pas nan tan du bya dgos so/ /lam thams cad kyi gzhi rten skyabs su 'gro ba'i khrid kyi rim pa'o// //gnyis pa theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i khrid la gsum/ tshad med bzhi'i blo sbyang ba/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ smon 'jug gi bslab bya bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir byams snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms zhes/ thog mar byams pa nas smos kyang / lam nyams su len pa'i tshe/ dang po btang snyems tshad med ma sbyangs na byams pa dang snying rje phyogs ris can du 'gro nyen yod pas btang snyoms sngon du sbyangs dgos/ de yang / slob dpon in+d+ra bhu tis/ pha dang ma ru ma 92

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam gsal byed/gyur pa'i/ /semasacanagangayangayodamaklonarī/ci /zhesapaltar/ btang snyoms tshad med ni chags sdang zhi 'dod kyi blo yin pas/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med par thag bcad/ dgra gnyen bar ma gsum chags sdang dang gti mug btang snyoms su ma song bar dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin dgra gnyen mnyam pa nyid du blta bar bya'o snyam du bsam zhing / dang po rang gi yid dang mi mthun pa'i zhe sdang skye yul gang yin de la dmigs te tshe rabs snga ma'i pha ma yin tshul dang dgra gnyen sogs re mos su gyur pa grangs kyis mi chod/ da lta yang 'khrul snang bden zhen 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad skad cig tsam yang mi rtag par 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pas gnod yun thung bas ma zad brtags na drin che ba yin te/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ dgras log bsgrub byas kyang thugs dam gyi bogs 'don/ /gtam ma nyes kha yogs dge spyor gyi lcag 'debs/ /'di chags zhen 'jig pa'i bla ma ru 'dug pas/ /kho'i drin lan 'khor mtha' med pa ru gzigs mdzod/ /ces nga/ ltar dang / ma 'ongs pa na'ang de ltar du 'gyur nges pa sogs thabs du ma'i sgo nas rang bzhin gyi sems can bar ma rnams dang khyad med ma byung bar blo sbyangs/ de nas bar ma rnams kyang yang de ltar dgra gnyen nges med du ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pa'i tshul la blo sbyangs pas chags sdang bar ma'i blo ngan gtan nas sbyangs shing thams cad pha ma ru ma gyur pa med pas btang snyoms chen po'i blo nges shes ma skyes bar du sgom dgos/ rang bzhin du dgra gnyen gang la yang chags sdang mi skye ba tsam ni/ phan med gnod med gti mug btang snyems pa zhes bya ste btang snyoms tshad med kyi go mi chod/ btang snyoms tshad med drang srong gis mgron 'gyed pa lta bu zhes dper na drang srong rnams kyis mgron 'gyed pa'i tshe bzang ngan thams cad la khyad med par 'gyed pa dang mtshungs par/ nam mkhas gar khyab kyi 93

sgo/ /riga'adzina'agro5lash+laubyedapa'abordorjes mdzad/sems can thams cadalanyeringachagasasdang rgenyis dngabral ba'i snying rje chen po'i yul du thams cad mnyam zhing snyoms par rtsal yang yang sbyangs dgos so/ /de nas byams pa tshad med ni/ de ltar btang snyoms chen po'i blo sbyang bas yul sems can ris su ma chad pa thams cad bde ba dang ldan 'dod kun la khyab pa'i byams pa chen po zhes bya ste/ dper na bu tsha chung ngu pha mas skyong tshe/ bu des tshur la log sgrub ci ltar byas na'ang dka' tsheg khyad du bsad de/ bu de bde zhing skyid pa'i thabs la rgyun tu brtson pa ltar/ dngos sam brgyud de sems can thams cad 'di phyi kun tu bde zhing skyid pa'i thabs kho na la 'bad dgos/ lar sems can thams cad kyis bde ba 'dod cing / sdug bsngal mi 'dod mod kyang / thabs la mi mkhas bas bde sdug gi rgyu go log tu bsgrub pa 'di thams cad kyi rang rang so so'i zhe 'dod ltar bde skyid kho na byung na ci ma rung snyam du yang yang bsgom/ sems can bde skyid can mthong thos tshe na'ang rang la bde skyid 'byor ba dang khyad med ma byung bar blo sbyang / de bzhin du mdo sde las/ byams nga/'i lus kyi las dang / byams pa'i ngag gi las dang / byams pa'i yid kyi las zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis sems can la gnod 'tshe med pa'i byams pa la bslab par bya dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ mig gi sems can blta na yang / /'di dag nyid la brten nas bdag /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro zhes/ /drangs shing byams pa'i tshul gyis blta/ /zhes pa ltar mig gis sems can gzhan la blta na yang / 'dzum zhing yid du 'ong ba'i chul las/ sdang mig sogs khro ba'i tshul kyis mi blta/ ngag gis kyang gzhan khyad gsod dang sun 'byin zur za sogs dgos pa'i dbang gis ma gtogs ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi spang / bden nga/ dang snyan pa sogs smra/ yid kyis kyang gzhan la gnod sems spang la phan ci thog bya zhing de'i bzang lan 'ong du re ba dang /94

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / rtse thar lam gsal byed/gzhan gyis rang labazangaporamathongathabs skyotshul 'chos byed pa sogs blo sbyong tho co ru shor ba'i bya ba ma yin pas/ snying thag pa nas gzhan la phan 'dod kyi bsam sbyor la nan tan tu bya ba dang / bdag gis tshe rabs thams cad du sems can gzhan gyi tha na ba spu'i khung bu gcig tsam la gnod pa byed par ma gyur cigaphan pa dang bde ba bdag gcig pu kho nas bsgrub nus par gyur cig snya ma du rnam pa kumyo tu smon lam gdab/ dngos su rang la bsten pa'i sgo khyi yan chad dang pha ma rgan khog sogs la mnar sdang mi bya/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas byams par bya/ byams pa tshad med bya mas bye'u gso ba lta bu zhes/ bya mas bye'u gso ba'i tshe/dang po tshang 'jam zhing bde bar bca'/ de nas gshog pas bkab/ drod la bcar/spyod lam thams cad 'jam po'i sgo nas bye'u de 'phur ma song bar du skyong ba dang 'dra bar/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du bdag gis thabs ji lta bus sgo nas bde ba dang ldan par bya snyam pa sgom zhing kun la khyab pa'i byams pa chen po'i rtsal sbyang ngo / /de nas snying rje tshad med ni/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi blo yin pas/ dang po sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba'i sems can gang zhig mi nag can thar med kyi btson dong du bcug nas khrims gyi chad pa sna tshogs kyis rtag tu mnar zhing sdug bsngal ba lta bu'am/ shan pa'i mdun sar dud 'gro 'chi ka ma lta bu'i sems can sdug bsngal drag pos gdung ba zhig blo yul du bsam pa'am mthong thos byung tshe/ de la rang nyid yin pa'i 'du shes bzhag ste/ da ci byed bros sa dang gab sa/ skyabs dang skyob pa ni mi 'dug dus da lta nyid du tshe 'di'i snang ba dang bral te gzhan lta ci gces par bskyangs ba'i lus kyang shul du bzhag nas/tshe phyi mar 'gro dgos pa 'di ya re nga snyam pa la sogs de dag gi sdug bsngal rang thog tu blangs nas 'jigs zing zing gi snang ba ma byung bar blo sbyang / yang sems 95

༄/ /riga'adzina'agro2la)/ rwa/ṭ+wāṃdapa'abordorjes ma dzad/can de rang gi tshe 'di'idrinacanagyimarganadecinengos suyin pa'i 'du shes bzhag la / nyes pa spu tsam med bzhin nga'i a ma sdug bsngal 'di lta bu dang bcas nas gsod na a ma la na tsha dang sdug bsngal ci lta bu yod/ a ma sdug bsngal las myur du thar ba zhig mi byed re snyam du blo sbyang / snying mi bzod pa lta bu'i snying rje skyes tshe dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag la ngal bso/ yang da lta'i dgra ru gyur ba dang bar ma'i sems can rnams kyang dus gsum gyi pha ma ru ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med la/ grangs ni nam mkhas gar khyab khams gsum gyi sems can gyis khyab yod cing / sems can de dag la la 'bras bu ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba nag can btson dong du chud pa lta bu/ la las sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kho na lag tu len pa ni shan pa'i 'dun sa'i sems can gsod kha ma lta bu ste sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis kyis rtag tu mnar ba 'di rnams snying re rje/ 'di thams cad gcig kyang ma lus pa rbe1 rbe'ire las snang gi sdug bsngal 'di las bdag gakhog pus bsgral nas sangs rgyas gyi sa la myur du dgod par nus na ci ma rung / de ltar nus pa zhig bla ma dkon mchog khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i gsol 'debs dang smon lam snying nas 'bad/ de ltar spyi 'byams go yul tsam ma yin par rim can dang spel mar rang blor gang 'phrod ltar nyams su len/ dngos su da lta rang la brten pa'i dud 'gro sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba drin chen 'di rnams la dmyal ba dang 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal du ma gtad nas/ de dag la sdug bsngal yod snyam pa'i snang ba tsam yang mi byed par kha nas sems can snying re rje zer ba 'di rnams brtags na rang rgyud na snying rje rtsa ba nas med pa'i skyon yin la/ khyad par du ched du bsad pa'i sdig zas dmar chog ded nas phye gtor 'gam pa rnams ni byams snying rje'i rtsa ba chad pa'i rigs can mdo sngags gnyis ka dang 'gal ba'i sdig pa gzhan gyi dod min pa ni khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sogs las shes la/ theg chen 96

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yeg / rdo thar lam/ gsal byed/brtul zhugs spyodapa'abrelatshadadonaldananornamame ni ma gtogs so/ /lta spyod zung 'jug spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel ba zhes/ lam gyi chos dang rang rgyud zhu dag pher nges tha dad du ma song ba zhig ni ya gi rdzogs pa chen po rnal du 'byor ba zhig yin kyang med thabs med yin pas dus rtag tu dman pa'i sa bzung /hrul po'i gos gyon/ bzang ngan rab 'bring thams cad gong du bkur/ sems can la dngos brgyud nas phan ci thog byed cing byams snying rje gnyis po 'di nges par rgyud la skyes nus na de bas gzhan dge sbyor sogs gang yang ma 'grub kyang rung ste/chos pang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas chos mang po la bslab par mi bgyi yi/ chos gcig la bslab par bgyi'o/ /de gang zhe na snying rje chen po'o/ /gang la snying rje chen po yod pa de la sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du yod pa ltar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ltar/ snying rje bsgom pa de yang ma lag rdum ma'i bu chus khur ba lta bu zhes/ma lag nga/ med pa zhig gi bu chus khyer na/ sdug bsngal drag po shas mi bzod par 'o dod 'bod cing rgyugs pa las gzhan bya thabs bral ba dang 'dra bar khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi chu bos khyer/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams la shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje skye yang rang la sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i nus pa ni med/ da ci byed snyam du snying thag pa nas sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bdag gcig pus bsgral nus pa'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs ma chung / myur du byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol snyam pas bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing rang gzhan thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu yin tshul shes pa'i sgo nas nyams su blangs shing mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /de nas dga' ba tshad med ni/ gzhan la phrag dog dang 'gran sems zhi 'dod kyi blo yin pas/ gang zhig rigs rus stobs 'byor mnga' 97

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrobolarno/ ༷ dpa'abordorjes mdzad/thang sogs mtho risakyibadeskyidadangaldanaparizhig dmigs yul du byas la/ da dung 'di bas kyang mngon mtho'i dpal gyis 'byor zhing / 'tshe ba med pa/ shes rab che ba la sogs phun sum tshogs pa du mas 'byor bar 3rdzog cig sems can gzhan rnams kyang 'di lta bu'i bde skyid dang ldan pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i blo sbyang / de yang dang po gang la skye sla ba'i yul rang gi mdza' bshes sogs dang / de nas rang bzhin gyi sems can bar ma rnams dang / de nas pha rol dgra sdang lta bu phrag dog gi gnas su gyur pa la dmigs pa sogs rang blor gang 'phrod rim can dang spel mar nyams su len cing / mdor na gzhan 'byor phun tshogs la mi bzod pa'i 'gran sems dang phrag dog gi blo ngan drungs nas phyungs ba zhig nges par dgos te/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis lag len gyi snying po sems can gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba'i rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan pa'i thabs kho na'i mdzad pa can yin pas/ bdag gis gzhan gyi bde skyid dang yon tan la mi dga' bar bltas na de bas sdug pa 'jig rten na ci yod snyam pas dus rtag tu gzhan la yon tan dang mthun rkyen ci tsam 'byor ba la snying thag pa nas dga' ba sgom zhing / da dung yang 'di las lhag pa'i phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam du snying thag pa nas bsgom la mthar dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag go /dga' ba tshad med pa rnga mong gis rnge'u stor nas rnyed pa lta bu zhes/ rnga mong de sems can gzhan las kyang bu la lhag par brtse ba yin pas de'i rje'u de stor na de tsam gyi mya ngan che zhing / gal te rnyed pa na de tsam gyi dga' brod yod pa de lta bu la bslab dgos/ de ltar tshad med pa bzhi po de dag ni mthar thug sku bzhi'i sa bon don dam byang chub kyi sems mtshan nyid pa rang rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu ma nor ba yin pas ci nas kyang rgyud la ma skyes bar du bsgom dgos te/ kun mkhyen 'jigs 98

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig /sti/rdothar lam/ gsal byed/med gling pas/ bsam pa bzang na sa dang lamathu yang bzang / /bsam pa ngan na sa dang lam yang ngan/ /thams cad bsam pa dag la rag las pas/ /rtag tu bsam pa bzang la 'bad par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ bsam pa bzang por bslab pa'i phan yon ni tshe 'dir yang dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis bsrung zhing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa 'a thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs/ gang bsam gyi don thams cad gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang /ci byas dge bar 'gyur zhing 'chi kha gnad gcod mi 'byung / phyi ma lha mi'i bde skyid la longs spyod cing / mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba yin pas rtag tu bsam pa bzang po la bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis nga/ sems bskyed dngos la/ blo stobs kyi khyad par gyis dbye na gsum/ dang po sngon la rang nyid thar bar byas nas 'gro ba gzhan de'i go 'phang la 'god par 'dod pa ded dpon lta bu'am rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed/gnyis pa rang dang gzhan lhan cig thar bar 'dod pa de mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed/ gsum pa sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rang nyid thar ba 'dod par mi byed pa ni rdzi bo lta bu'i sems bskyed ces so/ /sa mtshams kyis dbye na/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam na mos pa spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la lhag bsam rnam dag gi sems bskyed/ dag pa sa gsum na rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na sgrib pa spang ba'i sems bskyed dang bzhi'o/ /sems bskyed rang gi ngo bos dbye na kun rdzob don dam gnyis yod de/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ dang po / gang zhig phyogs ga shed don gnyer la 'gro bar 'dod de thag bcad pa lta bu gong bstan tshad med bzhi smon sems dang / dngos su lam du zhugs nas 'gro 99

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrosilazlo/ byedapa'abordorjes ma dzad/bzhin pa lta bu 'chad 'gyur gyi pha rol twe phyine pa drug la dngos su bslab pa ni 'jug sems te/ smonaci'ajug gnyis ka kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems yin zhing /tshogs sbyor gyi lam du de lta bu'i sems bskyed la brten nas yun ring por blo sbyangs ba'i mthu las/ mthong lam du chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes stong pa nyid kyi don mngon sum du rtogs pa ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed du 'dod la/ de lta bu'i kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga las thob dgos pa dang / don dam sems bskyed sgom stobs kyis thob par 'dod la/'dir las dang po pa'i dbang du byas te/ cho ga ltar len tshul sems bskyed 'bog chog bya ba ni/ 'bog /khrid rgyasapa'i skabs nyen dang po snyeribog chogargyas pa dang / nyen gnyis pa la 'bog chog 'bring bsdus gang 'cham dang nyams len dngos bshad na bde/ mchan/chog gzhan ltar dang / de ltar thob pa'i sems bskyed de mi nyams shing gong du 'phel ba'i phyir rgyun tu nyams su len pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sems bskyed kyi dpang por skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing slar gsal gdab/ 'di ltar nam mkha'i mthatha(khyab pa'i semasacan 'di thamasacad dus gsum gyi pha ma ru ma gyur pa gcig kyang med la/ drin bsam gyis mi khyab pasabaskyang ba'i ma drin can 'di dag thams cad so so'i lasangakyis bde sdug sogs sna tshogs su snang ba bden med 'khrul ba chu zla'i rdzun dis kyis rtag tu bslus shing / 'khor bre sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor bar me+ed lu gu rgyud du 'khyams pa'i skyabs bral mgon med kyi 'gro ba 'di rnams sdug bsngale marme' darge las bsgral te/ rang rig 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i dbyings su dal bso bar bya ba'i phyir du tshad med pa bzhi snyi ngang nas byang chub mchorgo tu sdemes bskyed de sngon gyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad spyod rlabs po che la bslab nas/ 'khor ba na sems can gcig kyang mi gnas pa ra/ de tsam du brtson 'grus brtsam par bgyid do snyam pa'i dam /00

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig /sti/rdothar lamagasal byed/bca' dang ldan pas/ ciho sna tshogs snang ba chu zla'i rdzun ris kyis: 'khor ba lu gu rgyud du 'khyams pa'i 'gro: rang rig 'od gsal dbyings su ngal bso'i phyir: tshad med bzhi yi ngang nas sems bskyed do: zhes ci rigs su brjod mthar/ tshogs zhing la mos gus dung ba zhig byas pas 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis de dag gi thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems rang rgyud la lhang gis skyes par bsam la sems rang babs ci gnas su bzhag mthar/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs ṅgāzung zhing / /bdud kyi las rnams spong par shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ /'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa / / sems can rnams la'ang de 'byor shog /ces sogs smon lam dang /'jam dpal dpa' bo sogs kyis bsngo ba bya/ de lta bu'i byang chub sems bskyed 'di ni/ rgyal bas chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kyi snying po dril ba/ yod des chog med thabs chags kyi gdams pa/ nad brgya sman gcigasman dkar po chig thub lta bu gzhan tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs/ lha bsgom sngags bzla ba sogs chos nyams su len pa thams cad kyang byang chub kyi sems yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di rgyud la skye ba'i thabs su gsungs pa yin gyi/ byang chub kyi sems la ma brten par so so'i lam gyis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob mi nus/byang chub kyi sems 'di rgyud la skyes na chos gang bsgrub sangs rgyas thob byed kyi rgyur 'gro ba yin pas 'di la nyams len gyi mthil bya/ rang la byang chub sems kyi man ngag ston pa'i bla ma de/chos theg pa chen po'i lam du 'dzud pa po yin pas/gdams ngag gzhan ston pa brgya stong las bka' drin lhag par che ba yin no/ /de ltar sems bskyed pa de yang / sems mchog bskyed pa mi gtso skye ba gtso/ zhes 101

༄/ /rigalona'agro2lasmṛsbyadapa'abordorjes mdzad/pa ltar/ kha bshadadangayinalotsamadumibazhergopar/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rang rgyud la skye nges bya dgos/ don sems thog tu ma blangs par sems bskyed 'bum phrag mang po bton kyang snying po de tsam mo/ /gsum pa bslab bya bstan pa la/ smon 'jug gi bslab bya gnyis las/ dang pola'ang / bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ brje ba/ bdag pas gzhan gces sgom pa dang gsum/ dang po bdag gzhan mnyam pa bsgom pa ni/ rang gis bde skyid 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa de bzhin du/ sems can thams cad kyis kyang 'dod lugs mnyam pas/sems can bde ba dang ldan cing sdug bsngal dang bral thabs dngos brgyud nas nyams su len/ bdag gzhan chags sngang gi blo ngan drung nas phyung ste bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems ni/ sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba'i sems can dngos su mthong ba'am min kyang rang gi mdun du dmigs la/rang gi dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i tshe/ bdag gi bde ba dang legs pa lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa gos phud de g.yog pa ltar kho la smin/ kho la sdug bsngal ci yod pa thams cad rang nyid kyis dang du blang bar bsam pa dang lhan cig dbugs nang du rngub/ de nyid bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral bar bsam pa'i gtong len sems can gcig nas rim par mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la sgom/ ngag tu yang / skyid na dge tshogs 'gro la bsngo/ /phan bde yis nam mkha' gang bar shog /sdug na kun gyi sdug bsngal khur/ /sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho skem par shog /ces sogs gsung byin rlabs can rnams kyang brjod/ de ltar rang sos dal du yod dus dran shes dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bde sdug gi rnam pa phra rags gang snang thams cad bag nyal du ma shor bar blo sbyangs nas lam du khyer dgos/ de ltar ma yin pas rang la na tsha sogs sdug bsngal byung dus de la phan du 102

ra tsho 'tsho ri/gri tshog / ga rī༄tsho//sngana'agra' dayagaX//(thar lamagasal byad/re nas blo sbyang mdog ni bdag 'dzin gya snon ma blo sbyong lto log tu shor ba zhes lam du 'gro dka' gsung pas rtag tu nyams su len/ dngos su rang la mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal na tsha sogs byung ba'i tshe na 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can du ma 'jig rten na yod pa de dag thams cad snying re rje/ nge/ thams cad kyi skal pa bdag la smin zhing /de dag thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bde ba dang ldan par shog cig snyam du snying thag pa nas bsgom/rang la bde ba dang skyid pa la sogs pa byung na/bdag gi bde dge 'dis sems can thams cad bde bar gyur cig snyam du bsgom/de ltar bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems 'di ni chos theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs pa thams cad kyi bsgom bya mthar thug gi snying po ma nor ba yin pas/ 'di lan gcig rgyud la skyes pas kyang bskal pa mang po'i sdig sgrib 'dagabasod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs/ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i skye gnas las thar bar 'gyur ba yin no//gsum pa bdag bas gzhan gces par bsgom pa ni/ bdag 'khor bar gnas nas ngan song du skye rung /mi 'dod pa'i nyams nyes ci byung yang bzod par bya yi/ sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin par shog cigabadag gi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad sems can la rdzogs par shog cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam zhing dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag go/bdag gzhan thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu yin tshul shes dgos so//don gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni/sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan te thabs phyogs kyi phar phyin lnga dang / shes rab ye shes kyi tshogs te drug yin la/dang po sbyin pa'i phar phyin la gsum/zang zing dang /chos da nga / mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa'o//dang po zang zing gi sbyin pa de la'ang nang gses su gtong ba dang /gtong ba chen po/shin tu ༷nga ba

༄/ /riga'adzina'agro2larmyeXtram̐dapa'abordorjes ma/dzad/gsum yod/ dngapo/ gtongabanizasakham rgocig tsamayan chad 'byor tshod dang bstun pa'i dngos po lan dang rnam smin la re ba min pa'i gtong sems dang ldan pas nor rdzas la chags zhen dang ser sna med pa'i mchod sbyin la 'bad/ gnyis pa / gtong ba chen po ni/ rgyal bu 'jig rten dbang phyug gis yab rgyal po'i dkor mdzod thams cad dang / rang gi sras dang bcas pa sbyin pa byin pa ltar dang /gsum pa/ shin tu gtong ba ni rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis gnod sbyin sha za spun lnga la sku lus sbyin nga sogasayin kyang byang chub sems dpa' dbang thob pa'i dus ma gtogasad lta de 'dra mtshan nyid pa mi 'ong bas/ 'a ga tu len bya lus sbyin dang gtong sems la goms par bya zhing / ma 'ongs par de ltar gtong nus pa'i smo na lam bzang po gdab/ khyad par du dben par brten pa'i spong ba bsam gtan pa rnams kyis sbyin pa thabs chag mi dgos/ gzungs sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus chu thigs dang nas 'bru tsam gyis kyang yi dwags gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mang po la phan thogs par 'gyur bas/ chu sbyin la 'bad/ dkar dmar gyi gsur bsngos pas kyang mkha' la rgyu b.liyi dwags la phan pa lhag nga ra che zhing 'gro ba'i srog dbugs 'phrog pa'i mi ma yin rnamasaganas skabs dri gsur gyi zas kyis tshims pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pas rgyud grol ba sogs la brten nas sems can gyi srog skyob par nges pas/ don la sbyin pa rnam pa gsum ga yin pas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang na bya sla la chod che ba yin pas lag tu blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ gzhan la dbang bskur/ chos bshad sogs yin kyang rang 'dod rtsa ba nas ma zad par mos pa spyod pa'i gang zag gis sems can gyi don byed lo gzugs brnyan pa ni/ byin rlabs bum pa gang byo dang 'dra ste gzhan gang ca na rang nyid stong par 'gyur/ gdams ngag mun khang nas sgron me lag 104

༄7//sngona'agro'ikhridayeg /blo rtothar lam/ gsal byed/brgyud phyi rol du song ba dang 'dra ste/ gzhan rgisal tsam na rang nyid 'grib par 'gyur ba sogs nyes pa gsog pa'i rgyu las med gsung / rab sa thob gdul bya dus la bab pa'am/ rang la bla mas bka' tshul bzhizha gnang ba therdzob pa dag gis gzhan don bya ba ni/ byin rlabs bum pa bzang pe'i bcud dang 'dra ste/ gzhan smin par byas kyang rang nyid la gang stong med/ gdams ngag mar me'i gzhi ma dang 'dra ste/gzhan gsal bar byas kyang rang la 'grib pa med pa yin/de'i phyir las dang po pas lag tu blang bya dam pa sa/sum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas/ chu gtor dang lus sbyin sogs kyi mjug tu/sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing sogs chos dang zang zing gi spyin pa'i dmigs pa bya zhing phyis dngos su de ltar bgyi ba'i smon lam dang 'dun pa bzang po bya ba la 'bad/ gsum pa mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin kla ni/ dngos sam brgyud de skyabs med la skyabs dang 11ga blu sogs sems can la phan 'dogs thabs kho na lhur len par bya'o/ /gnyis pa tshul khrims kyi phar phyin la'ang gsum/ nyesaspyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed do/ /dang po nyes spyod sdom pa'i chul khrims ni/ chul 'chal gyi nyes dmigs la bsam ste lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas lam gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs mi dge ba'i las thams cad dug bzhin du spang ba la brtson/gnyis pa dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims ni/ sdom bslab kyi gnas la mthun phyogs dge ba'i rtsa ba phra mo yan chad rang rgyud dang sbyar te dran shes bag yod kyi sgo nas rim par nyams su len cing gong 'phel du 'bad rtsol bya/ gsum pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni/ sngar bshad nga ltar rang 'dod rtsa ba nasazad pa'i dus su bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi /sbyin pa dang /snyan par smra ba/don spyod/ don mthun/mchan//la brten nas sems can gyi don dngos su byed pa la brtson pa yin te / las dang po pas smon 'dun bzang pos dge ba gang byas thams cad dam pa 105

༄/ /rigalona'agrospyolabyeXṭ+wāṃ dpa'abordorjes ma dzad/gsum gyis zin nges kyis nyams su len pa le 'du ga/sungs so/ /gsum pa bzod pa'i phar phyin la'ang gsum/ gzhan gyi log bsgrub bzod pa/ chos phyir dka' thub bzod pa/ zab mo'i don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa'o/ /dang po log bsgrub bzod pa'i bzod pa ni/ gzhan gyis rang la dngos su 'phrog bcom tshig ngan smra ba sogs dang / lkog nas mi snyan par brjod pa sogs la bzod dgos te/spyod 'jug las/ bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs/ /legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang / /khong khro gcig gis 'joms par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ khong khro'i nyes dmigs dran bzhin dus rtag tu dran shes dang ldan pas spang blang gi gnas phra zhing phra mo nas blo sbyangs shing goms 'dris bya dgos/ rang re sbrul gyi phru gu dang 'dra bas bze re can las dang po pas bzod pa ji bzhin pa bsgom mi nus pa/sa na/ dang po khong lngi 'khrugs pā'i thabs ci drag nyams su len/ yang / zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig nga med/ 0/bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod la nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'thedud chags kyi las brgya bsags pa las zhe sngang gis las gcig gi sdig che bar theg chen mdo rnams las gsungs pa bzhin/ lam thams cad kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs tshe rabs kyi dge ba bud shing skam po lta bu zhe sdang me dpung lta bus skad cig la bsreg par 'gyur ba dang / bzod pa ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi rgyan dang yon tan gyi mchog yin par khe nyen shes pa'i sgo nas nan tan du bya zhing bsgom par bgyi snyam pa'i snying nas dam bca'/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dran shes dang mi 'bral bar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa chos phyir dka' thub bzod pa'i bzod pa ni/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i zhen pa thams cad rlung la bskur/ dka' tshegs dang ngal dub thams cad khyad du bsad de dam pa'i chos thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad do/ /106

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig /1 rtethar lam/ gsal byed/gsum pa zab mo'idonalamiskragapa'ibazob ci ni// zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don spyi dang / khyad par du rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po bya rtsol dang bral ba'i gnad/dge sdig rgyu 'bras las 'das pa'i rdo rje'i gad mo bcu gnyis dang / ngo mtshar ba'i tshig chen po brgyad la sogs pa mthong thos tshe na'ang / log lta mi skye zhing de dag gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa zhig rang rgyud la lon na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dad spro dang bcas pas zab mo'i chos dang de ston pa'i gang zag la snying thag pa nas mos gus bya/gal te rang nyid skal pa chung bas nyams su len pa ma byung yang /skur 'debs sogs snying nas spangs la ma 'ongs pa na nyams su len pa'i smon 'dun bzang po bya/ bzhi pa brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin la'ang gsum/ go cha/ sbyor ba / chog par mi 'dzin pa'o/ / dang po go cha'i brtson 'grus ni/ sngon gyi dam pa gong ma rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam thar dang mdzad spyod chos phyir dka' ba spyad pa'i lo rgyus sogs mthong thos tshe na yang / spro sems dang bcas par sgyid lug bdag nyid brnyas pā'i sde ltos de lta bu ga la nus snyam pa'i dpa' semasaX mi sum̐m pare de les lhane pa zhig ma thon kyang / de lta bu zhig cis kyang 'grub par bya dgos/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa de rnams kyis de lta bu'i dka' spyad dang snying rus dgos na/ rang res ci'i phyir mi dgos/ o rgyan chen pos/ da res phun tshogs rkyen kun 'byor dus 'dir/ /brtson 'grus drag pos srid las 'da' bar mdzod/ /ces pa ltar/ da res chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sna tshogs 'dzoms pa'i dus 'dir dka' ba dang du blang / sla ba rgyab tu bor/ lus srog 'ben du btsug sha khrag gzan du bor/ dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar la tshad btsugs te snying thag pa nas chos shig mi bsgrub re snyam du dam bca'/ gnyis pa sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus ni/ chos byed snyam pa'i blo skyes ma thag sang bya dang gnang bya'i snyom las 107

༄/ /regalona'agrobolapy-itram̐ dpa'abordorjes ma dzad/'adz+rīn pā'i lte ldo'i dbang du skad cig tsame mi btang bar/ sdar ma'i pang du sprul zhugs pa lta bu'am/ sgeg mo'i mgo la me ye ra ba ltar/ mi rtag pa'i bskul ma btab ste 'phral dang 'phrakhru du chos la 'jug dgos pa yin/ gsum pa chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus ni/ rang gis dge sbyor cung zad re 'grub pa'i tshe/ de tsam gyis chog par mi 'dzin/ bya ba dan zhen gyi lde lto don med 'khrul pa'i bya ba cham gyis bzhag dgos/ kun mokhyen chen pos/rgyu'ajig rten bya ba shi shir zin dus med/ /nam bzhag dus na zin pa chos nyid yin/ /zhes dang / bya byed byis pa'i rtsed mo/ 'dra/ /byas zu/ mi zin bzhag na zin/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'dir snang gi rnam par g.yengs pa thams cad spang nas me thog tu shing bsnan lta bu'i nyin re bzhin chos la brtson pa je cher 'bad dgos te/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas/'chi ba la ci tsam bcar bzhin dge sbyor la snying rus cher 'gro ba 'di chos pa sad kyis ma khyer ba'i rtags yin/ zhes so/ /de ltar sangs rgyas mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du sbyang bya las dang bag chags yod/ thob bya yang gong ma gong ma'i yon tan yod pas/ snying thag pa nas chos la chog shes med pa zhig dgos la/ yang /brtson 'grus med pa'i gang zag la/ zhas rab dang ni dbang 'byor stobs/ /gang gis skyob pa ra mi nus te/ /gru gzing yod pa'i ded dpon la/ /skya bas sdug pa ji bzhin no/ /zhes pa ltar/ des na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ lto tshad la phab/ gnyid srang la gcur/ rig pa gzhur la drang ste/ thang lhod med pa'i brtson 'grus gzhu brdung ba lta bu zhig med na/ dal khoms re 'ga'i chos kyis ni sa gar yang mi phyin no/ /lnga pa bsam gtan gyi phar phyin la gnyis/ dang po/ bsam gtan gyi mi mthun phyogs spang dgos tshul bstan pa ni/ mdo rgya chen rol pa las/ 'dod pa 'phags min rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas/ /kho bos ngal snab rul pa bzhin du dor/ /zhes 108

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /1 thar lam gsal byed/dang / bshes springalas/ 'dodaparnamasarno phung khrol chen po'i rgyu/ /kim pa'i 'bras 'drar thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'dus pa ni bral ba'i chos can/ 'dod pa ni nyes pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs/ yod kyang chog mi shes/ser sna 'phel la dgra rkun sogs rtsod pa can dang thun mong ba/ rnam par grol ba'i chos dang 'gal bas na 'phags pa rnams kyis smad pa/ byis pa'i grogs ni rang bzhin ngan pa/ byas pa mi gzo ba/ mgu dka' ba/ phrag dog pa la sogs 'grogs pa tsam gyis dge ba 'grib pa/ 'du 'dzi ni rtag tu brel zhing don chung ba /ji tsam brtson yang snying po med pa/ dgra btul kyang mtha' med pa/ gnyen bskyangs kyang mtha' med pas na 'dod pa'i gnas grogs kyi rnam gswongs spang dgos/dben pa'i nags khrod ni/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dpabyadza chub sems dpa' rnams kyis zhi ba brnyes pa'i gnas/ 'udu 'dzī dang rnam g.yengs med pa/ tshong dang so nam med pa/ byis pa'i grogs dang bral ba/ bya dang ri dwags 'grogs na bde ba/chu dang lo ma dka' thub kyi zas btsal sla ba/ rig pa ngang gis dwangs shing / ting 'dzin shugs kyis 'phel ba/ dgra gnyen chags sdang gi sgrog las grol ba sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa/de lta bu'i dben pa'i gnas su dngos su phyin nas bsgom pa'i phan yon lta ci smos/dben gnas kyi yon tan bsam nas/ de'i phyogs su goms pa bdun bor na bskal ba gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa phul ba las kyang phan yon che bar zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las gsungasapas de lta bu'i dben ri 'am/yang na bsam gtan gyi khang bur lus ngag dben par bya/gnyis pa bsam gtan dngos la'ang / byis pa nyer spyod/ don rab 'byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs dga'i bsam gtan dang gsum/ de yang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams la zhen nas/ de nyid la ched du gnyer te nyams zhen gyi rtsi dang bcasapa'i 109

d+ku/ /riga'adzina'agro5lazlotwedapa'abordorjes ma dzad/dus na / byis pa nyeraspyodakyibasamagatan/ri8 nyamasakyisazhen pa dang bral nas bsam gtan gyi ro myong med kyang stong 'dzin gnyen po'i phyogs la zhen nas bsgom pa'i dus ni/ don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan/ stong 'dzin gnyen pa'i blo dang bral te chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin la gnas dus/ de bzhin gtogags dge'i bsam gtan zhes gsungs/ de ltar bsam gtan bsgom pa'i dus su lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun dang / mig gnad lta stangs byed pa sogs gal che/ yid gang du'ang mi rtog cir yang mi 'dzin pa'i ngang la mnyam par ‘sprujog pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /drug pa shes rab kyi phar phyin la'ang / thos pa/ bsam pa/ sgom pa'i shes rab dang gsum/ thos pa'i shes rab ni chos kyi tshig don bla mas gsungs rang gis nyan te de'i don go ba dang / bsam pa'i shes rab ni de dag go lo dang thos lor mi bzhag par rang rgyud la sbyar te rtog dpyod bsam gzhig gi sgo nas gtan la phab ste gcig pur nyams su len pa'i dus su nyams len kyi gnad gzhan la dri mi dgos par rang skya thub nges zhun thar bcad pa de'o/ /sgom pa'i shes rab ni/shes nas nyams su blangs te sgom pas gnas lugs kyi rang zhal mthong ba yin la/de yang dang po thosabasam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas/ sgom pas nyams su len pa'i dus su/ 'di ltar phyi yul lnga'i snang ba thams cad med bzhin 'khrul ngo la snang ba rmi lam lta bu/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las glo bur du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu/ med la yod par snang ba mig yor lta bu/ snang bzhin bden par ma grub pas smig rgyu lta bu/ phyi nang gang la yang med bzhin snang bas brag ca lta bu/ rten dang brten par med pas dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/snang la rang bzhin med pas gzugs brnyan gyi snang ba lta bu/ med snang cir yang 'char ba sprul pa'i grong khyer lta bu ste/dngos po med nga 'i stong gzugs sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du bltas pas yul gyi snang ba 110

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam/ gsal byed/rdzun pa'i rangabazhinadugo /deltarasnangadro'imekhan poyul can sems kyi gshis lugs la brtags pas yul snang ma 'gags la yul gyi 'dzin rtog zhi/ chos nyid stong gsal nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa'i ngang du 'jog pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de deg kyang bkral na phar phyin re re la yang gsum gsum du phye bas bco brgyad/ de las kyang zang zing gi sbyin pa la gsum du dbye bas nyi shu/ de'i steng du thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang nyer gcig stobs kyi phar phyin dang nyer gnyis/ smon lam gyi phar phyin dang nyer gsum/ ye shes kyi phar phyin dang nyer bzhi/ de las kyang rgyas par dbye na pha rol tu phyin pa re re la yang drug drug dbye bas sum cu rtsa drug tu dbye ba sogs khrid yig rgyas pa kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sogs la blta bar bya'o/ /de dag gi gnad dril te nyams su myong dgos te/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ chog shes la sbyin pa'i phar phyin gnas/ /de yi ngo bo gtong sems yin/ /dkon mchog gis ma khrel na tshul khrims yod/ /dran rig ma nyams pa bzod pa/'i mchog /kun gyi grogs su brtson 'grus dgos/ /snang zhen lhar bsgom bsam gtan te/ /'dzin zhen rang grol shes rab bo/ /de la bsam dang bsam byed med/ /tha mal ma yin nges shes bral/ /mya ngan 'das zhi dam pa'o/ /'di ni kun la brjod mi bya/ /sems kyi dam par zungs shig gu/ /zhes rber+sha/ /de ltar phar phyin drug sogs byang chub sems dpa'i gzhud lam rgya chen po de thams cad mdo hril gyis dril na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can nyams su len pa la 'du ste/ dpal sa ra ha'i zhal nas kyang / snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid lta ba/ /des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin te/ /gal te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom na yang / /'khor ba 'dir gnas thar pa yod dam ci/ /gang la gnyis po yod par gyur ba de / / srid par mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /zhes pa ltar/ srid pa dang mya 111

sto/ /rigalona'agrobolarnyishā/ṭ+wāṃdapa'abordorjes ma dzad/ngan las 'das pa gnyisakaramiganasapani—ske/ miganasapa'i myang 'das rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin no/ /de bzhin du mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/stong nyid snying rje snying po can/ /byang chub bsgrub pa kha cig la'o/ /zhes so/ /byang chub kyi sems stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can 'di dang bral na/ lta sgom gyi chos zab zab 'dra mo nyams su blang kyang sangs rgyas thob nga/ra mi 'gyur la/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ bskyed rdzogs sogs gsang sngags kyi nyams len rnams kyang / byang chub sems kyis zin na tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur 'gro zhing / byang chub kyi sems dang bral na mu stegs pa dang khyad med/ mu stegs pa la'ang lha sgom sngags bzla/ rtsa rlung bsgom pa/ rgyu 'bras spangs blang byed pa sogs du ma yod kyang / skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnyis po 'di med pas 'khor ba'i gnas las thar mi nus pa'i skyon de yin par 'dug skyabs sems gnyis po 'dis legs par ma zin pa'i chos la thos bsam bsgom gsum rgya gang che byed lo byas kyang / dper na dgun kha'i 'khyag rom gyi steng du mkhar legs par brtsigs te/de la zhal 'degs dang ri mo la sogs pa rnam 'gyur byas pa dang 'dra ste phugs su snying ngo ci yang med/ des na skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnyis po 'di gal chung mi bya bar/ lam thams cad kyi spyor dngos rjes gsum 'di ga'i khong nas rdzogs pa zhig byed dgos pas/'di kho na la rtsal bton nas sbyang par byed pa gal che/ byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa zhig nyams su len shes na/ yon tan gzhan ci yang ma shes kyang de la gang 'brel don dang ldan pa yin/ 'on kyang shan pa dang smad 'tshong ma la sogs pa'i khrod na yang thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' du ma yod par gsungs pas gang zag gzhan gyi rgyud na byang chub kyi sems yod med shes dka'/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nga dang nga lta bu ma gtogs gang zag gi tshod gang zag gis mi 112

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig sna rtethar lam gsal byed/ bzung zhes gsungs/ desanarangargyudalardongarkyeb kyi sems gang gis bskyed pa'i lha dang bla ma dge ba'i grogs po sogs la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhagarang rgyud la yang gnas lugs kyi don rtogs snyam pa sogs lam rtags kyi yon tan ltar ci lta bu byung yang de la brten nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gong 'phel tu 'gro bar 'dug na/ de nyid yon tan yin par thag bcad/ gal te byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'grib par 'dug na/ bdud kyi bar chad yin par gdon mi za/ khyad par gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa bcos ma ma yin pa de rgyud la skyes na nges 'byung dang byams snying rje dad pa dag snang thun mong ma yin pa zhig rgyud la nges par skye 'ong / de yang lam rtags kyi yon tan yin kyang de la rlom sems dang rang mthong gi nga rgyal med pa zhig dgos/ nyams len gnad du dril ma shes na shes shes go go rig rig mang po la snying po ci yang med/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ shes bya nam mkha'i gza' skar 'dra/ /bslab dgos gnas la zad pa med/ /da res chos sku'i snying po'i don/ /'gyur med btsan sa bzung na legs/ /zhes pa ltar/ rang rgyud la phan pa med par ma zad nga rgyal gyi snon mar 'gyur ten yod pas kha nang du bskor nas don shes dgos nges lam gyi cha rkyen sngon 'gro'i chos 'di legs par nyan nas nyams su 'e1na nges zhig byas na de las mang mi dgos pa ni nges pa'o/ /de ltar khrid tshul 'di la phar phyin theg pa'i zab gnad thams cad 'du zhing theg pa chen pe'i chos kyi rtsa ba yin pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa dang / nyan rang gi theg pa las 'phags pa dang / dge rtsa mi zad cing 'phel ba dang / bsod nams rgya chen po thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi gdung 'tshob pa dang / gzhan don rlabs po che 'grub pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa dpag tu med pas spyor dngos rjes gsum tshang pas nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba theg pa chen 113

༄/ /rigalona'agrolpolasmolhadapa'abordorjes ma/dzad/po byang chub mchogatusemasabaskyedapa'izhidan+turimapa'o// //don gsum pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi khrid la gsum/ sbyang bya/ sbyong byed/ sbyong tshul lo/ /dang po/ sbyang bya zab mo'i lam gyi nyams rtogs khyad par can skye ba la bar du gcod par byed pa ni nyams chag dang sdig sgrib yin/ de la'ang spyir sdig pa'i sgo drug gsungs la/ bsdu na shes nyon gnyis yin te/ o rgyan chen pos/ byin rlabs dngos grub kun gyi gegs/ /sgrib pa rnam gnyis yin pa'i phyir/ /de dag rab tu sbyang pa gces/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa sbyong byed khyad du 'phags pa rang lugs la rigs kun 'dus pa bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la brten pa yin la/ sku gsung thugs snying po bstan pa'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kyi/ /re re'i bskyed rdzogs grangs las 'das/ /ma lus kun sgrub 'di ltar bya/ /hūm̐ las bla ma rdo rje sems/ /zhes so//gsum pa sbyong tshul la'ang kun rdzob bskyed bzlas stobs bzhi dang 'brel ba / don dam bdag med dbyings su sdig lhung la bzla ba'i tshul gnyis las/dang po ltar na/ rim par stobs bzhi'i dag pa dran pa'i ngang nas 'don bsgo ma zung du 'jug pas/aX bdag nyid tha mal spyi bo sa pad dkar zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus: zhes/bdag nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i tshangs bug tu reg la khad kyi yar la pad+ma'i sdong bu dpang sor bzhi 'am mda' tshad tsam las gyes pa'i rab tu yangs shing rgya che ba pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad dam stong brdal ba'i lte bar ze'u 'bru dmar ser gyi phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba zhig bsgom/ hūm̐ las bla ma rdo rje sems: dkar gsal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: rdo rje dril 'dzin snyems ma 'khril: zhes/ de'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po rab tu phra ba gsal zhing 'tsher ba zhig yongs su gyur pa las skad 114

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig /ste/ thar lam gsal byed/cig gis ngo bo rtsaba'iblamayinapalarnamaparbecomaldana'adas rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar gsal dwangs shel dri ma med pa la nyi 'od phog pa lta bu zhi tshul dgu dang lngan pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ de yang dar chas lnga ni/ cod /dar kha dog sna tshogs pas//paṇa/ stod /dar dkar gser gyi ngang ris can gyi//g.yogazi /dar mthing khra'i cod paṇa ltag pa nas phyir 'phyang ba//ldir/ gar gyi phu /dar mthing dmar gang rung gi stod /web lta bu la phu dung thung ngu yod pa// dung / smad /tshe gu'i//dkris/rin po che'i rgyan brgyad ni/ dbu rgyan/ snyan cha/mgul rgyan/ do /lhe 'og yan 'khor ba//shal/ se mo /nu ma'i bar sleb pa'i do shal chung ba//do/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ ska /rin ngo/ che sna tshogs kyi phra tshom can//rags ste longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis mdzes par spras pa/ phyag g.yas rig stong mtshon byed rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod cing 'dzin pa/g.yon snang stong mtshon byed dril bu dkur brten pa/ zung 'jug mtshon byed yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo phyag g.yas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khrud cing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsi stob tshul can dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab rdo rje'i skyil krung dang yum pad skyil gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ de yang snang cha nas spyan gyi dkar nag tshun chad ma 'dres par gastal ba / stong cha nas gdos bcas su grub pa gang yang med pa dag pa ye shes kyis rnam 'phrul dwangs pa'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon thol gyis shar ba lte bu/rigs dang /thabs shes sogs zung 'jug gi don shes pas/ mchan// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spyi dpal chen por gsal btab la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi shes rgyud kyi sdig lhung dag pa zhig khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i smon 'jug gi sems dang ldan pas skyabs su bzung ba ni rten gyi stobs/ khyod la skyabs gsol sdig pa spyangs: zhes/ bla ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin thugs ye shes kyi mkhyen cha dang bcas pas brtse ba chen pos rjes su dgongs te 115

༄/ /rigalona'agrosilapyosbyadapa'abordorjes ma dzad/bzhugs pa'i spyanasngar/ tsherabasathogadīb blad pa nas bdag dang ma sems can thams cad kyi rgyu dug lnga dang dug gsum gyis kun nas bslang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas rang bzhin gyi sdig nga/ dang bcas pa'i sdig lhung sdom pa gsum gyi nyams chag dkon mchog gsum la log par lta ba la sogs las nyon dngos su dran pa thams cad blos blangs te/ 'gyod sems drag pos mthol lo bshags:zhes/ rang nyid ngo tsha 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa chen po dang bcas pas snying nas so sor bshags so snyam pa dang / dngos su mi dran pa'i tshe rabs nas bsags pa du ma zhig yod nges pas/ de dag thams cad ni mi 'chab bo/ /mi sped do/ /mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa de dag thams cad dus da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di ru lhag ma med par byang zhing dag pa zhig thugs rje ma chung snyam pa ni nyes byas sun 'byin gyi stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdom: zhes/ sngon chad ni bdag mi shes rmongs pa'i dbang gis mi dge sdig pa'i las de dag bgyis pa yin la/ da ni drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas khe nyen shes nga/'i rang bzhin can yin pas/ da phyin chad ni srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las 'di dang 'di lta bu mi bgyid do snyam nas yid la dam bca' ba ni nyes spyod sdom pa'i stobs/ khyod thugs zla ba rgyas pa'i steng: hūm̐ yig mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor: zhes/yab yum gnyis su med pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sran ma gleb pa tsam gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po spus bris pa lta bu'i mdun nas brtsam ste yi ge brgya pa'i yig 'bru rnams rwa langs pa lta bu gcig la gcig gis ma reg tsam du g.yas skor rim pa gsum du sbrul 'khyil pa lta bur bkod pa'i nang ma'i oṃ dang / phyi'i phaṭa gnyis thad rbe1ra 'phrod pa zhig gsal/ bzlas pa sngags kyis rgyud bskul bas: yab yum bde rol sbyor mtshams nas: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi sprin://6

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam gsal byed/ga bur rdul ltar 'dzagapayis: bdagadang /shāms gsumasems can gyi: las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgyu:nad gdon sdig sgrib tes lhung grib: ma lus byang bar mdzad du gsol: tsho/ /sngags kyi margo 'dren bkra shis pa'i don te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje snying po//badz+ra sa twa sa /rdo rje sems dpa' dam tsheg/ma ya/ ma nu pa la /rjes su skyongs shig/ya/ badz+ra sa /rdo rje sems dang 'a khyod kyis nye bar bzhugs shig/twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ drordo me /bdag la brtan par gyur cig/ bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me /bdag la dgyes pa ra mdzod// bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me /bdag la shin tu dgyes bar mdzod// bha wa/ a nu rak+to me /bdag la rjes su chags nga/ra mdzod// bha wa/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra /bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol cig/yatsā/ sarba kame n+da/ las thams cad la'ang bdag la//tsa me/ tsi t+t+waṃ /sems kyi dang/la du mdzod cig/shri yaX ku ru hūṃ/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje snying po//ha ha /me long sogs ye shes bzhi// ha ha /dbang du gyur cig/ho/bha ga /bcom ldan 'das//wān/sarba /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi//ta thā ga ta/badz+ra ma me /rdo rjes bdag la rab tu grol bar mardzog/muñca badz+rī bha /rdo rje can du mdzod//wa/ ma hā sa /dam tshig chen ngo/'i sems dang 'a//ma ya sa twa āḥ/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i snyeng ngo //hūṃ phaṭaḥ /rang lugs zhe khro ༅ song spyong pa'i yi ge sprin gyi dgongs pa yin la//de ltar sgra mtshams sbyar nas bklag na'ang / badz+ra 'bad dzar/ su to ṣ+yo su po ṣ+yo gnyis su to yo dang su po yo/ m+me pra yats+tsha ma me pra yad tsha/ badz+rī ni 'bad 'dzir/ zhes bklag pas don grub bo/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' ni rigs brgya rigs lnga gsang chen rigs gcig gi bdag nyid yin pas sngags don dang bklag tshul mtha' gcig tu bzung bar mi bya'o/ /don lha sngags kyi thugs rje dang nus pa la the tshom med pa'i dad pa brtan po dang ldan pas sngags don ltar gsol 'debs kyi tshul du rdo rje sems dpa' sngags yi ge brgya pa'i gzugs su shar ba yin pa'i nges shes dang bcas pas 117

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrobol)sdodapa'abordorjes ma dzad/dmigs 'dun rtsegacigagigazhanadumigaskrejisapa'inganganas sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul gyis bzlas pas thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las ngo bo thugs rje la rnam pa bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ga bur gyi rdul ltar zhes zla ba zhun ma lta bu ngang nar gyis babs/ sku'i dbyibs gang snyom par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byung pad+ma'i sdong bu la 'khril ba'i tshul gyis rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te/shwa 'ud chen po'i sna la sbur mi chags pa ltar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i rgyus bskyed pa'i sngon las 'phral rkyen gyi nad thams cad khrag rul dang rnag rul/ de bzhin du gdon thams cad srog chags stom sdig sbal sbrul nya lcong shig la sogs pa'i rnam pa/ sdig sgrib thams cad dud sol khu rlang sngo dmar gyi rnam pas rkang mthil dang dbang pe'i sgo gnyis ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas nag nyil gyis phyir thon te/ sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje glang dmar po'i rnam par kha gdangs pa'i lto bar tshud pas dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bslus/ de'i 'khor lan chags sha 'khon gyi bdag po bdag mo thams cad kyis zos shing 'thung rab tu dga' zhing tshim nas bu lon sod/sha 'khon khyer/lan chags byang / thams cad rang gnas su log ste phyin chad gnod pa'i bsam sbyor spangs nas byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa rgyud la skyes par bsam la bzla/de yang dmigs pa thams cad cig car du gsal nus na de ltar bya/ de ltar mi nus tshe gdan dang thugs srog sogs la rim par dmigs te zhag grangs kyi bar du re re nas sbyangs dgos byung na'ang rang mgo rang gis mi g.yog par gsal snang thon par bya dgos pas sems grim lhod ran pas bzlas pa ji ltar rigs pa bya/mthar sdig lhung thams cad lhag med du dag rang lus snang stong 'od kyi rnam par gyur pa'i lus dbus su/rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi bcas gsal la/ de yang rtsa 'khor rnams gyes mdor rtsa /18

༄7//sngona'agro'ikhridayig/ste/rtethar lam/ gsal byed/gsum sbu ba gcig tu gyur pa las gdugs rkyi rtsib ma brgyangs nga/ lta bu'i sbyi bor bde chen gyi rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis bdud rtsis gang /bum dbang thob/lus sgrib dgadaga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang /sprul sku'i sa bon thebs/mgrin par bab pas rtsa 'dab bcu drug gang /gsang dbang thob/nyon sgrib dag mchog dga'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ rtsa rlung bsgom pa dang sngags bzla ba la dbang / longs sku'i sa bon thebs/ snying gar babs pas rtsa 'dab brgyad gang /sher dbang thob/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dgakhyad par gyi dga' ba rgyud la skyes/'bar 'dzags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang /chos sku'i sa bon thebs/ lte bar babs pas rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi gang /tshig dbang thob/bag chags kyi sgrib pa dgalhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa la dbang /ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon thebs/mthar sor mo'i rtse mo tshun chod shel bum 'o mas gang ba ltar du gyur pa'i rkyen gyis lus sems zag med kyi bde bas khyab par mos la/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis: dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams:bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig:gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste: thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can: 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi: sku ga༄/nga thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes nongs tshig brjod ma thag bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' thugs dgyes pas zhal 'dzum mdangs su bzhad cing /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib tes lhung thams cad dag pa yin no zhes gnang ba byin te bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs sogs ma 'dres shing yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam 9

sgo/ /rega'adzina'agrosilash+lauhūṃdapa'abordorjes ma jad/pār gsul la/ deyangachulasachuburardol— rib ltabuskudang ye shes tha dad med par ye nas dag pa'i don shes bzhin/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag skyon nun zad yon tan kun rdzogs don gyi bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' nga'o snyam pa'i nges shes brtan po dang bcas pa'i skur gsal pa'i thugs kar zla dkyil gyi dbus su hūm̐ mthing gi de'i mdun du oṃ dkar po/ g.yas su badz+ra ser po/ rgyab tu sa dmar po/ g.yon tu twa ljang gu rnams sbus bris pa tsam du dmigs/ de la sems zhugs pa ltar ma yengs par gtad de/ skyed badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ zhes bzlas pas gsal snang thon pa ni bsnyen pu/ yig 'bru rnams las rang mdog gi 'od zer mchod sprin gyi rnam pa dparge tu med pa 'phros/ zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas brgyud gsum rtsa gsum rgya mtsho tshogs la thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam nga sa yig 'bru rnams la thim/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub lam dang 'brel ba rig 'dzin bzhi dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu mi slob pa zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du gyur par bsam nas bzlas pa ni nye bar bsnyen pa zhes rang don chos sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin/ yang 'od zer grangs med pa 'phros/ khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad mun par nyi ma shar ba ltar dag phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad mngon par dga' ba'i zhing dang / nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam la bzla ba ni sgrub pa/ las dang po pas 'od zer rigs drug so so'i gnas su rim par spro baṃsdu byas na bde la/ gang ltar yang 'od zer 'phros pas bcud rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs gsal ba la phog pas/ de dag gi zhal dang zin pa dang ma zin pa'i sgra thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūṃ/120

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig /ste rtethar lamagasal byed/zhes bung ba'itshangazhigapaltara'uradiri(sgroges par bsam nas bzla ba ni sgrub pā rnyen sto zhes gzhan don gzugs sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin/ dmigos gnad 'di lta bu la brten nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa thabs la mkhas pa'i gnad kyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang skad cig la rdzogs shing / nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can gyi don yang sgrub nus pa yin/ de ltar bzlas pa ci rigs byas pa'i mthar/ snod bcud rdor sems rigs lnga'i lha tshogs su gsal ba thams cad rim gyis 'od du zhu nas rang la bsdu / rang yang gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ badz+ra la thim/badz+ra sa la thim/ sa twa la thim/ twa hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la thim/ zhabs kyu 'a chung la thim/ 'a chung ha khog la thim/ ha khog zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/thig le na dwa'i bar rim bzhin bsdu / na dā shin tu phra ba la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag mthar na dā yang nam mkha' 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar dmigs pa ni las sbyor te kun rdzob bskyed rim la brten pa'i sgrib sbyong dang / de'i ngang du lha sngags kyi spros pa 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngang du bsdus te sbyang bya spyong byed kyi rtog tshogs thams cad gzod ma nas rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i rig stong don gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i rang zhal blta zhing yi ge brgya pa'am/ yig drug yid bzlas cung tsam bya ba ni/ gnyis pa don dam rdzogs rim la brten pa'i sgrib sbyong khyad par can yin te/ mtshan brjod las/ thig le stong pa yi ge brgya/ /zhes dang / me tog bkod pa'i rgyud las/ rang byung yi ge brgya pa'i mthus/ /sgrib pa rnam gnyis byang bar 'gyur/ /zhes thig le thabs snying rje dang / stong pa shes rab ste stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi ngang du bshags pa 'di cher zab la/chos 'byung ba med pa'i mdo las/ gang chos bdag med cing rnam par smin pa med par shes na/ de las kyi sgrib pa rnam par nga/ga pa thob bo/ /zhes sogs lung shin tu mang ngo / //21

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrod+kulasmyirā dpa'abordorjes ma dzad/sdig pa chen po bdag 'dzin yin pas gnyeneri po bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes ches cher bsngags so/ /slar snod bcud rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin bkra lam gyis gsal la/ dge ba 'di yis myur tu bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /sogs bsngo smon bya ba rnams ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs so/ /de la sngags bzla lugs la'ang rag bzlas dang yid bzlas gnyis/ dang po ni sngags sgra ha cang che ba ma yin chung ba ma yin/ ha cang mgyogs che ba dang dal che ba yang ma yin/ yig 'bru dang 'dogs dang bu drug chad lhag med pa ste skyon drug spang la bzla/ gnyis pa rdor bzlas la'ang rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang yid bzlas gnyis las/ yid bzlas ni mchog sgrub pa la gtso che bar gsung pas de ltar na lce rtsa mi 'gul par yid kho nas bzla/ rlung bzlas ni 'byin 'jug gnas gsum sngags kyi sgrar shes pas bzlas pa yin/ gang ltar yang yid gzhan du ma yengs pa dang ngag bcad de bzla ba gal che ste/ rgyud las kyang / gal te ting 'dzin 'di med na/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jing gi pha wong bzhin/ /bskal bar bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes dang / dag dang ma dag stong 'gyur yin/ /ting 'dzin yod med 'bum 'gyur yin/ /zhes dang /o rgyan chen ngo sa/ lo gcig 'bag bzlas byed pa bas/ /zla gcig smra bcad byed pas dga'/ /zhes de ltar bzlas pa sngags kyi phan yon kyang / dri med bshags rgyud las/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi yang snying nyams chags dang rtog sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa/ yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba bshags pa thams cad kyi rgyal po 'di dus gcig la lan brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas na nyams chags thams cad skong ste/ ngan song gsum du lhung ba las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis yid dam du bcas nas 'don na mi de tshe 'di la'ang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras kyi dam par dgongs nas bsrung skyob 122

༄7//sngona'agro'ikhridayig /ste/rdothar lamagasal byed/mdzad la/shi 'phos nas kyang / bde bar k+kashegs pa rnams kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ /zhes rdo rje sems dpas zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rgyud lung rnams su phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs kyang yi ge mang dogs pas ma bris so/ /mdor na rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig la nyams chag gang byung yang / nyin re bzhin tho rangs mi tshig dang ma 'dres gong rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin lan nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas na/ des ltung ba byin gyis brlabs pa zhes/rnam smin gong 'phel du mi 'gro/ yi ge brgya pa 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na lhung ba thams cad rtsa ba nas dag pa ni snyi nga po rgyan las/ pad dkar zla ba'i gdan gnas par/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs dmigs te/ /yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas gyur na/ /lhung sogs byin gyis brlab 'gyur phyir/ /'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ /grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ /rtag par du ni nyams su blangs/ /'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas gyur na/ /rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/mi skya pho mo yan chad phal cher dbang re thob ma myong ba ni su yang med/ dbang thob tshad ni gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa yin pas de'i dam tshig ma bsrung na dmyal ba dang / bsrung na sangs rgyas kyi spo 'phang gnyis las 'gro sa gzhan med de/yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/sngags la zhugs pa'i skyes bu ngan song dang / /sangs rgyas gnyis las 'gro sa gsum pa med/ /zhes pa ltar/ da lta rang re gnyen po chung ba dran pa nyams pa/ shes bzhin med pa/ lhung ba'i rnam grangs legs par mi shes pa rnams la ni/ dam tshig nyams chag char bzhin 'bab par gdon mi za/ gal te rang ngos nas dam tshig nyams pa'i skyon cher ma byung yang / gzhan rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa dag dang gtam bsre ba dang / spyod lam gyis 'brel pa/23

༄/ /riga'adzena'agrobolazlo/ byedapa'abordorjes ma dzad/tha na lung pagacig gichulabatungakyangar+shazlarme nyams dang zhor nyams kyi nyes pa bskyed pa yin pas bshags sdom la 'bad pa gal che/ rgyud las kyang / nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa bskang ba dang / /nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang / /nyams la mi 'jem nyams pa de dag gis/ /nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal/ /zhes pa ltar bla slob dang rdo rje mched lcam rdo rje nang dme byas pa'i gnas de'i sa yang tshig ste ma rung bar 'gyur bas/ slar bshags sbyangs nan tan ma byas na phyis sa der su 'dug 'di phyi kun tu mi dge ba dang / ci tsam bsgrub kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung bar gsungs pa dang / tshogs gral gcig na dam tshig nyams pa'i mi gcig yod kyang / de'i nyams grib kyis dam lden brgya stong yod kyang sgrub pa'i 'bras bu cung zad kyang mi 'byin pa 'o ma rul ba thigs gcig gis ma rul ba zangs gang yang rul bar byed pa ltar/ ji skad du/ rnal 'byor nyams pa can gcig gis/ /rnal 'byor can kun ma rung byed/ /ces so//gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig ni sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum gyi khyer so dang skad cig ma gcig bral kyang dam tshig las 'das par gsungs pas na bsrung dka'/ rgyas par dbye na sa ya 'bum sde'i grangs su gsungs pas rnam grangs mang la/ nyams pa'i nyes pa yang / rgyud las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gros snying khrag 'thung ba dang / /tshe thung nad mang nor yal dgras 'jigs dang / /mnar med dmyal ba shin tu skyi g.ya' bar/ /sdug bsngal mi bzod yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes pas/ rang gi blo la mngon pa dang mi mngon pa'i nyams chag nyes lhung thams cad kyi gnyen por dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bla ma rdo rje sems dpa/'a bsgom la yi ge brgya pa yi dam du bzung nas bshags sbyangs la 'bad pa gal che'o/ /nyan thos kyi lugs la rtsa lhung skor gcig byung na rdza be'u chag pa dang 'dra ste/ slar 124

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / rtse thar lam gsal byed/gso ba'i thabs medaparagasungasal/ byengarwanimarinapochenyer spyad chag pa dang 'dra ste/ mgar ba mkhas pa la brten nas bcos su skusnad pa ltar/ gzhan rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas gso rung / gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ni/rin po che'i nyer spyad cung zad zhom pa dang 'dra ste/ rang nyid kyis lha sngags ting nge 'dzin la brten nas bshags pa byas na dag par gsungs pa yin/de yang 'phral du bshags na 'dag sla ste/ yun lon nas nyes pa gong 'phel du 'gro ba yin pas bshags dka' zhing / lo gsum 'das phan chad bshags pa'i yul ma yin no/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' ni rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi spyi dpal yin pas/yi dam gyi lha zhi khro rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kyang / rdo rje sems dpa' la ma 'dus pa med pa dang / ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med du bsgom pas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgom pa zhes shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug pa yin/ sngags kyang snying po yi ge brgya pa las lhag pa med tshul sngar bshad pa ltar yin no/ /'di lta bu'i gdams pa dang 'phrad nas nyams su len pa'i skal ldan du gyur pa ni rgyu bsod nams tshad med pa'i 'bras bu yin pa la nges shes brtan pos dran pa gsos 'debs shing / gong bshad ltar bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa gal che/de ji bzhin mi shes pa'i blun pos kyang lha sngags ye shes so so ma yin tha dad med nga/'i go ba dang bcas bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong dus 'gyod sdom snying thag pa nas byed nga/ dang / bdag bskyed skabs rang blo 'khrul ngor tsam las/ don la snod bcud ye nas lha'i rang bzhin tu dag pa'i nges shes bskyed/ thags bcad sngags gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bklag lugs gong bshad tsam las ha cang mi spros par the tshom med pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa kho na gtsor 'don pa gal che ste/ rgyud las/ yang na blun po dad pa brtan/ /de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub nye/ /zhes so/ /'di las zab 125

༄/ /riga'adzena'agrosilash+lauṭ+wāṃdapa'abordorjes ma dzad/pa'i chos gzhan namedaparashesaparabya'o/ ri/skosdigasgribasbyong bar byed pa bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i khrid kyi rim pa'o// / /don bzhi pa bsod nams kyi tshogs la brten nas ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid la gsum/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'bul ba'i tshul/ phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po/bsod nams kyi tshogs la ma brten par 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs mi rdzogs pas na maṇ+ḍal 'bul dgos/ mdo las/ ji srid tshogs gnyis dam pa de ni ma rdzogs par/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / til+li pas/ bu snang ba rtenacing 'brel 'byung 'di/ /don skye ba med par ma rtogs par/ /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'phang lo la/ /'bral bar ma byed nā ro pa/ /zhes so/ /spyir tshogs bsags pa'i thabs mang yang bya sla la chod che ba maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba 'di yin no / / gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i chul ni/ rang lugs kyi phyag len la bsgrub pa dang mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gnyis yod/ maṇ+ḍal gyi rgyu ni/ rab gser dngul/ 'bring li zangs/ tha na gyo mo dang rdo shing sogs ngos 'jam la bzo dbyibs legs pa/'god rgyu'i tshom bu yang / rab rin po che sna tshogs/ 'bring sman sna tshogs/ tha ma 'bru'i rigs byed/ nges par ma 'byor tshe rdo dang gseg ma sogs kyis kyang dmigs rten tsam du rung / dang po bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal byi dor legs par byas/ dri bzang gi chu'am/ mar gyis sbags pa'i 'bru tshom lnga'am dgu bkod/ rang gi mdun thad mchod stegs steng du bzhag la mchod pa'ang ci 'byor dang bcas dmigs rten bya/ mdun mkhar sku gsum gyi ngo bo bla ma dang rgyal ba sras bcas tshogs zhing du dmigs la/ gnyis pa mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal lag g.yon pas bzung nas/ g.yas nga/'i mkhrig mas phyi bzhin yid gzhan du ma yengs par yi ge brgya pa dang / yan lag bdun pa sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ sku gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa kun mkhyen 126

rdzo de stong|༷/ 95 sto ge mar༄tsho//sngona'agra' dayag///rdzuthar lamagasal byad/klong chen pa'i zhal gsungs bla ma yang thag yid bzhin nor bu'i lugs sam/yang na 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa'i lugs tshom bu so bdun ma gang rung sngon du 'bul na yongs grags kyi phyag len ltar bya/ rang lugs sku gsum maṇ+ḍal la/dang po thun mong sprul sku'i zhing khams 'bul ba ni/oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥzhes/dri bzang gis chus maṇ+ḍal gyi steng khyab par byugs shing / lcags ri yod na dgod/tshom bu dbus dang phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi dang dgu bkod la/ stong gsum 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing:rin chen sna bdun lha mi'i 'byor bas gtams:bdag lus longs spyod bcas pa yongs 'bul gyis: chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i srid thob shog: zhes gling bzhi tshangs ris kyi lha gnas dang bcas pa de gcig tu brtsis nas/ de 'dra ba stong song ba'i tshe stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten zhes bya/stong spyi phud kyi 'jig rten na/gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten stong yod nga/ de gcig tu brtsis te/ de 'dra ba'i spyi phud kyi 'jig rten stong song ba'i tshe/ stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten zhes bya/ stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten de gcig tu brtsis nas/de 'dra ba stong song ba'i tshe/ stong gsum gyi stong chen lo 'jig rten du 'dod la/ des na gling bzhi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya zhes khyon dung phyur bcu yod pa ni sangs rgyas sprul sku gcig gi 'dul zhing yin/de lta bu'i zhing khams grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag na lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun bkra shis pa'i rdzas rtags brgyad/ nye ba'i rin chen bdun/byang chub sems dpa'i thugs bskyed las byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing dang /gter gyi bum pa bzang po/yid bzhin gyi nor bu/nad gsos kyi sman/'chi med bcud len gyi bdud rtsi/ga༈ yang sman dang shing gi skyed mos tshal mang po/rin po che'i bya rigs dang ri dwags kyi tshogs mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba du ma ṭ+wāṃgs
