༄/ /riga'ajina'agrosil ༷rdo dpa'abordorjes ma dzad/lha dang mi lasa'adasapadangama'adasat+pa'irbekodapa blos dpog par dka' ba bdag pos yongs su bzung ba dang ma bzung pa'i mchod 'os ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad dang / de'i steng du rang gi lus longs spyod mnga' ris phun tshogs dang bcas pa mdor na 'dzin sems kyis gces dgur bzung ba thams cad ser sna 'jur gegs kyis ma bcings par ma lus shing lus pa med pa dus gsum gyi dge tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad blos blangs nas kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur dmigs te bla ma sprul sku'i lha tshogs la ltos med du 'bul ba ni bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen po thun mong sprul sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ gnyis pa longs sku'i zhing khams 'bul ba ni/ yod na lcags ri gnyis pa 'god/ tshom bu dbus dang phyogs bzhi dang lnga bkod de/ 'og min bde chen stug po bkod pa'i zhing: nges pa lnga ldan rigs lnga'i tshom bu can: 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam yas pa: phul bas longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog: ces/ de'i steng gi nam mkhar thun min longs sku'i maṇ+ḍal rang snang 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams ye shes rin po che'i gzhal med khang sku dang zhing khams ye nas lhun gyis grub pa la sgeg sogs 'dod yon gyi lha mo grangs med pas spras pa blos dpog par dka' ba/ bla ma longs sku'i lha tshogs la dus rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor 'bul bar dmigs pa ni / thun min longs sku'i maṇ+ḍal/ gsum pa 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i zhing khams 'bul ba ni/ yod na lcags ri gsum pa bzhag la tshom bu gcig bkod de/snang srid rnam dag gzhon nu bum pa'i sku: thugs rje ma 'gags chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan: sku dang thig le'i 'dzin pa rnam dag zhing: phul bas chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog: ces/de'i steng gi dbyings la khyad par chos sku'i maṇ+ḍal skye med gdod ma'i gzhi la 'gags med 'od gsal gyi snang cha rig pa tshad phebs kyi tshom bur bkod pa ste/128

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig ri thar lam/ gsal byed/de ltar go sla ba'i phyiratsamadangasprosapatsamalarī gamatshamasaso sor dmigs rim dang tshom bu bkod tshul bzhag pa yin gyis/ don sku gsum gyi zhing 'bul bya 'bul byed kyi dmigs pa'i bye brag rnams so sor mi byed par/ rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i rang snang gi zhing khams steng 'og sogs kyis gzhal bya ma dmigs par de dag gi rdul phra rab re re'i khongs su rdul de snyed kyi zhing khams yangs dog med cing cir yang 'char ba'i chos nyid rang shar lhun gyis grub pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa'i tshul khong du chud pa'i ngang nas mos gus gdung ba dang bcas pas phul dgos la/ las dang po lhongs su ma gyur pa dag gi chos dbyings bsam mi khyab pa'i zhing khams sku gsum gyi bkod pa ji ltar yod pa de ltar du 'bul snyam pa'i 'dun pa'i nges shes gal che/ gang ltar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang /nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ mthar thug sku gsum gyi zhing khams rgya mtshor longs spyad du gsol snyam pa'i mos gus bya/ mthar maṇ+ḍal tshogs zhing dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes dar zhing rgyas par bsam la ma bcos ye grol gyi ngang du ci gnas su bzhag slar bzang po spyod pa sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab pa'o/ /grangs gsog skabs dka' tshegs khyad du bsad de spro sems dang ldan pa'i brtson 'grus dang le lo sogs la bzod pa'i sgo nas rab rang gzhung ltar sku gsum maṇ+ḍal kho na'am/ bsdu na sa gzhi spos chus sogs/ tshom bu bdun ma gsog thun mgor rgyas pa gang rung re bya/ dam pa gsum gyi rtsis zin pa gal che ba ni thams cad la 'dra'o/ /rang la 'byor ba yod na nas 'bras sogs dri bzang gi chus sbags nas kha dog ser po bya ste mchod 'bru rnying pa yang zlos mi bya zhing gsar pa kho nas 'bul la/ rnying ba rnams bya bye'u dang sprang long sogs la sbyin par gtong 129

sgo/ /riga'ajena'agrolpolarnik+to dpa'abordorjes mdzad/ba'am/ rtenadrungaduspungasate'ajog nga rgengaprungalasarang gis bdag tu bzung nas longs mi spyad/ de tsam ma 'byor na yang ci 'byor ba'i tshod du mchod 'bru brje/de yang ma 'byor na 'bul thebs gcig gis mchod 'bru yang yang phul kyang rung /gang ltar bsam pa dag pa dang ci 'byor gyi dngos po gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhig cis kyang dgos/ nges par dngos 'byor gyi cha rkyen mi 'dzom pa dang / 'dzom kyang mi spro ba'i dus dmigs gnad dang ldan pas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas 'bul ba rber+shags chosags bsags pa'i thabs la 'bad pa ni lam gyi gnas skabs thams cad du 'dor du mi rung ba'i nyams len yin/ gsum pa phan yon ni/ tshe 'dir ci bsam 'grub/ mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub thob pa ni/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu ma nor ba yin pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ma rdzogs par sangs rgyas sku gnyis kyi 'bras bu thob thabs med pa sngar yang bstan la/mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas kyang / dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing / /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa sku gnyis thob par rbesnag /ces pa ltar/ dmigs bcas bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pas gzugs sku dam pa dang / dmigs med ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pas chos sku dam pa thob pa yin no/ /rgyal ba'i sras po byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni tshogs bsags dang /sgrib spyong gang byed kyang / nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i sems can gyi don du byed pa nyag gcig yin pas/ rang gi tshe 'di'i ched du sgrub pa lta yang ci smos/ rang don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod kyang theg pa chen po'i lam dang 'gal na/ tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gang byed kyang sems can gyi don du dmigs pa las/ rang 'dod kyi blo dang ma 'dres pa zhig gal che'o/ /de ltar byas na rang don dang tshe 'di'i bde skyid sogs mi 'dod kyang zhar la 'byung ste/ me 130

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig /sti/rdothar lamagasal byed/'bud pa'i zhar la du ba 'byung ba dang / nas botab pas sog ma zhar la 'byung ba ltar yin pas na/ rang don ched gnyer gyi blo ni spang bar bya'o/ /tshogs bsags pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid kyi rim pa'o// //lnga pa bdud bzhi cig car du bcom pa ku swā li'i tshogs/ bsagres ni/ spyir sems nyid ngal bso nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar lus kyi mchod pa 'byung yang / skabs su bab pa phyag dre pa bzhin maṇ+ḍal gyi yan lag tu 'dir 'chad par bya la/ de yang ku swa li zhes pa ni sprang po ste/ bya btang ri khrod pa lta bu tshogs bsags pa'i longs spyod gzhan mi rnyed pa rnams dang / bdag 'dzin btsan thabs su gcod par 'dod pas rang lus mchod sbyin bya ba yin te/ longs spyod kyi dngos po gzhan brgya stong mchod sbyin byas pa las 'di khyad du 'phags shing phan yon tshad med de/ ji skad du/ rta dang glang po brgya 'gyur yin/ /bu dang chung ma stong 'gyur yin/ /lus kyi mchod sbyin 'bum 'gyur yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag gi gces par 'dzin pa'i gtso bo lus 'di yin pas lus mchod sbyin tsam du ma zad bdag 'dzin gyi 'khri ba btsan thabs su gcod pa'i thabs kyang yin cing bya sla la chod che ba'i gnad kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa la/ mdun mkhar rin po che khri rkang dar zab 'bol brtsegs sogs rab tu mdzes pa'i steng du zhing lpags kyi gdan la drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid he ru ka pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'i chas can phyag g.yas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru 'brol stabs dang g.yon bhan thod bcud ldan dkur brten tshul zhabs rol stabs su bzhugs pa'i 'khor du brgyud gsum rig pa 'dzin pa rnams dang sangs rgyas dang byang sems/ yi dam sgyu 'phrul zhi ba dang khro bo gnas yul lhan skyes kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro ste srid zhu'i mgron dang /ye shes dang las las grub nga/'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can mgon po yon tan gyi mgron rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ 'og tu dus gsum gyi pha mar 131

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrobolasnibye dpa'abordorjes rma dzad/gyur pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug snying rje mgron/ sngon las 'phral rkyen gyi gnod byed log 'dren gdon bgegs/ khyad par du dug gsum rang khar shor ba'i pho gdon rgyal po/ mo gdon bsen mo/ klu gdon sa bdag sogs bu lon lan chags kyi mgron rnams dang / gzhan yang khas zhan dbang chung glo bur du lhags pa'i mgron lhag ma la re ba rnams dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab la/ nang bdag tu 'dzin byed yul can sems kyis phyi 'khrul snang zag bcas kyi phung po sogs bdag tu bzung nas 'chi med gnyug ma'i ye shes la sgrib par byed pa'i lam gyi bar chad tshe 'dir zhen pa lha bu'i bdud btsan thabs su gcod pa'i phyir/ rang gi sems rnam par shes pa de nyid thig le dkar po sran ma tsam pa zhig gsal la/phaṭaḥces brjod pa dang chab gcig dbu ma'i lam brgyud de tshangs bug nas rgyangs se thon pa'i mod la ro de gan rkyal du ling nger 'gyel te rnam shes dbyings su thim par dmigs la/ dbyings rig dbyer med kyi ngang du dal cig bzhag pas 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ slar rig gdangs chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul gyis rang byung ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro khros ma mthing nag dar dang rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ spyi bor phag zhal gyis mtshan pa can du gsal ba'i phyag g.yas nyon mongs skye shi'i bdud rtsad nas gcod cing 'joms byed ye shes gsum mtshon gyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar bas/ ngar 'dzin phung po'i bdud ro de nyid kyi thod pa smin mtshams nas bral te/ phyag g.yon pa las byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i tshul gyis stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i thod pa de nyid blangs nas/ sku gsum mtshon pa'i mi mge'i sgyed pu ri rab tsam gsum gyi khar bzhag par dmigs la/lus gces 'dzin bor bas lha bdud chom: sems tshangs pa'i sgo nas dbyings la thon: 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom khros mar gyur: g.yas nyon mongs bdud bcom gri gug gis: gzugs phung po'i bdud bcom thod pa bregs: g.yon las byed /32

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig shrī rdo thar lam gsal byed/tshul gyis bhan+dha thogs: skugasumagyimimago②sgyedapurabazhag: nang stong gsum gang ba'i bam ro de: zhes slar phyag gi gri gug gis ro de nyid la reg pa tsam gyis rdo khab len gyis lcags rdul blangs pa ltar len te thod pa'i nang du bskyur ba/ da lta'i lus 'di lta bu ma yin par rab tu che ba stong gsum dang mnyam pa/ tsho zhing snum pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba srid na rin thang bral ba zhig tu gyur pa de nyid la slar yang phyag gi gri gug tshad tsam byas pas dum bur sil bur gtub nas spu ngas par bsam la/ a thung dang haṃ yig gis bdud rtsir bzhu: 'bru gsum gyi nus pas sbyangs spel bsgyur: zhes thod pa'i 'og tu sgyed pu gsum gyi sum mdor shes rab kyi rang bzhin a /dmar ngo 'am ḍa log gang rung / mchan//thung las ye shes kyi me bde drod kyi rnam pa can 'u ru ru 'bar bas thod pa'i nang gi sha rus khol/rlangs pa steng gi thabs bde ba chen po rang bzhin haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan du gnas pa la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag ste zhu zhing khol/ oṃ brjod pas bdag khros ma/'i thugs ka nas oṃ yig dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros te thim pas ma dag pa'i dnges po thams cad rlangs pa sngo dmar gyi rnam par phyir thon te sbyangs/ ā /dmar/ mchan//brjod cing 'phros pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab par spel/ hūm̐/mthing / mchan//brjod cing 'phros pas ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnamaX pa/kha dog dkar ngo zla zhun lta bu spris ma dmar ser gur gum gyi khu ba lta bus khyab 1 pa reb tu mdzes shing mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa/ dri 'jig rten na bzang dzo zhing ngad pa dang ldan pa ji snyed yod pa thams cad gcig tu bosdus pa lta bu tshor ba ( tsam gyis gdug pa'i bsam sbyor thams cad zhi zhing lus sems bde bas tshim pa/1 dwo kha mngar skyur ba lan tshwa sogs 'jig rten gyi ro bcud nus pa thams cad ཿ gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu myang ba tsam gyis zag med bde ba'i zas kyis 'tsho ba/133

༄/ /rega'adzina'agrolpol droXdapa'abordorjes ma/dzad/nus pas mchodayulalhatshogasakunagyihūṃgasum̐ngathugasakyidagyes pa skong ba sbyin sum̐l lha srin sde brgyad kyi gdug rtsub dang sdug bsngal zhi nas byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skye bar byed pa/ rigs drug so se'i las snang gi sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral te 'di phyi phan bde la sbyor ba/ bgegs rigs lan chags kyi bdag po rnams kyi lan chags sha 'khon thams cad byang nas gnas skabs bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang / mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la sbyor ba/lhag mar dbang ba'i mgron/ zha bo rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ long ba shes rab kyi miga'on pa chos nyid kyi sgra/phongs pa 'dod yon gyi gter dang lngan par byed pa'i zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod rgu yid bzhin gyi sprin phung zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āhūm̐/ zhes mang du brjod cing rang nyid khros ma'i thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo rin po che'i snod sna tshogs dang bhan thod thogs pa nyi rdul lta bu dpag tu med pa spros te/ bdud rtsi'i phud kyis dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron la gus pa'i tshul gyis mchod cing /bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang semadra'irnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga pa spu gu can dang /yi dam dang mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogasakyi rang rang gi rigs dang mtshungs pa'i 'khor lo rdo rje/ rin chen pad+ma rgya gram sogs kyis mtshan pa'i ljags dang / yon tan gyi mgron ye shes pa'i chos skyong pho rgyud rnams kyi ljags ral gri dang / mo rgyud rnams kyi ljags gri gug gi rnam pa/ gter srung dam can gzhi bdag dang bcas pa'i ljags nyi zer gyi rnam pa'i spu gus bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs shing gsol bas thugs ༄spyad zag med bde bas tshim te bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob/yon tan mgron gyis sngon gyi tha tshig rjes su dran nas ci 'dod pa'i sdong grogs dang phrin las sgrub par bsam/ mar mgron rnams la snod ye shes kyi ka pā lar /34

ོ gzhe'i 'i 1༄6 rī༄7//sngana'agra'akhradayag// zhuthar lamagasal byad/bcud zag med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba re re bzhan sbyin pa'am/yang na thod pas bdud rtsi bcus nas 'thor bas char babs pa ltar 'phang med du sbyin pas thams cad mnyes shing tshim/so so'i las snang gi sdug bsngal dang bral/ lus sems bde bas gang / bu lon lan chags sha 'khon thams cad byang / byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la lhang nger skyes par bsam pa rnams ni bdud rtsi dkar 'gyed kyi dmigs pa'o//yang khra 'gyed dmigs bsal spro na/ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa 'dod rgu'i longs spyod gang la ci 'dod so so'i spyod yul du de ltar 'char ba'i nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo'i sprin chen por slar bsgyur nas mgron bzhi la 'bul zhing sbyin pas/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis dgasku gnyis mngon du gyur par mos/gang ltar yang gzhung tshig dmigs bsal dngos bstan ltar/khyad par du btsan dang / rgyal 'gong /dam sri mo 'dre bsen mo/ che 'dre chung sri sogs gnod byed gdug pa can gyi tshogs dang / lhag ma'i mgron bcas la zas gos nor phyugs gnas mal/mkhar khang /khyo shug bzhon pa la sogs so so'i gang 'dod kyi longs spyod gcig las du mar 'char ba dang gzhan yang rgyu gti mug gis bskyed pa'i klu dang sa bdag rnams la/ne'u seng dang me tog sna tshogs dang ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i skyed mos tshal mang po chu rta sogs dkor nor/rin po che'i bang mdzod mang po/nad gsos kyi klu sman sna tshogs/ngang ngur sogs chu bya'i rigs gyur/ rin po che'i khang bzang mang po mdor na gang 'dod kyi longs spyod dang / sha khrag rus pa bdud rtsi'i phung por dmigs nas sbyin pas zad med du longs spyod thams cad dga' zhing tshim/lan chags dang bu lon sod/ lus kyi nad dang sems kyi sdug bsngal gnod cing gdug pa'i bsam pa ngan nga/ thams cad zhi/bde skyid kyi snang ba rgyas//dī chub

༄/ /riga'adzina'agro5lapyobye dpa'abordorjes ma dzad/kyi sems rinapochebacosamamayinapar+ghaṃd rla skyes/ lus 'ja' tshon gyi sku dang /sems kyi 'khrul rtog thams cad chos sku'i dbyings su nub nas gnas 'gyur bar bsam/ de ltar rim can dang / dmigs pas chun na/ ngo bo bdud rtsi la rnam pa gong smos ltar dmigs pa gcig gis dkar 'gyed/ khra 'gyed/ dmar 'gyed gsum ga tshang par byas nas 'bru gsum dang / phaṭaḥ'ajam zhing ring pa brjod la/skabs su phaṭaḥdrag la thung ba brjod de bya byed kyi rtog tshogs dbyings su la bzla/yang / sngar ltar lan grangs dmigasakhapa bya 'khorig rtsal sbyang / gang ltar mthar/phaṭaḥces/ mchod bya dang mchod yul sogs gzung 'dzin gyi rtog tshogasathams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i sems kyi gshis lugs 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i dbyings su sbyangs shing 'khor gsum gyi mtshan ma dang bral ba'i ngang nas/yar mchod yul mgron gyi thugs dam bskangs: tshogs rdzogs nas mchog thun dngos grub thob: mar 'khor ba'i mgron mnyes lan chags byang: khyad par du gnod byed bgegs rigs tshims:nad gdon dang bar chad dbyings su zhi: rkyen ngan dang bdag 'dzin rdul du brlags mthar mchod bya dang mchod yul ma lus kun: gshis rdzogs pa chen por ma bcos u de ltar rang gi blo dang mtshams pas bsags sbyangs 'di la nan tan du byas na tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ goms na nad gdon rkyen ngan gyi lam khyer gzhan la ltos mi dgos pa 'di kho nas chog pas/dmigs pa'i spros pa ma cig gi gcod kyi man ngag dang / spros med rang lugs gsang gcod rdo rje lam bstan gzhan thun mong blo sbyangs sogs rang rgyud la gang 'byor nyams su len cing lam khyer bye brag bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /ku sā la'i tshogs gsog pa'i khrid kyi rim pa'o// //drug pa rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyud la bskyed pa'i thabs thams cad kyi mthar thugabyin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid la gsum/ dang po /36

sa tsho sa ra/gri 95 / dzog༄7//sngana'agra' dayag// rdzuthar lamagasal byad/la'ang /bla ma bsten tshul/tshul bzhin bsten pa'i phan yon gnyis las/dang ngo bsten tshul ni/ gang zag tshe 'dir grol bar 'dod pa'i rigs can skal ldan rnams kyis bsten bya/brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i tshe rabs kyi bla ma rnyed na rab/ min kyang rang gis yid ches shing khung bcun pa zhig la bsten/ de yang bsten lo tsam ma yin par yon to gyi ngos nas sangs rgyas dang mnyam la/ bka' drin ni sangs rgyas stong las kyang lhag snyam pa'i nges shes kyi dad pa brtan po dag snang dang bcas pas mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsten dgos/ gnyis pa tshul bzhin bsten pa'i phan yon ni/spyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying po bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa kho na yin pa rgyud sde thams cad zhal mthun pas/gzhan bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa las kyang lhag par gsungs te/rgyud las/gang gis bskal pa bye ba ru/lha sku 'bum phrag bsgom pa bas//bla ma skad cig dran pa mchog/zhes so//khyad par rang bawo rdzogs pa chen po snying thig rdo rje snying lo theg pa 'di'i lugs la/theg pa 'og ma ltar rtog dpyod dang gtan tshigs la sogs thos bsam gyi sgo nas zab mo'i don gtan la 'beb pa yang ma gsungs/rgyud sde 'og ma ltar thun mong gi dngos grub la brten nas mthar thug mchog la sbyor ba yang ma gsungs/rgyud sde gong ma gzhan ltar dbang gsum pa 'i dpe'i ye shes la brten nas don gyi ye shes ngo sprod rtsal du bton pa yang ma gsungs/ brgyud pa gser gyi nyag thag la dam sel gyi g.yas ma gos pa'i rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi bla ma kho na la/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag gang gsung tshad mar 'dzin cing zhabs tog rnam pa gsum bsags sbyang gi snying por bzung nas ci 'grub la 'bad pa bskyed de/snyi/nga khung rus pa'i gting nas yid khyed shes kyi mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa kho nas mthus dper na spra ba skam thag chod pa me shel dang 'aṭ+wāṃd pa

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrospyolats+tshalhadapa'abordorjes ma dzad/ltar skad cig gisabyinarlabasa'aphoba'ostorbesakyisartogs pa btsan thabs su rgyud la skye bar bzhed pa yin pas rgyu mtshan shes pa gal che ste/ dpal sa ra has/bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ /lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ /zhes dang / de bzhin kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos sgyu ma ngal bso las kyang bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim sgom pa la sogs pa rnams ni/ rang rang gi lam ngo bo des mi grol te/ de yang spyod pa dang bogs 'don sogs la brten pa yin/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni rang gi ngo bo 'di kho nas gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes te grol ba yin pas na/ lam thams cad la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zab pa yin gsungs pa dang / dam tshig bkod pa las/ mchan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i lha/ /bskal pa 'bum du bsgom pa bas/ /bla ma skad cig dran pa mchog /bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa sa ya bas/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gcig mchog /zhes dang /a ti bkod pa chen po las/ drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma de/ /spyi bo'i gtsug gam snying gi dkyil/ /yan lag mthil du gang sgom pa/ /sangs rgyas stong gi dngos grub kyang / /gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud kyi lung mang la/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i zhal snga nas kyang /kho bos kyang rgyal ba gnyis /klong chen nga /mchan//pa'i gsung rab mthong nas sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skyes te phur tshugs su gsol ba btab pas/ ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung ste/ rang byung gi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes/ dus de nas bzung ste zhu ba po brgya phrag thal ba la khrid btab nga/ yin te/brtson 'grus /re dogs 'dzin pa dang bcas nga / mchan//can 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan las na ma 'phar/ shes rab can rtog dpyod /gnyis 'dzin blang dor gye yid dpyod can/ mapha//kyi phyogs su gol/ don dam pa'i rtogs tshul mos gus kyis srang la theb pa sha stag byung ngo / /zhes pa ltar/ 'di las lhag pa'i zab lam ni /38

༄tsho/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal byed/theg pa rim pa dgu'i chos zhal bsdur kyang mi da pas ming du sngon 'gror btags kyang / don du dngos gzhi'i lam thams cad kyi gnad 'gags mthar thug yin pas/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'di kho na la nyams len gyi mthil bcol na/nyams len gzhan ci yang med kyang rung bas snying thag pa nas 'bad pa ci nas kyang gal che/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dngos gzhi nyams su len pa la'ang gnyis/tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa/ yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags pa'o/ /dang po ni / e ma hoḥ rang snang lhun grub dag pa rab 'byams zhing: bkod pa rab rdzogs zangs mdog dpal ri'i dbus: zhes zhing khams sbyong ba blo stobs chen po'i spyod yul yin nga/sa snang bas gar khyab thams cad dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho phrang bkod pa tshad med pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i dbus su/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar gsal gri thod 'dzin: zhabs gnyis dor stabs spyan gsum nam mkhar gzigs: zhes/ rang nyid dbang gi snod du rung ba dang / bde stong gi ye shes bskyed pa dang / rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel gyi khyad par las/ pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng du/ngo bo mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal yin pa la/ rnam pa rje btsun /rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa zhabs dor stabs can bskyed kyang chog mchan//rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bla ma'i thugs kar rings ba'i /dga' bas brel langs pa'i tshul/ mchan//tshul gyis gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas ma rig gti mug gnyid las slong byed thod pa'i ḍā ma ru snya na g.yas kyi thad du 'brol ba / g.yon dug gsum rtsad nas gcod phyir gri gug dkur bsten pa/ sku gcer mo rus pa'i rgyan dang me tog gi chun 'phyang can snang la rang bzhin med pa mkha' las 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu zhig bsgom/ spyi bor pad+ma 'bum brdal nyi zla'i 139

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrobolad+dhisbyadapa'abordorjes ma dzad/steng: zhes/ de'ispyiboralporabazhi'itshadetsamagyimadun mkhar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan ze'u 'bru dmar ser gyi phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su srid zhi'i dwangs bcud thabs shes dbyer med mtshon pa'i nyi zla'i gdan rab tu mdzesasheng yid 'phrog pa'i steng du/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang: dbyer med mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku: dkar darme/ra mdangs ldan gzhon nu'i sha tshugasacan: phod kha chos gos zab ber 'dung ma gsol: zhes/ ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa o rgyan rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar la dman ba'i mdangs chags pa dper na dung la pho tshos brkus pa lta bu khro 'dzum gyi nyams can spyan gnyis lta stangs hrig ger gzigs pa/sku la nang du byang sems theg pa rdzogs pa'i rtags rdo rje'i gsang gos dkar po dang 'dung ma dmar po/ sngags kyi theg pa rdzogs pa'i rtags su phod chen mthing gso thar gyi theg pa rdzogs pa'i rtags chos gos dmar po gser gyi ha ri can/ theg pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtags za 'og ber chen dbang gi mdog can rnams brtsegs mar gsol ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyal 21 rol pa'i stabs:zhes/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs la sag lhum gsol zhing rgyal po rol pa'i stabs n+da/ bsdoyinas pa/ phyag gapa'iso rdo rje gaskusnan pas 〈snad bum bsnams: zhes/phyag g.yas rig stong 'gyur ba med pa'i brdar gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar /gtod tshul can sgom kyang 'dra/ mchan//snang srid bsdigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing /g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na snang stong gnyis su med pa'i brdar ka pā/ la 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba'i dbus su yo ga tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i brdar tshe bum dpag bsam ljon shing gi kha rgyan can 'dzin pa/dbu la 'dab ldan pad+ma'i mnyen zhu gsol: zhes/ spyir u rgyan rin po che'i dbu zhwa 'di snyesmu mi 'dra ba lnga tsam yod kyang / skabs 'dir pad+ma mthong grol lam 'dab /40

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /ste rtethar lam gsal byed/ldan rigasalngagasolab/ deyangabaskyed rdze ges zunga'ajug mātshon pa'i phyi nang rim pa gnyis/ sku gsum mtshon pa'i yarngo rtse gsum/ sku lnga'i 'gro don mdzad pa'i mtshon kha dog lnga/ thabs dang shes rab mtshon pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba/ dam tshig la mu mtha' med pa'i mu khyud mthing ga ting nge 'dzin la g.yo 'gul med pa'i rdo rje'i tog lta ba'i yang rtse rtogs shing sgrub pa mthar phyin pa'i rgod kyi rtse sgros brgyan pa/ mchan khung g.yon na bde stong yum mchos ma: sbas pa'i tshul gyis kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams: zhes/ mchan g.yon na yum lha lcam mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug sbas pa'i tshul gyis kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pa/ de yang ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum mtshon pa'i yar rtse gsum/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum mtshon pa'i thod pa skam rlon rnyid gsum// theg rim dgu mtshon pa'i rwa la lcags long dgu/ ye shes lnga'i mtshon dar tshon lnga/ dur khrod chen po bgyod du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad de ma mo dang mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus pa'i brdor shiskra dang gson skra la sogs pas brgyan pa ste brda don rtags gsum rdzogs pa/ 'ja' zer thig le 'od phung klong na bzhugs: zhes/ sku'i mtshan dpe gzi 'od kyis zhing khams thams cad snang bar byed cing / thugs rje'i rang mdangs 'ja' tshon gyi gur khang / thig le dang thig phran mer mer shig shig tu g.yo ba'i dbus na sprul pa yang sprul nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'khrigs pa zhig gsal btab / phyi 'khor 'od lnga'i drwa bas mdzes pa'i klong: zhes/ de'i phyi rol 'od lnga'i drwa ba mig mang ris su shar ba'i nang khongs 'ja' 'od zlum 'khyil gyi dbus na/sprul pa'i rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang: rgya bod paṇa grub rig 'dzin yi dam lha:mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can sprin ltar gtibs: gsal stong mnyam gnas chen po'i ngang du gsal: zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs ye shes chen po'i rnal rol las shar ba'i rgya bod kyi paṇa grub rig pa 'dzin pa'i sastol bzhugs pa rnams dang / rgya 141

༄/ /rigalona'agrokhrul (wa dpa'abordorjes ma dzad/gar gyi mchog gi riga'adzinachenapobargyapru/ rnola'abyoragyidabang phyug brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ bod kyi rje 'bangs chen po nyi shu rtsa lnga sogs/ rdzogs chen bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / gzhan yang yi dam rgyud sde drug gi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsal stong 'dzin med chu zla ltar gtso 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul du tha mal gyi snang ba rang 'gags su 'gro ba zhig gsal gdab la mos gus gdung dbyangs snyan pos/hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyis: byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol:gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūm̐:zhes brjod pas thugs /sngon gyi zhal bzhes/mchan//rgyud bskul te/ sku gsum dag pa'i zhing dang rnga yab dpa' ri pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i brgyud gsum rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs dpag tu med pa/ mtsho la kha ba bab pa ltar spyan drangs nas bdag dang tshogs zhing la sib sib thim par mos/ gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa'i sgo yan lag bdun ni/ 'di ltar rdo rje theg pa'i lam thabs mang la/ dka' ba med pa dang / dbang po rnon po'i spyod yul yin pas/ sems stobs chen pos tshogs bsags pa la rgyun chags su bslab pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i bskal pa chen po'i tshogs 'dir skad cig ma la 'dum nas tshe gcig la sogs pas grol ba yin la/ khyad par du gsang ba bla na med pa'i tshogs zhing gi rab dang phul du gyur pa yang rdo rje slob dpon nyag gcig tu nges pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel bar 'byung bas na gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /de la dang po nga rgyal gyi gnyen po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ hrīḥ bdag lus zhing gi rdul snyed du: rnam par 'phrul bas phyag 'tshal lo: zhes/ spyir phyag 'tshal 142

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /ste rtethar lam/ gsal byed/zhes pa na maḥ'isgralasagusa'adudakyirnad+mo'agyur yin pas de la'ang yul so so'i srol ma nges kyang / bdag cag gi 'khor lo'i mgon po rnam gnyis kyi zhal rgyun ltar na/ sdig bshags skabs brkyang phyag dang / rjes su yi rangs skabs yan lag lnga ldan gyi phyag 'tshal dgos par gsungs pas/ de gnyis gang yin yang dang po gus pa'i rnam 'gyur snyi nga ga nas pad+ma kha 'bus 'dra ba'am/ ga'u chung gi brtul zhugs zhes lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i sor mo'i rtse rnams sprad pa'i thal mo gru bzhi ltar 'ong ba mthong brgyud ltar bya dgos pa ni/ yon tan mdzod las/bab col goms pa min pa'i lus btud nas//snying gar gus bcas mngon rtogs ngoms pa la/ /me tog dog pas rab bzung snyim pa'i snod/ /ga'u chung gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de nas spyi bo zhes rang gi mgo'i spyi gtsug sbu 'khyil yod sa 'di dang / mgrin pa phrag pa'i dang ru gyes mtshams/ snying dkar nag mtshams gsum thal mo gtugs/ lus kyi ma lnga po ni/ dpral ba/ lag mthil gnyis/ pus mo'i lha nga gnyis te lnga po sar phab nas phyag 'tshal ba la yan lag lnga ldan gyi phyag zhes so/ /spyi bor thal mo sbyar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo las/ pad+ma kha 'bus phyes 'dra ba/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar te/ /lus dpag med pa'i sprin tshogs bcas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /de ltar ma yin par mi dred kyi lad mo lta bu bab col dang ma gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal na/ yul khyad du bsad pa'i nyes pa yod tshul gsungs pas des na dad gus kyi brtul zhugs dang ldan pas rang gi lus dpag tu med par sprul nas/sems can thams cad kyis rang dang 'jug pa gcig pas lo yag gi snye ma rlung gis ded pa ltar dus gcig la phyag 'tshal bar dmigs na phyag de snyed kyi phan yon thob cing / de ma yin par lus mi bsrang bar rgur por bya ba dang / mgo sa 143

༄/ /rega'ajina'agror+ṣalapy-i/ ṭ+wāṃdapa'abordorjes ma dzad/la mi gtugs pa dang / thal mo legatsu pare mi sbyar bar lag pa yug tsam byas nas phyag 'tshal ba rnams rni phan yon thob mi dgos nyes pa gsog byed yin par dam pa gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pas rgyu mchan shes pa'i sgo nas nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag ni/ dngos bshams yid sprul ting 'dzin mthus: snang srid mchod pa'i phyag rgyar 'bul: zhes dngos su rang gis kun slong bsam pa rnam nga ra dag pas ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa rgyu bzang spus gtsang bkod legs pa ser snas ma bcings shing tshul 'chos su ma song ba bshams la dmigs rten tsam byas te/ yid kyis nam mkha' dang sa gzhi thams cad bdag pos yongs su bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod nga/ra 'os pa'i mchod rdzas grangs las 'das pa mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis glu gar gyi rnam 'gyur du ma dang bcas thogs nas mig 'phrul lta bu'i yongs su gang ba de dag re re las kyang dpag tu med pa'i mchod rdzas kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la dus ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du mchod par dmigs pa ni 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung zhes bya ste/ de 'dra ba rang blos ci lcog tu 'bul ba dang rgyun tu yang dngos 'byar gyi mchod pa ci nus su'ang 'bad do/ /gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag ni/sgo gasdas mi dge'i las rnams kun:'od gsal chos sku'i ngang du bshags: zhes/ dus 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas rang bzhin gyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las gang bsags dang / bcas pa'i sdig pa sdom bslab dam tshig nyams chag gang sgordzor ba thams cad gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol lo bshags so/ /slan chad mi bgyid do snyam pa'i gnyen po stobs bzhi'i dag pa dran pa'i ngang nas bshags pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad rang 144

༄tsho/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal byed/gi lce thog tu nag phung gis 'dus pa la/ gso zhing lha tshogs kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer byung ste phog ma thag nyi mas mun pa ded pa ltar sang sang dag par bsams la nges shes bskyed/ mthar rang rig 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang du la bzla'o/ / bzhi pa phrag dog gi gnyen po rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag ni/ bden pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa yi: dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang: zhes/ rgyal ba rnams kyis sems can gyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad spyod rlabs po che dang / sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams dang thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba dang bcas kun rdzob dang don dam gyis bsdus pa'i rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa thams cad la snyi nga thag pa nas dga' ba chen pos rjes su yi rang bsgom pas rang gi dge ba gong 'phel du 'gro ba dang /ma byas shaṃng bsags pa'i dge ba rlabs po cher 'gyur ba sogs phan yon tshad med pas rnam pa kun tu gces so/ /lnga pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag ni/ rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya la/ theg gsum chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: zhes/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa gzhan don rlabs po che khur bzod pa rnams/ 'gro ba'i log sgrub dang skyo ngal gyis thugs sun nas chos mi gsungs par zhi bder gzhol ba dag gi drung du/ bdag lus bye ba brgya stong grangs med par sprul nas/ gser gyi 'khor lo dang dung dkar po g.yas 'khyil sogs phul nas chos 'khor bskor ba'i gsol ba btab pas/ phyi kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pa nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems gsum/ nang dka' thub rig byed kyi theg pa kri ya u pa ya yo ga gsum/ gsang ba dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa ma hā a nu a ti gsum ste/ theg pa gsum la nang gses dgur dbye ba de dag gdul bya chos gang gis 'dul ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar /45

sgo/ /riga'adzina'agrobolat+nabyedapa'abordorjes ma/dzad/gsol ba btab pasarangargyudalabyinarlobs —'ipho ba'itshul du chos 'khor bskor te de nges par gzung ba'i mos pa brtan por bya'o/ /drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa'i yan lag ni/ ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs par: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: zhes zhing khams 'di dang gzhan dag tu sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sems can gyi don mdzad zin nas mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa de dag gi mdun du/ sngon ston pa bcom ldan 'das la dge bsnyen tsun+das gsol ba btab pa ltar/ bdag gis gdung ba'i shugs drag pos gang sku mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pas/gsan te 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can gyi don du gzugs sku mngon sum nga/ra bzhugs pa zhal gyis bzhes nas dngos su bzhugs par bsam mo/ /bdun nga/ bsngo ba'i yan lag ni/ dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa kun: byang chub chen ngo 'i rgyu ru bsngo: zhes yan lag de dag gis mtshon rang gzhan gyi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad 'jam dpal gathon nus yongs bsngo ltar dmigs pa med nga 'i shes rab kyi rgyas btab ste/ bsngo ba ni dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dge rtsa che phra gang byas kyi mjug tu nyams su blang dngos/ de ltar ma bsngos na dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsgrub de dge 'bras lan cig smin nas zad par 'gyur la/mthar thug byang chub thob pa'i rgyur bsngos na dge 'bras lan brgyar smin kyang dge rtsa de rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob par mi zad cing gong nas gong 'phel du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de bzhin du nyan thos/ rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' gang gi go 'phang don du gnyer ba'am/ mngon mtho lha mi'i lus rten thob par 'dod pa dang gzhan yang tshe ring ba dang gzugs bzang ba la sogs pa gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu gang rung la dmigs nas dge rtsa zhig bsgrub kyang de nyid de'i ched du bsngo dgos/ ji skad du//46

༄༅//sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /blo skothar larme/ gsal byed/bsngo ba mizadalamayinate/ /speladangadrosgror ba'i chosacan no/ /zhes so/ /de yang 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi bsngo ba mtshan nyid pa so so'i skye bo'i sa 'dir 'ong dka' bas na/sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag gis ji ltar bsngos pa de ltar bsngo'o snyam nas bsngos na 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba'i go chod la/dge rtsa kha lo sgyur byed gong smos ltar mjug bsngo ba'i rgyas yongs su thebs pa 'di kho nar rag las pa yin pas na rnam pa kun tu 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar yan lag bdun po 'di rnam pa kun tu gal che la khyad par phyag 'bum ther dang 'brel na lhag par phan yon che'o/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa phur tshugs su gsol ba 'debs shing rgyu rdo rje bzhi'i ngo bor bsgrub pa ni/'di ltar thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa ni rang byung rig pa'i ye shes rtogs nga/ la rag las shing /de yang gong smos ltar bla ma'i byin rlabs la rag las/ de yang yul gyikhyad par la mi ltos byin rlabs 'jug snga phyi rang gi mos gus yod med la rag las pa ni sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar dang mthong chos su grub pa 'di yin pas de'i phyir dpal mgon bla ma dam nga/ ni dkyil 'khor gang du he ru ka'i ngo bor dbang rdzogs/ mthong ba dang thos pa dang dran pa dang reg pa tsam gyis thar ba'i sa bon 'debs shing / sangs rgyas thams cad dang phrin las kyi byed pa gcig pas dkon mchog bzhi par byon/ rang ngor tshe gcig lus gcig la smin grol zab mo'i lam dang thugs rje byin rlabs kho nas rdo rje 'chang gi sar btsan thabs su bkod pas sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin mchog tu lhag cing /yon tan gyi sgo nas gzhal na dgongs nga nam mkha' ltar rgya che / mkhyen brtse rgya mtsho ltar tshad med//thugs rje chu klung ltar shugs drag /rang bzhin ri rgyal ltar thugs brtan/ 'gro bar pha ma ltar thugs snyo mas shing yon tan re re'i cha yang dpag par mi nus la/gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis ci 'dod 47

sgo/ /riga'adzina'agrobolat+nak+to dpa'abordorjes ma/dzad/dngos grub thamasacada'abadamedadu'abyujib yid bzhinagyi nor bu rin po che khyed la brten/ khyed la re/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang khyed kho na mkhyen snyam pa kha tsam min pa blo snying brang gsum ling gis gtad/ mos gus kyis lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba/ mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa/ blo sna bla mas phrogs pa/ bsam thre/ bla ma las med pa/ sdo/sa sems tshugs mi thub pa lta bu'i sgo nas gdung shugs drag pos/ rje btsun gu ru rin po che: khyed ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: thugs rje byin rlabs 'dus pa'i dpal: sems can yongs kyi mgon gcig pu: lus dang longs spyod blo snying brang: lhos pa med par khyod la 'bul: 'di nas byang chub ma thob par: skyid sdug legs nyes mtho dman kun:rje btsun chen po pad 'byung mkhyen: zhes dang / gsol 'debs rgyud bskul gyi 'dzab badz+ra gu ru kho na la 'bad/ bsnyen pa brgya re song mtshams/ rje bcun gu ru rin po che: sogs gsol ba gdab/ de ltar bsnyen pa ci tsam bzla ba'i phyed tsam song nas/ bdag la re sa gzhan na med: da lta'i dus ngan snyigs ma'i 'gro: mi bzod sdug bsngal 'dam du bying: 'di las skyobs shig ma hā gu ru dbang bzhi skur cig byin rlabs can: rtogs pa spor cig thugs rje can: sgrib gnyis sbyongs shig nus mthu can: yan chad gong ltar dang / dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa yang yang bya/ thun mthar/ gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs: kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin no: byin rlabs thugs kyi klong nas snol: bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol: zhes dang /de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi yon tan dang bka' drin dran pa'i mos gus gdung shugs kyis dbyangs dang bcas/ e ma ho ༷ rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba'i zhing khams nas: dang po'i sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang: longs sku chu zla'i rol rtsal rdo rje sems: sprul skur mchan rdzogs dga' rab rdo rje la: gsol ba 148

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam gsal byed/'debs so byinarlabasadabangabaskurastsolardo rice shrīsidhadon dam chos kyi mdzod:'jam dpal bshes gnyen theg dgu'i 'khor los sgyur: dz+nyā na su tra paṇa chen bi ma lar: gsol ba 'debs so grol byed lam sna ston: 'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyan gcig pad+ma 'byung: nges par thugs kyi sras mchog rje 'bangs grogs: thugs gter rgya mtsho'i brda 'grol klong chen zhabs: mkha' 'gro'i dbyings mdzod bka' babs 'jigs med gling: gsol ba 'debs so 'bras bu thob grol snel: spyan ras gzigs dngos rgyal ba'i myu gu dang:chos kyi spyan mnga' dri med blo gros zhabs:/gnyis ka dus mnyam du byon kyang kho ba'i smin grol gyi gdams nga/'i bka' drin thob snga phyi'i bab/mchan//bka' babs bdun ldan rdo rje gzi brjid la/ gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis lhun 'grub shog /zhes/ 'dod pa'i don so sor dmigs su bkal nas gsol 'debs yid khyed shes kyi dad pa kha zhe ngo lkog med pas/ srid las nges par 'byung ba'i zhen log gisaḥ rdo rje bla ma don ldan mig bzhin brtenaḥ ci gsung bka' bsgrub zab mo'i nyams len laḥ ltem rkyang med pa'i bsgrub tshugs zhe rus kyisaX thugs rgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs 'pho bar shogaX snang srid 'khor 'das ye nas 'og min zhing ཿ lha sngags chos skur dag rdzogs smin pa'i 'brasaḥ spang blang bya rtsol med pa'i rdzogs pa cheḥ shes nyams yid dpyod las 'das rig pa'i gdangasaḥ chos nyid mngon sum rjen par mthong bar shogaḥ mtshan ma'i rtog pa rnam grol 'ja' zer sbubasaḥ sku dang thig le'i nyams snang gong du 'phel ༷ rig rtsal longs sku'i zhing khams tshad la phebaḥ chosazad blo 'das chen por sangs rgyas teX gzhon nu bum skur gtan srid zin par shogaḥ shin tu rnal 'byor nyams 'og ma chud deḥ rags lus dngas ma'i dbyings su ma grol naḥ nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed bstung pa'i tsheḥ'achi ba 'od gsal ka dag chos skur sharaḥbar de'i snang cha longs spyod rdzogs skur grolaḥ khregs chod thod rgal lam gyi rtsal rdzogs nas ma pang bu 149

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrosil /drobyedapa'abordorjes ma dzad/'jug lta bur grol bar 31gaḥ gsang cher+ghaṃ— 'odaci chigasal theg pa mchog gi rtseḥ sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol chos sku'i zhalaḥ mngon gyur gdod ma'i sa la ma grol naḥm bsgom sangs rgyas chos lnga'i lam mchog laḥ brten nas rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing lnga dang ཿ khyad par pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang duḥ rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gtso mchog o rgyan rjesaḥ gsang chen chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa'i saraḥ sras kyi thu bor skyes nas dbugs dbyung steḥmatha' yas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor bdag 'gyur shogaḥ rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs dang ཿ chos dbyings bsam mi khyab pa'i bden pa yisaḥ dal 'byor rten la rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyisaḥ rten 'brel mngon gyur sangs rgyas thob par shogaḥ ces rdo rje'i tshig byin rlabs dang lngan pa rdzogs pa chen po'i lam kha tshang gang zag gi khyad par dang bcas pa'i gnad 'di dag la nges shes dang ldan pas de ltar 'grub pa zhig mkhyen snyam pa'i snying khung nas gsol ba 'debs/ slar mos gus dung dung pa zhig byas pa'i rkyen gyis 'khor rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar bzhin bdag la rjes su brtse bar mos te/ tshig rjes don dran gyis/ gu ru'i smin mtshams nas oṃ yig chu shel lta bur 'tsher ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/lus kyi las dang rtsa'i sgrib pa dag /sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ bskyed rim gyi snod du gyur/ rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ sprul sku'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal pa rgyud la bzhag /mgrin pa nas ā yig pad+ma rā ga ltar 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ ngag gi las dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag /gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/bzlas brjod kyi snod du gyur/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i go 'phang gi skal pa rgyud la bzhag /thugs ka'i hūṃ yig nam mkha'i mdog can las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi snying ga nasazhugs/ yid kyi las dang 150

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / ste thar lam gsal byed/thig le'i sgribapadag/thugasardorje'ibyina~Xbah+phi zhugs/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/bde stong tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i snod du gyur/phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ chos sku'i go 'phang gi skal pa rgyud la bzhag slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ yig gnyis pa zhig skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du chad/ rang sems dang tha dad med par 'dres/ kun gzhi'i las dang shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ tshig gis mtshon pa don dam gyi dbang thob/ ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gyur/ lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i skal pa rgyud la bzhag go /zhes/ de'i ngang du snying po yid bzlas ci rigs bya/rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam la zhugs nas/dam tshig nyams chag byung na gso ba dang / bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen la sogs pa'i lam thams cad bsgom nga/ la dbang ba dang / gegs dang gol sa mi 'byung ba dang / yon tan gyi tshogs gong nas gong du 'phel ba la sogs rtsa ba smin byed kyi dbang la rag las pa yin te/ ji skad du/ gsang sngags dbang la ma bsten 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /dper na mnyan pa lag skya med rnga bzhin/ /zhes dang / dbang ma bskur na dngos grub med/ bye ma btsir bas mar mi 'byung / /zhes so/ /dang po mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur thob pa de gzhi'i dbang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas rang nyid kyis dbang bzhi rgyun du len pa ni lam gyi dbang / mthar thug 'bras bu'i dus 'od zer chen po'i dbang ngam zab gsal gnyis med kyi dbang bskur thob ste mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa 'bras bu'i dbang yin/ de la yang dag rdzogs smin gsum gyi zab gnad bsam gyis mi khyab pas dngos gzhi nyams su len pa'i tshe na yang spyir sngon 'gro'i chos thams cad 'dor du mi rung / khyad par bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gang nyams su len pa'i tshe bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas lam dbang blangs pa 'di 151

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrosil ṣ+ṭṛ/ snradapa'abordorjes rma/dzad/thun re'i mgor mchagaparabyabani gnapru kyi dem pa'o/ /de las ldang ba na/ nam zhig tshe yi dus byas tsheḥ rang snang rnga yab dpal ri'i zhingaḥzung 'jug sprul pa'i zhing khams suḥ gzhi lus rdo rje rnal 'byor maḥ gsal 'tsher 'od kyi gong bu sa gyur nas rje btsun pad 'byung dang ཿ dbyer med chen por sangs rgyas teḥ bde dang stong pa'i cho 'phrul gyiḥ ye shes chen po'i rol pa lasaḥ khams gsum sems can ma lus paḥ 'dren pa'i ded dpon dam pa jatsho rje btsun pad+mas dbugs dbyung gsolaḥ zhes gu ru rin po che zhal 'dzum mdangs dang bcas spyan rjes chags kyi tshul du g.yos pa'i ngang las thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po drod dang bcas pa zhig wal gyis byung nasabadag rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying gar reg pa tsam gyis 'od dmar gyi gong bu zhig du gyur nas gu ru rin po che'i thugs kar thim pas dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ zhes/ yun ci gnas su bzhag la/ de las ldang ba na/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs la/ /bka' drin chen pe'i sgo nas rjes gzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar ba la/ /skad cig tsam yang log lta mi skye zhing / /ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyis/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug par de|ga /ces gzhi lus zhing khams kyi bkod pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab la/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma cung zad khro nyams can gsal ba'i spyi bor ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag med gtso 'kher gsal ba sogs tshig ris dang mthun pa'i dmigs 'dun bcas/ de yi khong dbus rtsa dbu ma sogs 'chad 'gyur ltar nyams su len/mthar/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod nas/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces dang / zhabs brtan dmigs bsal yod tshe 'dir 'don/ zangs 152

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayeg /sto thar lam/ gsal byed/mdog dpalari'ismonalamadapalari'irgosang4 lam sogs bsngo smon ci rigs bya/de ltar gcig chog bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di lam gyi snying por 'dzin cing nyams su len pa'i skal bzang sbyang pa sngon song re 'ga' cam las dus dbang gis dka' bar gda' yang gang ltar bla ma'i phyogs kyi skyon yon gnyis ka la rtog dpyod mi mang / rang gi lha skal bzang rung ngan rung bla ma rin po che 'di kho na yin/ mdzad spyod sogs brtags na so skye blo mig ma dag pas skyon kun zad yon tan kun tshang bzang por mthong dka' yang / rang gi dad pa zhig bskyed nus na ci tsam yin kyang bems po khyi sos rgan mo grol ba'i lo rgyus sogs la bsam gzhig gis rang gis rang la gros 'debs/ rim par rangagi nyams rtogs kyi yon tan ci tsam 'phel na de tsam gyi bla ma'i bka' drin dang yon tan dran te rtogs pa mngon sum rtogs dus sangs rgyas dngos kyi dad pa thob 'ong ba yin la/ so skye'i snang ba gzhan dbang can skad cig la cung tsam gyis dga' sdug dang / dad pa 61ga lha 'gyur ba can ni sems can spyi'i chos nyid yin pas rang gis rang la yid rton pher dka'/ rtag tu nyin par cir snang ci spyod kyang bla ma mi brjed pa'i dran shes kyis lha dang bla mas dbyings nas mi khrel/ rdo rje mched grogs dpang pos mi khrel/ rang gi sems kyis rang la mi khrel ba gsum la mthil bcol ba'i bag yod dang ldan pas ci byas thams cad bla ma'i phyogs kyi bsags sbyang la 'gro nges las tha mal du skad cig tsam mi btang bar dam pa gsum gyis zin nges bya/ nub mo'i thun la bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom zhing / mtsho dbus ge sar sogs rang gzhan gyi don du bsam pa lhun grub dang / sku gsum zhing khams sbyong ba'i smon lam sogs gdab/ nyal ba'i tshe bla ma snying dbus su gdan drangs nas sku'i 'od kyis rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar mos nas bla ma'i zhal ras sogs la sems 'dzin/ mthar gnyid bdo ba na/ 'od de lus kyis ma thub pa'i tshul gyis snod bcud thams cad la phog pas 153

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrod+kul sna bye dpa'abordorjes ma dzad/lan tshwa chu la thim pa ltar 'od du zhu nas dzange larī wim/ rang bla ma la/ bla ma yang 'od du yal te dbyings su thim pas gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i ngang du gnyid log /sad na 'phro rgod bsam gzhig gi dbang du mi btang bar bla ma dran pa'i gsol 'debs bya zhing / slar ma bcos pa'i ngang bskyangs/ de ltar nyams su blang na gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang rmi lam zin par 'gyur/ tho rang ldang ba'i tshe mal nas hal gyis langs te drang por 'dug la rlung ro bsal/ khams kyi gnyid rmugs kyi rnyogs ma bsang la ngal bso/ ma dag snang ba sbyang phyir phyi snod kyi 'jig rten zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo bcud kyi sems can bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rnam par gsal ba'i phyag gis ḍā ma ru di ri ri bsgrags pa'i sgra gdangs dbyangs gsal gyi rnam pa can gyi sgras sems can thams cad gti mug gi gnyid las sad par mos pa dang / ngag 'don chog khrigs ltar ngag byin brlab tshig ris dang mthun pa'i dbyangs gsal rten snying bdun re ma mtha' byas pa'i bzlas pa sogs ji skad bshad pa ltar nyams su blang ngo / /de ltar mos gus dang dam tshig rnam par dag pa gang zhig 'di yan chad kyi lam mthar phyin pas kyang dngos gzhi la mi ltos par rnga yab dpal gyi ri bor dbugs dbyung / dag pa'i zhing khams der rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i lam nyi zla'i bsgrod pa las kyang myur bas kun tu bzang po'i sar phyin par 'gyur ro/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bsnyen pa'i tshad thun du bcad na zla ba drug sogs min kyang 'bum phrag brgya tham pa ci nas kyang 'gro nges par bya dgos gsungasaso/ /de ltar sngon 'gro'i chos 'di dag la de tsam gal mi che'am snyam nas/ dngos gzhi'i chos zab zab mo'i kha skad la re nas sngon 'gro nyams su len long med par bskyed rdzogs sogs sgom lo byed pa rnams ni/ sngon 'gro'i chos gzhug shor te dam nyams chos dred du 'gro bas nyams len la snying po til 'bru tsam yang med cing / drod rtags glo bur ba cung zad 154

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig sna rtethar lam gsal byed/re skyes kyang brtanapamedapartsigasarmingadzābyenges pa'imakhar dang 'dra'o/ /gal te sngon 'gro'i dus khrid sbyangs sogs khral rgyugs tsam byas nas/ dngos gzhi'i dus sngon 'gredore bsags sbyangs mi dgos snyam nas rtsis med du skyur ba rnams ni shes med mdo shor/ dper na gro chas gang yang med pa'i gcer bu zhig gi rgya dkar nag gi bya ba byed 'dod pa dang 'dra bas/lam gyi cha rkyen yod des chog sngon 'gro'i nyams len gong 'phel la brtson dgos/ lam gyi gzhi rten nam cha rkyen sngon 'gro'i chos dor ba ni chos kyi rtsa ba chad pa yin pas na/ sngon 'gro'i chos 'di dag la nges shes bcos ma ma yin pa re skye nges su 'bad cing / khyad par byin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na la nyams len gyi mthil bya ba ne+e gnad dam pa'o/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes btsan thabs su rgyud la bskyed pa/ byin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid kyi rim pa'o gsum pa nyams len dngos gzhi'i cha lag 'da' ka ma'i man ngag 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas kyi khrid la/ 'pho ba'i dbye ba/ 'pho ba'i yon tan/ ji ltar 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su len tshul dang gsum/ dang po la'ang lnga/ chos sku lta ba rgyas 'debs/ longs sku bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug sprul sku tshad med snying rje/tha mal pa 'du shes gsum ldan / gshin po rjes 'dzin thugs rje'i lcags kyu'i 'pho ba'o/ /dang po rab chos sku lta ba rgyas 'debs kyi 'pho ba ni/ tshe 'dir gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i lta ba rgyud la skyes shing sgom stobs kyis lhongs su gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'chi ba'i dus ka dag khregs chod kyi gseng lam nas gzhi'i rig pa ma dang /rnal 'byor lam gyi rig pa bu'i tha snyad du byas nas 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa zhes sbra khyim lta bu gud du bcad byed bsal ma thag phyi nang gi nam mkha' gcig tu 'dres te tha dad med pa ltar gzhi 'brasazung 'jug dbyings rig dbyer med dang chos kyi sku ru 'pho ba dang / gnyis pa/ 'bring longs sku bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi 155

ri༅/ /reg rije'e 'gro 5la rkedzo wadapa' bo rdo rjes ma dzad/kyājo ba ni/ bskyeng rdzogs dbyer med kyi rnal 'ibyor la goms 'dris byas shing sgyu ma lta bu'i lta sku la rtsal sbyong ba dag 'chi ba'i tshe bar do 'khrul nga/'i snang ba 'char ba dang mnyam du zung lajug sgyu ma'i skur ldang nas longs spyod rdzogs skur 'pho ba dang / sasum pa tha ma sprul sku tshad med thugs rje'i 'pho ba ni/ smen byed kyi dbang thob cing / dam tshig la skyon ma zhugs/ bskyed rdzogs la mos pa byed cing bar de'i sadams ngag dang ldan pa rnams/ ji skad du/ mngal sbo dgag nas ru log dran par bya/ /snying rus dag snang dgos pa'i dus gcig yin/ /zhes nga ltar/ bla mas gsung pa'i gdams ngag rjes su dran pas ma dag pa'i mngal sgo ngan pa bkag cing / skye ba sprul pa'i lam khyer la brten nas zhing dag pa'i skye gnas su 'pho ba dang / bzhi pa tha mal pa 'du shes gsum/ ldan gyi 'pho ba ni/ rtsa dbu ma lam gyi 'du shes/ sems rnam shes thig le la mgron po'i ladu shes/ gnas bde chen dag pa'i zhing la pha yul du 'gro ba'i 'du shes se /gshin ngo/ rjes 'dzen gyi 'pho ba tho tsam 'og tu 'chad par bya la/ da res kyi skabs su 'chad rgyu'i 'phe ba 'di ni/ 'du shes gsum lden gyi 'pho ba'am rnam shes bla ma'i 'pho ba zhes so/ /gnyes pa 'pho ba'i phan yon nam yon tan ni/ rje mi la ras pas/lam sbyangs pa dman na 'pho bas bsu/ /gan+da/nga paphultar lam la bstan nga/ ma thob pa 'i rigs can dang / gang zag sdig po che la gnad 'di gal che/ rang 'di lta bu'i man ngag dang lngan na sdig po che yi na kyang ngan song gi skye sbo khegs nges la/ dus kyi 'bo/ ra lo las/ nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang / /mtshams med lnga rmi byed nga/ yang / /'di yi lam gyis grol 'gyur te/ /sdig gis gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / yang / bu ga dgu ye steng phyogs su/ /yid kyis bsam te 'pho byed na/ /sdig rgos gos par mi 'gyur te/ /dag pa'i zhing du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang ji skang du/ gnas spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng na/ /pha mtshan lngan/ gyi bla ma'i /56

༄7/ /sngonarigro'ikhridayig /sto /rdo thar lamagasal byed/zhabs drung du/ /rtsa dar dkar gyi lam la 'gro shes na/ /mchams med lnga po byas kyang grol/ /zhes so/ /gzhan mtshams med kyi las byas pa zhig yin kyang bems rig ma bral gong 'pho ba 'debs pa'i dus chod dang 'brel te gang zag khyad par can gyi bdag ngo/'i rkyen gyis gdam/sa pa 'ji dang 'phrad na sdig po che bcan thabs su grol ba la/ the chom mi dgos te/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang bi zhal nas/ nyin bzhen bram ze gsod pa dang / /ma/chams med lnga ngo/ byed pa/ ya nga / /gdams nga/ 'de dang 'phrad —gyur na/ /grol 'gyur 'ange la the tshom med/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa gdams pa ji ltar tam/sa su len chul la 'ang gnyis/ sbyangs pa dang / las la sbyar ba'o/ /dang ngo sbyang ba'i stabs dngos gzhi dmigs pa ni/ khyed rang rnam sa hūṃsleb ske la so gas gzhan la 'phe brid kyi rjes su gnang ba'i dmi/gas pa pheg skabs/ mchan// lus band drang ngo/ra sdod la sems gzhan du ma/ yengs pas dmigs pa 'di ltar gyis/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta d+dhā na badz+ra su bha wa atā konyahaṃ/stong pa'i ngang las rang re sdod pa'i sa phyogs zhing kham sa nga d+ma drwa ba can dngos su bde ba can gyi zhing gi rgya'e dang bkod pa yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams kye ga'e lus kyi phung po skad cig bis gnas 'gyur nas pad nyi'i gdan la ngo bo mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la rnam/ pa rdo rje rnal 'byar ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal cung zad khro nyams dang ldan cing spyan gsum narme/ mkhar ye re gzigs pa/ gnag snum dbu skra'i lan tshar sku rgyab tu 'phyang ba/ phyag g.ya sa ma rig gnyid las slong byed thod pa'i ṭī ma ru snyan g.yas pa'i thad du 'khrol ba/ g.yon dug gsum rtsad gcod kyi gri gug dkur bsten pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i dor stabs can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i zhig gsal thob/ de yi lus dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma khrag dang chu ser gyis ma gos nga / chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i brdar mthing shun ltar sngo ba/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa srab pa'i brdar pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa/ ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal sdi57

༄/ /riga'adzina'agro5lash+laukhrodapa'abordorjes ma/dzad/ba'i brdar til gyi mar me ltar gsal rbo/ klam log pa dang dman par mi 'gro ba'i brdar chu shing gi ldem bu ltar drangs pa ste mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa/ thar lam mtshon pa'i yar sne spyi bo'i gtsug na rgya mthong kha phyes nga/ lta bu ha rer yod pa/'khor ba dang ngan song gi skye sgo 'gags pa'i mtshon mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad kha zum pa/ dbu ma'i nang snying gi thad kar smyugs ma tshigs kyis bcad pa lta bu'i steng du/ rlung gi thig le ljang skya 'gul 'phrig can gyi steng du rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa dar cog rlung gis brdab pa ltar 'dar phri li li yod par dmigs/ rang gi spyi bor gru gang tsam gyi nam mkhar me bya zlos gar rtse ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la nyi 'od phog pa lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung / phyag mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba'i lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ mchog gi sprul sku tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer mu mtha' med pa 'phro ba'i skur gsal ba'i g.yas su snying rje'i rang gzugs 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs gnyis pad zla'idzikadan la mnyam par bzhengs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa/g.yas 'og mas skyabs sbyin gyis shel phreng dang / g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dkar pe'i yu ba nas 'dzin cing snyan gyi thad du kha gyes pa/ ri dgas kyi lpags pas nu g.yon bkab pa/ gtso bo'i g.yon du pad zla'i gdan la mthu stobs mnga' bdag gsang ba'i bdag po sku mdog sngon po zhabs mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs shing / phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa/ byang sems gnyis ka /58

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig /sto rtethar lam gsal byed/longs spyod rdzogasasku'irgyanachasabacugasgyem sku'is rnamapar spras pa/ gtso 'khor gsum po'i mtha' bskor du zab lam 'pho ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dwangs pa'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar bzhugs pas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la brtse ba'i zhal phyogs shing / 'dzum pa'i spyan gyis gzigs/ dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs nas bde chen dag pa'i zhing du 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por bzhugs par mos shig /ces dang spro na/ rang nyid gzhi lus rdo rje rnal 'byor maX zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar gsal gri thod 'dzinaḥ zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs spyan gsum nam mkhar gzigasaḥ de'i khong dbus rtsa dbu maḥ sbom phra mda' snyug tsam pa laḥ stong sangs 'od kyi sbu gu canaḥ yar sne tshangs bug gnas su haraḥ mar sne lte 'og zum pa yiḥ snying gar tshigs kyis bcad pa'i steng ཿ rlung gi thig le ljang skya'i dbusaḥ rig pa hrīḥyig dmar por gsal/ spyi bor khru gang tsam gyi steng ཿ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas niḥ mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i phung por gsalaḥ zhes gsal gdab spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med la snying khung rus pa'i gting nas yid khyed she/sa kyi dad pas mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa dang bcas lag pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyor la mos 'dun rtse gcig pas yid kyis rjes zlos gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdul bral shin tu rnam par dag pa mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal 31/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan ci mang brjod mthar /spro zhing nus na gzhan sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mchan/ mchan//yid 'gyur nges kyis dbyangs la drangs te/ e ma hoḥ gnas rang snang don gyi 'og min naḥ yid dad brgya'i 'ja' gur 'khrigs pa'i klongaḥ skyabs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma niḥ sku tha mal ma yin dwangs ma'i lusaḥ dpal sangs rgyas snang mtha'i ngo bor bzhugasaḥ yid mos gus 159

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrosilañcā/ṭ+wāṃ dpa'abordorjes ma dzad/gdung bas gsol ba 'debasaḥ lam 'pho mob 'byongs par byin gyis rlebasaḥganas 'og min bsgrod par byin gyis rlobasaḥ dbyings chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par shogaḥces char ci rigs par brjod pa'i rjes ma la yid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debasaḥ man chad tshar gsum dngaḥ yang dbyings chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par shogaḥ ces lan gsum brjodaḥ rig pa sems kyi rten hrīḥyig la semasabazung /de nas spar chog gi tshe rkan gyi phug nas hrīḥhrīḥzhes lnga tshar brjod pa dang mnyam du hrīḥdamar po rlung gi thig le ljang skya g.yo ba'i rnam pa can des btegs te 'dar phri li li byed cing je mtho je mthor song / spyi bor tshangs pa'i bu gar thon pa dang mnyam du phaṭaḥces brjod pas dpag chen gyis mda' 'phang ba ltar sangs rgyas 'od dpas med kyi thugaba'ikar thim par bsam//dmegasapa phog skabs tshar gcig gi chog /mchan//sbyangs ba'i skabs su yang snying gar hrīX yig gsal la dmigs pa sngar ltar phaṭaḥsgra dang bcas grangs bdun nam nyer gcig sogs yang yang sbyangs/ lugs gzhan la phaṭa brjod nas spar zhing ṭa brjod pas mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa bya srol yod kyang / 'dir mar 'bebs srol med gsungs/ mthar sku lnga'i dbyings su rgyas gdab pa'i ched du/ phaṭa lnga phrugasasu brjod cingaganasalugs sprosapa dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de nas spyi bo'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams gtso bo gsum la thim/ sems dpa' gnyis kyang bla ma 'od dpag med la thim/ 'od dpag med 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i tshe bum rin po che dpag bsam ljon shing gi kha rgyan can 'dzin pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis spras pa'i thugs kar 'khor 'das kyi dngas bcud thabs shes nyi zla /nyi ma 'og mchan/ga'u 160

༄7/ /sngona'agro'ikhridayig / rtethar lam gsal byed/kha sbyor gyi dbusasuhrīḥ.āsmṛsamatshanang/zlosridezhi'isnod bcud kyi tshe bcud 'dus par gsal thob la bsnyen pa mnyam du gsung bar zhu/ oṃ gu ru ā yuḥsirnyi hūṃ hrīḥ.a mā ra ṇi dzī ban ti ye swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa dang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyang ci rigs par brjod la mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag go /de ltar byas pas rten 'brel gyi bden pas che gegs kyang zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /ji skad bshad pa'i dmigs pa blor byang bar byas la/ nyams su len skabs gter gzhud khrigs bsdebs ji lta ba bzhin nyams su len la rtags thon bar sbyangs/ 'byongs pa'i rtags ni/ gzhung las/ mgo na chu ser zil pa phrum//'jags ma 'dar gyis tshugs sogs 'byung //zhes so/ /mthar dge ba bsngo zhing bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam kyang 'don par bya'o/ /de ltar zab lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'di ni bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam grangs gzhan ltar dus yun ring du sbyangs mi dgos par bdun phrag gcig tsam sbyangs na nges par rtags thon nges pas ma bsgoms par sangs /rta/pa'i snor+shartocheXsnyomyur lam bla na med pa 'di lta bu thams cad kyis yi dam du bya bar rigs so/ /gachis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ rang nyid la 'chi ltas byung ste cis kyang mi bzlog par shes shing thim rim rnams 'byung ba'i tshe bya dgos kyi/ de las gzhan du mi rung ste/ rgyud las/ dus la bab tshe 'pho bya ste/ /dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de la spyir thim rim la mang du yod kyang go bde ba'i dbang du byas na/dbang po lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi/ snang mched thob gsum gyi thim rim dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi sngas mgor ser tshogs lta bu yod na/ de dag gi 'don pa gsung ba'i sgra'am/g.yin gyis rang la gtam smras kyang sgra tsam las tshig 'bru ci bzhin mi go ba'i tshe rna ba'i shes pa 'gags pa yin/1 de bzhin du mig gis gzugs la bltas kyang yad yud tsam las mi mthong /sngar 'drisakyi rang gi nye 'brel sogasadrung du phyin kyang ngo mi 16/

༄/ /riga'adzina'agro2lakhrosko dpa'abordorjes ma dzad/shes pa/ mawo//ba'i tshe mig gi shes pa 'gagase/2 de mtshon snas dri3— lces ro4ngulus kyis reg bya sogs yul ci bzhin mi myong bar 'gyur ba'i tshe thim rim phyi ma yin pas 'di dus ngo sprod gdab dgos shing /5 'pho ba 'debs mkhan yod na 'debs pa'i dus ma nor ba yin/ min kyang rang gis 'pho ba las la sbyar ba'i gdams nga/ 'chad 'gyur ltar gnad du bsnun dgos pa'i dus yin no/ /gnyis pa sha'i khams sa la thims pas lus dong du lhung ba lta bu dang /1 ri bos non pa lta bu lci snang 'char te/ da lta mi 'chi ka ma 'ga' res nga yar 'then zer ba dang / nga'i sngas 'di mtho ru chug la sogs pa zer ba de yin/ khrag gi khams chu la thim pas kha sna nas chu 'dzags3 shing lha ba nyab/2 drod kyi khams me la thim pas drod mtha' nas sdud de kha sna skam/3 kha cig la spyi bo nas rlangs pa phyu ru ru 'ong / dbugs kyi khams rlung la thim pa'i tshe/4 gyen rgyu/ thur sel/ me nyams khyab byed kyi rlung dang bzhi ka srog 'dzin gyi rlung la 'dus pas dbugs nang du sdud dka' zhing /dbugs kyi gnas glo ba nas lam mid pa dkar nag brgyud de dbugs phyir la brtsegs mar 'phen/de nas lus kyi khrag thams cad srog rtsar 'dusate snying dbus su khrag thig pa gsum rim par brgyab bas dbugs ring po gsum ha zhes phyir 'phen zhing ༷ltazhes dbugs song ste phyi dbugs khrog gis chad/ gsum pa de'i dus su spyi bo nas pha las thob pa'i thig le dkar cha thur du brgyugs te phyi rtags su nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la zla 'od phog pa lta bu'i dkar lam 'char/ nang rtags su shes pa gsal nyams dang ldan/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa so gsum 'gags/ de snang ba zer/ lte ba nas ma las thob pa'i rak+ta dmar cha gyen du brgyug pas phyi rtags su nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la nyi 'od phog pa lta bu'i dmar lam 'char/ nang rtags su shes pa bde nyams che/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags/ de mched pa zer/ de nas dkar dmar gnyis snying dbus su 'phrad pa'i bar du rnam 162

༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / thar lam gsal byed/shes tshud nas phyi rtagasasunamamakha'agaya'adig pa lasmags kyis khyab pa lta bu'i nag lam dang / nang rtags su mi rtog nga 'i nyams 'char/ gti mug gi rtog pa bdun 'gags nas nag thum gyis brgyal 'gro/ de nye bar thob pa zer/ de nas nyer thob 'od gsal la thim pa zhes cung zad brgyal sangs nas nam mkha' bslad byed kyi rkyen gsum dang bral ba lta bu'i gzhi yi 'od gsal yud tsam la 'char ba de rang ngo shes nas mnyam par bzhag na rab chos skur 'pho ba zhes bar do med par sangs rgya ba yin/ de nas rim pas chos nyid dang srid pa'i bar do sogs 'char ba yin te/ de dag dngos gzhi'i khrid ye shes bla ma las shes so/ /phal po che las/dper na rkyal mkhan chu yis khyer ba'i tshe/ /rkyal ba'i lo rgyus sems la yod gyur kyang / /ma brkyal bar du thar bar mi 'gyur bzhin/ /shes kyang ma sgom chos kyang de dang 'dra/ zhes dang / lho brag mar pas/ ngas sbyangs shing sbyangs shing yang yang sbyangs/ /sngar 'dris su byas pa'i gdeng gcig yod/ /nga tha mal du shi yang nyams nga med/ /ces pa ltar/ da lta nyams len gnad du khel nges ma byas par bshad yams dang go lo thos lor shor tshe/ yang phal po che las/ ji ltar yul ba so nam mkhan gyi mis/ /rang gi zhing bskyur rog la legs bslab pas/ /ston thog smin dus rang la med pa ltar/ /shes kyang ma bsgoms chos kyang de dang 'dra/ /zhes gdams ngag la goms 'dris byed pa gal che/ nyams len gnad du ma song ba dag gis 'chi ba la nye ba'i tshe 'jig rten tshe 'di'i zhen pa rbad kyis bcad nas/ da res 'chi ba 'di bla ma'i gdams ngag la brten te dag pa'i zhing du dpag chen gyis mda' 'phang pa ltar 'gro ba yin pas nga re dga' snya/ma du sems kyi dpa' bskyed/'pho ba'i dmigs nga/ sogs rang gi yid la gsal dka' na gsal 'debs nus pa'i grogs yod tshe gsal 'debs su 'jug go /gang ltar gong du bshad pa ltar da lta gson pa'i gnas skabs na 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang / gang 163

༄/ /riga'ajina'agrobolazlo// lhadapa'abordorjes rme dzad/byas sdig sdug gi bya ba/ gang snang 'khrul bi'i rngeng bzhin/ rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal kho na las bde ba med tshul la blo sbyangs/ ji skad bshad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byar gyi rdzogs rim bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dang / 'pho lung gi dmigs rim la goms 'dris yod nges bya ba rnams gal che'o/ //rtsa ba'i lnga pa gshin po rjes 'dzin thugs rje'i lcags kyu'i 'pho ba la gsum/ 'pho ba gdab pa'i dus tshod/ 'debs pa po gang zag gi khyad par/ ji ltar 'debs tshul lo/ /dang po 'pho ba gdab pa'i dus tshod ni/ gong du las la sbyar ba'i skabs ji skad bshad pa ltar phyi dbugs chad nas nang dbugs ma chad pa'i gong du dus nges pa dang 'phrad na 'pho ba'i man ngag la cung zad goms 'dris yod pa gang rung rung gis 'pho ba btab na yang / phan thog che zhing ngan song gi skye gnas dgag par nus te/ mgron po lam du zhugs pa la grogs kyis bsgyur ba dang 'dra gsungs/gnyis pa de ltar ma yin par lus sems bral tshar na'ang / rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi rnal 'byor pas byang bu sogs dmigs rten la rnam shes bkug nas 'pho ba btab na gdos bcas kyi lus dang bral ba de rkyen gyis bsgyur sla bas na the tshom med par grol nus la/ gang zag phal bas phung po la rnam shen(bkug ste 'pho bar rlom pa la ni snying po ci yang med gsungs/ de bas na da lta bla ma'am sprul sku la sogs pa'i ming btags pa go sa tsam las bskyed rdzogs la sbyang goms cher med pa gshin po la 'pho ba 'debs pa rnams kyis/ byams snying rje byang chub gyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs te rang 'dod kyi 'khris med pa dag gis gshin po la phan thog shas che zhing rang la sgrib par mi 'gyur mod/ yon tan gang yang med bzhin rang gi rted tshol gyi ched du ngag 'don tsam shes pa la brten nas 'pho ba 'debs shing / gshin po'i pho rta sogs len pa ni shin tu tha chad pa yin te/ ji skad du/rang thar pa'i skam sar ma phyin par/ /mi gzhan gyi 'dren ston byed pa de/ /de sdi64

༄༅/ /sngon 'gro'i khrid yig / rtse thar lam gsal byed/gnyis kyang cungazadachamamathun/ /dpechuḍā khyepre mi lamisa'ajus 'dra/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa 'pho ba ji ltar 'debs chul ni/ de la rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas pha rol po'i rnam shes dang rang gi rtog tshogs dbyer med dbyings su la bzlas te phaṭa kyis rgyas gdab cing ngang la bzhag pa dang / bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug la goms pa'i gang zag gis gshed ma bskrad bsrungs sdig sbyang rnams rang rang gi cho ga'i 'gros ltar rgyas bsdu sa gang byed sngon du 'gro bas dmigs rten la rnam shes bkug nas ming bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po lhar gsal te nges shes ma skyes par spar la mthar dbyings rig bsres pa dang / de gnyis ka lhongs su ma gyur pa dag gis cho ga gang byed sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang pa'i rnam dag la nan tan du bya zhing rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab me'i bden pa bslu ba med pa la yid ches pa'i dad pa brtan po dang ldan pas bcos ma'i byams snying rje'i rtsal yang yang bton nas dmigs pa kho na la 'bad cing 'pho ba'i gsol 'debasal grangasabazung ste yang yang spar/mthar bsngo smon bzang po'i rigs lad mo rjes zlos kyi tshul du bya ba sogs gang zag gi blo tshod dang bstu na dgos pa yin no/ /'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas pa'i khrid kyi rim pa cung zad bstan zin to// //de ltar dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba la bsam nas dal rten la snying po blangs/ tshe mi rtag pa la bsam nas bcerdzon 'grus kyi rta pho lcag kyis bskul/ sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras la bsam nas nges 'byung dang snying rje'i rtsal 'don/ dge ba'i rgyu 'bras la bsam nas theg pa mchog gi lam la brod pa bskyed/ thams cad las kyi rang bzhin yin par thag bcad ste rgyu 'bras yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po rgyud la bsten/ zhar byung rang rgyud la brtags nas rang skyon sun phyung ste yon tan gong 'phel la brtson/ dge ba'i bshes gten la bsten nas dgongs spyod bslab pa ste thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro khrid rkang drug dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su bzung nas thar pa'i lam 165

༄/ /riga'adzina'agrobolarlo/ swādapa'abordorjes rme dzad/gyi rten gzhi bca'/ byangachubamachogatusemarmi bskyedadergyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya mtshos khog phub/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la brten nas nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba sdig lhung stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags/ sku gsum gyi zhing khams maṇ+ḍal du phul ba dang rjes su 'brel te phung po mchod sbyin gyis bdag 'dzin gcod cing tshogs gnyis khyad par can bsags/ byin rlabs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla ma la gsol ba btab ste dgongs brgyud don gyi 'pho ba rang rgyud la theb par bya ba ste/ thun min nang gi sngon 'gro khrid rkang lnga dang / lam mthar ma phyin par 'chi ba thog bab tu byung na dag pa'i zhing du mtshams sbyar ba 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas te khyon khrid rkang bcu gnyis yin la/ de dag kyang sngon 'gro blo ldog bzhi dang /rang skyon sun 'byin la brten nasabacosam ma yin pa'i ngesa'abyung bskyed cing lam gyi sgo phyes/ yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten nas lam gyirten 'brel bsgrigs/ skyabs 'gros gzhi bzung / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ phyin drug gi lam la bslab nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam yang dag pa la khrid pa ste/khrid tshul gzhan du snang ba gsum dang / skyes bu gsum dang / phyag chen mdo lugs su khrid par grags pa la sogs pa thams cad kyi lam gnad yongs su rdzogs pa 'di tsam du 'dus pa yin la/thabs bla na med pa rdor sems dang maṇ+ḍal la bsten pa'i bsags sbyangs gnyisadang /zab mo byin rlabs kyi gsang lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / ma bsgom par sangs rgyas pa 'pho ba'i gdams pa rnams ni/ khrid tshul 'di'i khyad par gyi chos bla na med pa yin/ da dung yang snying thig rdo rje snying po'i lam gyi dngos gzhi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgor 'jug pa la ni/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'i sgo nas sku gsum dang sems rigs gis sna khrid de/ don gyi ngo sprod rig pa rtsal gyi dbang bskur nas gzod nyams khrid dmar bcing du 'debs pa yin no// //166

༄7//sngona'agro'ikhridayig/ste rtethar lam gsal byed/de ltar 'phags bodagrubapa'idabangaphyugachene+e po dag girnam thar rma med bdag gir mdzad nas thos bsam sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan sogs gzhan la ma lhos par lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na nyams bzhes mdzad pa la brten te/ thugs bskyed kyi 'bras bu dus su smin nas ji lta ji snyed kyi ye shes mngon du gyur te/gangs can gyi mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug gi nor bu lta bu shing rta chen po rang byung rdo rje 'jigs bral gling pa zhes mtshan snyan gyi rnga gseng sa gsum yongs su khyab pa gang gi bka' babs bdun gyi gter kha dang khyad par dgongs gter nam mkha' mdzod kyi chos sde byon pa'i rtsa ba bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyi snying po/klong chen snying thig zhes snga 'gyur rdzogs pa chen po bka' gter thams cad chu bo gcig 'dres gdams pa'i bcud phur lta bu 'di nyid nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i mkhas grub kyi dbang po du ma byon pas thun mong thun min gyi khrid yig tshad ma gsum ldan zab cing rgya che ba rgyas bsdus ma dros rgya mtsho ltar bzhugs bzhin/bye gseb chu thigs lta bu'i blun po rang mtshang ston byed 'di 'dra 'dri ba'i dgos gal chung yang / kho bo skyes sbyangs yon tan gyi na tshod phra bzhin rang rgyud grol smin gyis dben zhing /chos dang 'jig rten gang thad nas ku su la'i gdol spyod pa yin kyang /bong ba gser gzigs lta bus sgo nas brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung / smin grol gdams pa rgya mtsho'i bka' drin brtsal ba'i rang ngor kha tsam min pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang snga phyi rim pas dbang bskur chos bshad gyis zhes bka' nan gser gyi rdo rje spyi bor phebs bzhin bsgrang bya du mar bla ma'i go sa bzung nas slob ma skyong mdog mar me ri mo la mar me'o zhes btags pa ltar mchog dman phal tha so sor gang 'dod ci phan smin grol don gnyer byas rung dus dbang btsan pas dngos su phan thog de tsam las ma byung yang / dpal mgon bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs skong byed dang /zab chos 'di nyid phyogs mtha' kun tu khyab che bas rang 'dra'i blo daX/ dpe

༄/ /riga'ajina'agrolpolapyo ṭ+wāṃ dpa'abordorjes ma/dzad/tshogs mang che na blor mi shongs shing / zeb grehūṃs kyi gnad gsang mi dpog pa'i bla slob la/ 'chad nyan bde ba'i ched go sla ba'i thabs kho na gtsor bton/ khrid yig rgyas bsdus rnams la khong bcol/ mtshungs med dam pa rnams kyi zhal rgyun rang gis gang zin bcas sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don khrigs su bcad nas tshigs ris dang mthun par byas te/ blo ldog rnam pa bzhi dang khyad par rgyu 'bras skabs sdig pa'i rgyu 'bras ngan song gsum dmigs su bkal/ dge ba'i rgyu 'bras mtho ris gsum sogs shugs bstan gyi mdzad nga can yin pa mkhyen bzhin khrid rim gnyis su byas/ sdom gsum bcas 'gal sogs rang skyon sun 'byin la gsal kha phran bus brgyan/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas thun mong thun min 'pho ba bcas tshig gi 'byin 'jug rang blo da/nga gang 'phrod tsam las rang gzhung ngag 'don ltar lhag bsam rnam par dag pas dus snga mo nas 'di ltar bri snyam pa'i mos pa yod pa dang /slar lam 'di la mos pa du mas bskul zhing / khyad par du bka' brgyud 'brug pa'i bstan 'dzin mchog sprul 7 kun bzang theg mchog bstan 'dzin gyis dngos po'i maṇ+ḍal gya nom pa bcas dngos brgyud nas nan cher bskul ma mdzad pa la brten nas grags snyan re ba'i chos brgyad kyi bsam pa'i dug dang ma 'dres nges pas/ji skad du/ don med phal cher don yod phyir/ /rnam kun don yod rig par bya/ /zhes se ral la khyi tshil gyis dpes phyi rabs blo dman thar 'dod mkhos chung gi skal ldan re 'ga' la cung phan nam snyam pas yang yang brtag dpyad bcas grub par bgyis pa lags/ yi ge 'di la go ba lon nges dang / gtam rgyud sogs rgyas spros kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung zhib mjal gyis go don rang rgyud du 'byor nges re mdzad na de las mang mi dgos lam kha tshang yin nges so/ /oṃ su sti/ de ltar klong chen snying thig sngon 'gro yi/ /thun mong thun min khrid rim thar pa'i lam/ /gsal byed sgron me zhes spel kun phan blos/ /yi ge'i phyi mo spar 168

༄༅/ /sngona'agro'ikhredayig /dhi thar lam gsal byed/du bkrun pa'idage /dusagasumabasagasasgropa'i rnem dkar dge tshogs rgyun/ /chab gcig ma rnams sangs rgyas thob phyir du/ /dmigs med chos kyi dbyings su yongs bsngos pas/ /khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas dkrugs gyur cig /'gro khams ye nas chos skus khyab pa la/ /gzhi la gdams ngag zab mos mtshams sbyar te/ /'bras bu dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi skur/ /phyams gcig bde mchog bde blag nyid thob shog /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bla ma mchog gis rjes su 'dzin gyur nas/ /gdams pa'i bcud myang 'gro kun phan bde'i dpyid/ /dam chos 'od brgyas yongs su snang nus shog/sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed mdzad phrin kun/ /bzod brtson rtag gus sbyor bas nyer blangs te/ /gang 'dul der ston skyo ngal med pa yis/ /bstan 'gro'i sman pa che mchog nyid gyur cig /ris med bstan dang der 'dzin skyes bu'i sde/ /brtan mkhas btsun pas 'dzam gling tha gru khyab/ /spong klog phrin las mkhan slob chos rgyal gyis/ /dus ston ji bzhin dar rgyas gong 'phel 3|ga /gnas skabs dus kyi rgud tshogs tha dag zhi/ /bskal bzang gsar du 'bod pa'i byed po ni/ /'gro khams 'phags nor bdun gyis 'byor bas phyug /tshe bsod dpal yon rdzogs ldan dus mtshungs shog/theg rtse bla med bstan pa 'dzin mkhas pa'i/ /rig pa 'dzin pas sa steng yongs gang nas/ /nges gsang gdong lnga'i dbang po'i nga re'i sgras/ /lam dman log gol lta ngan ri dwags sde/ /mthar bskrad yang dag lam bzang snang gyur cig /'brul zhig rnal 'byor rdo rje lcam dral gyis/ /ri sul mtsho gling gangs dang nags kyi khrod/ /yongs su gang nas brtul zhugs mthar phyin te/ /'phur 'gro'i bstan pa mkha' nyi ltar gsal rgyas/ /'gro kun skal bzang gdams pa'i snod gyur nas/ /mig 'phrul lta bu'i rig 'dzin gsang lam la/ /brten nas tshom bu gcig tu macan sangs rgyas/ /'khor 'das mnyam nyid zhing gis mdzes gyur cig /mi srun 'byung po'i tshogs kyi gdug pa'i sems/ /169

༄/ /riga'adzina'agro2lajoswā dpa'abordorjes ma dzad/byang sems bdud rtsi'i char gyis rlan byas4 nes—/ /thar ba'i sa bon smin rgyas phyams gcig tu/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i dbyings su grol bar shog /duḥ kha'i rgyu 'bras kyis mnar khams gsum 'gro/ /srid na gcig kyang mi gnas de srid du/ /lam bzang dam pa 'di yang nub med pas/ /bkra shis sa gsum kun tu khyab gyur cig /ji bzhin re smon 'grub pa'i dpang po sa /skyabs gnas rgya mtsho bden ldan ji snyed kyi/ /bslu med mthu byin nus pas de de bzhin/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ //ces rtsom pa grub phral yi ge'i phyi mo dge slong pad+ma sangs rgyas dang / spar dpe dge slong bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis shing / gcung po nam mkha' 'od gsal snying po dang / dbon sprul pad+ma kun grol bzang po gnyis/ mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pas gzhi byas/ sgrub brtson dam pa byams pa kun bzang gi dngul srang bcu dang /rmugs sangs sprul pa'i sku rnam gnyis sogs lam 'dir mos pa'i gang zag mang po'i bdag rkyen la brten nas dmar zob dngul rtel tshad 'gro nges za yon sbyar te spar du bsgrubs nas bsngo smon tshig bcad bcas rnams dkar byed ngo/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor tsam po pa/ 7kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi snang ba cung zad thob pa'i 7rig 'dzin 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rjes gnas chen rdo rje yongs rdzong gi nye char/ bkra shis dung dkar 'khyil ba'i ri zhol/ rang gnas bsam gtan gyi khang bur bla ma la gsol ba btab bakhi3 spel bas rnam pa kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig gu/ dge'o// //dge'o// // dge'o// // ༷ji so)/ //mi// 〈staXri spros+t+risgro kyā/(ṭī sne byusherte tshoricirmephrod+mahūṃ/tshoririrīXbye)170 cimoṅkarnye— /rtso/khyeraciste5(shātsho dzo ruspya274 rīchi
